```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/chat/components/channel-sidebar.tsx"
"use client";

import type { SubmitEvent } from "react";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import {
  HashIcon,
  LockIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  RotateCwIcon,
  SearchIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Alert, AlertAction, AlertTitle } from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useConversations } from "@/hooks/use-messaging";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import type { ChannelRow } from "../chat-actions";

import { browseChannels, createChannel, joinChannel } from "../chat-actions";

export interface OpenChannel {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
}

const KINDS = ["channel"] as const;

/**
 * The caller's channels with unread and mention counts, kept live over
 * Realtime, plus dialogs to browse the organization's channels and create one.
 */
export function ChannelSidebar({
  selected,
  onSelect,
}: {
  selected: string | null;
  onSelect: (channel: OpenChannel) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const { conversations, error, refresh } = useConversations({ kinds: KINDS });

  const opened = (channel: OpenChannel) => {
    void refresh();
    onSelect(channel);
  };

  return (
    <Card size="sm" className="min-h-0">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Channels")}</CardTitle>
        <CardAction className="flex gap-1">
          <BrowseChannelsDialog onOpened={opened} />
          <CreateChannelDialog onCreated={opened} />
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" aria-live="polite">
            <AlertTitle>{errorMessage(error)}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => void refresh()}
              >
                <RotateCwIcon aria-hidden />
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        {conversations === undefined ? (
          <div
            className="flex flex-col gap-2"
            aria-busy="true"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Loading channels")}</span>
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
          </div>
        ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty>
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <HashIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No channels yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Create one, or browse the channels others made.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5" data-testid="channels">
              {conversations.map((conversation) => {
                const name = conversation.title ?? conversation.id;
                const current = selected === conversation.id;

                return (
                  <li key={conversation.id}>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant={current ? "secondary" : "ghost"}
                      size="sm"
                      className="w-full justify-start"
                      aria-current={current ? "true" : undefined}
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelect({ id: conversation.id, name });
                      }}
                    >
                      {conversation.access === "members" ? (
                        <LockIcon aria-hidden />
                      ) : (
                        <HashIcon aria-hidden />
                      )}
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "truncate",
                          conversation.unread > 0 && "font-semibold",
                        )}
                      >
                        {name}
                      </span>
                      {conversation.mentions > 0 ? (
                        <Badge variant="destructive" className="ml-auto">
                          @{conversation.mentions}
                        </Badge>
                      ) : conversation.unread > 0 ? (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-auto">
                          {conversation.unread}
                        </Badge>
                      ) : null}
                    </Button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </ScrollArea>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function BrowseChannelsDialog({
  onOpened,
}: {
  onOpened: (channel: OpenChannel) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const browse = useAction(browseChannels);
  const join = useAction(joinChannel);

  const pick = async (channel: ChannelRow) => {
    if (!channel.joined) {
      const joined = await join.run({ channelId: channel.id });

      if (!joined.ok) {
        toast.error(errorMessage(joined.error));

        return;
      }
    }

    setOpen(false);
    onOpened({ id: channel.id, name: channel.name });
  };

  const rows = browse.data;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);

        if (next) {
          void browse.run({});
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger
        render={
          <Button
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="outline"
            aria-label={t("Browse channels")}
          />
        }
      >
        <SearchIcon aria-hidden />
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t("Browse channels")}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {t("Every public channel, and the private ones you are in.")}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {browse.error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" aria-live="polite">
            <AlertTitle>{errorMessage(browse.error)}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => void browse.run({})}
              >
                <RotateCwIcon aria-hidden />
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : rows === undefined ? (
          <div
            className="flex flex-col gap-2"
            aria-busy="true"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Loading channels")}</span>
            <Skeleton className="h-10" />
            <Skeleton className="h-10" />
          </div>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty>
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No channels to join")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Close this and create the first one.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {rows.map((channel) => (
              <li key={channel.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium">
                    {channel.visibility === "private" ? (
                      <LockIcon aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                    ) : (
                      <HashIcon aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span className="truncate">{channel.name}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {channel.topic ??
                      t("{count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}", {
                        count: channel.memberCount,
                      })}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant={channel.joined ? "outline" : "default"}
                  disabled={join.pending}
                  onClick={() => void pick(channel)}
                >
                  {channel.joined ? t("Open") : t("Join")}
                </Button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function CreateChannelDialog({
  onCreated,
}: {
  onCreated: (channel: OpenChannel) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState("");
  const [isPrivate, setPrivate] = useState(false);

  const create = useAction(createChannel, {
    onSuccess: (id) => {
      setOpen(false);
      onCreated({ id, name: name.trim().toLowerCase() });
    },
  });

  const message =
    create.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(create.error);

  const submit = (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    void create.run({
      name,
      topic,
      visibility: isPrivate ? "private" : "public",
    });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        setName("");
        setTopic("");
        setPrivate(false);
        create.reset();
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger
        render={<Button size="icon-sm" aria-label={t("Create a channel")} />}
      >
        <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("Create a channel")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("A place for one team, project or topic.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-invalid={message ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-name`}>{t("Name")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-name`}
                value={name}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setName(event.target.value);
                }}
                required
                maxLength={80}
                pattern="[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_\-]*"
                placeholder="launch"
              />
              <FieldDescription>
                {t("Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.")}
              </FieldDescription>
              {message ? <FieldError>{message}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-topic`}>{t("Topic")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-topic`}
                value={topic}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setTopic(event.target.value);
                }}
                maxLength={250}
              />
            </Field>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Switch
                id={`${fieldId}-private`}
                checked={isPrivate}
                onCheckedChange={setPrivate}
              />
              <Label
                htmlFor={`${fieldId}-private`}
                className="text-sm font-normal"
              >
                {t("Private: only the people you add see it")}
              </Label>
            </div>
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={create.pending}>
              {t("Create")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

## Message list

A conversation's messages over Realtime, with older pages on demand, who is typing, reply counts and the composer. It calls `useMessages` from `@/hooks/use-messaging`; the [messaging](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/messaging), [channels](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/channels) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add messaging channels`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/message-list.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert button card empty scroll-area skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-messaging
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/chat/components/message-list.tsx"
"use client";

import type { Message } from "better-supabase/blocks/messaging";

import { MessagesSquareIcon, RotateCwIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useRef } from "react";

import { Alert, AlertAction, AlertTitle } from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useMessages } from "@/hooks/use-messaging";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { MessageComposer } from "./message-composer";
import { MessageItem } from "./message-item";
import { PresenceAvatars } from "./presence-avatars";

/**
 * A channel's top-level messages, live over Realtime: older pages on demand,
 * who is typing, and the composer. Replies open in a thread.
 */
export function MessageList({
  conversationId,
  name,
  topic,
  onOpenThread,
}: {
  conversationId: string;
  name: string;
  topic?: string | undefined;
  onOpenThread: (root: Message) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const input = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const {
    messages,
    hasOlder,
    typing,
    error,
    send,
    setTyping,
    loadOlder,
    refresh,
  } = useMessages({ conversationId });

  return (
    <Card size="sm" className="min-h-0">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>#{name}</CardTitle>
        {topic ? <CardDescription>{topic}</CardDescription> : null}
        <CardAction>
          <PresenceAvatars
            subject={{ type: "conversation", id: conversationId }}
          />
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" aria-live="polite">
            <AlertTitle>{errorMessage(error)}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => void refresh()}
              >
                <RotateCwIcon aria-hidden />
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        {messages === undefined ? (
          <div
            className="flex flex-col gap-4"
            aria-busy="true"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Loading messages")}</span>
            <Skeleton className="h-12" />
            <Skeleton className="h-12" />
            <Skeleton className="h-12" />
          </div>
        ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="flex-1">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <MessagesSquareIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No messages yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Say hello to start the conversation.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => input.current?.focus()}
              >
                {t("Write a message")}
              </Button>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 pr-3">
              {hasOlder ? (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="xs"
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="self-center"
                  onClick={() => void loadOlder()}
                >
                  {t("Load older messages")}
                </Button>
              ) : null}
              <ol className="flex flex-col gap-4" data-testid="messages">
                {messages.map((message) => (
                  <MessageItem
                    key={message.id}
                    message={message}
                    onOpenThread={onOpenThread}
                  />
                ))}
              </ol>
            </div>
          </ScrollArea>
        )}
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="flex-col items-stretch gap-1">
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
          {typing.length > 0
            ? t(
                "{count, plural, one {Someone is typing} other {# people are typing}}",
                { count: typing.length },
              )
            : null}
        </p>
        <MessageComposer
          conversationId={conversationId}
          inputRef={input}
          placeholder={t("Message #{name}", { name })}
          onSend={send}
          onTyping={setTyping}
        />
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Message composer

A message box that sends on Enter, signals typing, and uploads dropped, pasted or picked files onto the message. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [messaging](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/messaging), [attachments](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/attachments) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add messaging attachments`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/message-composer.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button label spinner textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/chat/components/message-composer.tsx"
"use client";

import type { Result } from "better-supabase";
import type { DragEvent, Ref } from "react";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { PaperclipIcon, SendIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import type { MessageDraft } from "@/hooks/use-messaging";

import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useSupabase } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { confirmChatUpload, startChatUpload } from "../chat-actions";

interface PendingFile {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly name: string;
  /** Set once the bytes are uploaded and confirmed. */
  readonly id: string | null;
}

/** How often a held key press tells the others the caller is typing. */
const TYPING_EVERY_MS = 2000;

/**
 * Writes a message with files: drop them on the box, paste them, or pick them.
 * Each file uploads to the conversation first; `send` moves it onto the
 * message.
 */
export function MessageComposer({
  conversationId,
  placeholder,
  inputRef,
  onSend,
  onTyping,
}: {
  conversationId: string;
  placeholder: string;
  inputRef?: Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>;
  onSend: (body: string, draft: MessageDraft) => Promise<Result<unknown>>;
  onTyping: (typing: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const bodyId = useId();
  const picker = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const lastPing = useRef(0);
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<readonly PendingFile[]>([]);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const start = useAction(startChatUpload);
  const confirm = useAction(confirmChatUpload);

  const uploading = files.some((file) => file.id === null);

  const drop = (key: string) => {
    setFiles((current) => current.filter((file) => file.key !== key));
  };

  const upload = async (file: File) => {
    const key = crypto.randomUUID();
    setFiles((current) => [...current, { key, name: file.name, id: null }]);

    const started = await start.run({
      conversationId,
      name: file.name,
      mimeType: file.type,
      size: file.size,
    });

    if (!started.ok) {
      drop(key);
      toast.error(errorMessage(started.error));

      return;
    }

    const { id, bucket, path, token } = started.data;

    const sent = await supabase.storage
      .from(bucket)
      .uploadToSignedUrl(path, token, file, { contentType: file.type });

    const confirmed = sent.error ? undefined : await confirm.run({ id });

    if (!confirmed?.ok) {
      drop(key);
      toast.error(t("{name} did not upload. Try again.", { name: file.name }));

      return;
    }

    setFiles((current) =>
      current.map((each) => (each.key === key ? { ...each, id } : each)),
    );
  };

  const add = (list: FileList | null) => {
    for (const file of list ?? []) {
      void upload(file);
    }
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    const text = body.trim();

    if ((text === "" && files.length === 0) || uploading) {
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);

    const result = await onSend(text, {
      attachmentIds: files.flatMap((file) => (file.id ? [file.id] : [])),
    });

    setSending(false);

    if (result.ok) {
      setBody("");
      setFiles([]);
    } else {
      toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
    }
  };

  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-2"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        void submit();
      }}
    >
      <Label htmlFor={bodyId} className="sr-only">
        {t("Message")}
      </Label>
      <Textarea
        ref={inputRef}
        id={bodyId}
        value={body}
        rows={2}
        maxLength={4000}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        onDragOver={(event: DragEvent) => {
          event.preventDefault();
        }}
        onDrop={(event: DragEvent) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          add(event.dataTransfer.files);
        }}
        onChange={(event) => {
          setBody(event.target.value);

          if (event.timeStamp - lastPing.current > TYPING_EVERY_MS) {
            lastPing.current = event.timeStamp;
            onTyping(true);
          }
        }}
        onPaste={(event) => {
          if (event.clipboardData.files.length > 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            add(event.clipboardData.files);
          }
        }}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
            event.preventDefault();
            void submit();
          }
        }}
      />
      {files.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" aria-live="polite">
          {files.map((file) => (
            <li key={file.key}>
              <Badge variant="outline">
                {file.id === null ? <Spinner /> : <PaperclipIcon aria-hidden />}
                {file.name}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={t("Remove {name}", { name: file.name })}
                  className="text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
                  onClick={() => {
                    drop(file.key);
                  }}
                >
                  <XIcon aria-hidden />
                </button>
              </Badge>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          ref={picker}
          type="file"
          multiple
          hidden
          onChange={(event) => {
            add(event.target.files);
            event.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="icon-sm"
          variant="ghost"
          aria-label={t("Attach files")}
          onClick={() => picker.current?.click()}
        >
          <PaperclipIcon aria-hidden />
        </Button>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {t("Drop or paste files to attach them.")}
        </span>
        <Button
          type="submit"
          size="sm"
          className="ml-auto"
          disabled={sending || uploading}
        >
          <SendIcon aria-hidden />
          {t("Send")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Thread panel

A thread beside the channel: the root message, its replies live over Realtime, and a composer that replies into it. It calls `useMessages` from `@/hooks/use-messaging`; the [messaging](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/messaging), [channels](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/channels) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add messaging channels`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/thread-panel.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert button card empty scroll-area separator skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-messaging
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/chat/components/thread-panel.tsx"
"use client";

import type { Message } from "better-supabase/blocks/messaging";

import { MessageSquareIcon, RotateCwIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useRef } from "react";

import { Alert, AlertAction, AlertTitle } from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useMessages } from "@/hooks/use-messaging";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { MessageComposer } from "./message-composer";
import { MessageItem } from "./message-item";

/** A thread: its root message, the replies, and a composer that replies into it. */
export function ThreadPanel({
  root,
  onClose,
}: {
  /** The top-level message the thread hangs off. */
  root: Message;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const input = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const thread = useMessages({
    conversationId: root.conversationId,
    threadId: root.id,
  });

  return (
    <Card size="sm" className="min-h-0">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Thread")}</CardTitle>
        <CardAction>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={t("Close the thread")}
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            <XIcon aria-hidden />
          </Button>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
        {thread.error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" aria-live="polite">
            <AlertTitle>{errorMessage(thread.error)}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => void thread.refresh()}
              >
                <RotateCwIcon aria-hidden />
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        {thread.messages === undefined ? (
          <div
            className="flex flex-col gap-4"
            aria-busy="true"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Loading the thread")}</span>
            <Skeleton className="h-12" />
            <Skeleton className="h-12" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 pr-3">
              <ol>
                <MessageItem message={root} />
              </ol>
              <Separator />
              {thread.messages.length === 0 ? (
                <Empty>
                  <EmptyHeader>
                    <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                      <MessageSquareIcon />
                    </EmptyMedia>
                    <EmptyTitle>{t("No replies yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                    <EmptyDescription>
                      {t("Replies stay here, out of the channel.")}
                    </EmptyDescription>
                  </EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyContent>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => input.current?.focus()}
                    >
                      {t("Reply")}
                    </Button>
                  </EmptyContent>
                </Empty>
              ) : (
                <ol className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                  {thread.messages.map((message) => (
                    <MessageItem key={message.id} message={message} />
                  ))}
                </ol>
              )}
            </div>
          </ScrollArea>
        )}
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="flex-col items-stretch">
        <MessageComposer
          conversationId={root.conversationId}
          inputRef={input}
          placeholder={t("Reply in the thread")}
          onSend={thread.send}
          onTyping={thread.setTyping}
        />
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Presence avatars

Who else has a record open (a channel, a comment thread's record or a document), on the record's presence topic. It calls `usePresence` from `better-supabase/react`; the [messaging block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/messaging) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add messaging`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/presence-avatars.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add avatar
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/chat/components/presence-avatars.tsx"
"use client";

import { usePresence } from "better-supabase/react";
import {
  subjectPresenceTopic,
  subjectPresenceValues,
} from "better-supabase/realtime";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import * as v from "valibot";

import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarGroup,
  AvatarGroupCount,
} from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/hooks";

const SHOWN = 4;

/** States that fail the schema never reach `members`. */
const viewers = subjectPresenceTopic(
  v.object({ userId: v.string(), name: v.string() }),
);

/**
 * Who else has a record open: a channel, a comment thread's record or a
 * document. The subjects module lets anyone who reads the record join its
 * presence topic. States come from the clients, so they only label avatars.
 */
export function PresenceAvatars({
  subject,
}: {
  subject: { readonly type: string; readonly id: string };
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("chat");
  const session = useSession();
  const me = session.kind === "user" ? session.user : null;

  const { members } = usePresence(
    viewers,
    subjectPresenceValues(me ? subject : null),
    { state: me ? { userId: me.id, name: me.email ?? t("Someone") } : null },
  );

  const others = new Map<string, string>();

  for (const { state } of members) {
    if (state.userId !== me?.id) {
      others.set(state.userId, state.name);
    }
  }

  if (others.size === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const people = [...others];

  return (
    <AvatarGroup
      aria-label={t(
        "{count, plural, one {# other viewer} other {# other viewers}}",
        { count: people.length },
      )}
    >
      {people.slice(0, SHOWN).map(([userId, name]) => (
        <Avatar key={userId} size="sm" title={name}>
          <AvatarFallback>{name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</AvatarFallback>
        </Avatar>
      ))}
      {people.length > SHOWN ? (
        <AvatarGroupCount>+{people.length - SHOWN}</AvatarGroupCount>
      ) : null}
    </AvatarGroup>
  );
}
```

## Workspace URL field

An organization form with a name and a URL slug, where reserved and taken slugs come back as field errors. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [organizations](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/organizations), [reserved-slugs](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/reserved-slugs) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add organizations reserved-slugs`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/workspace-url-field.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button field input
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/organization/components/organization-form.tsx"
"use client";

import { useActionForm } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { updateOrganization } from "../organization-actions";

export function OrganizationForm({
  name,
  slug,
  canEdit,
}: {
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  canEdit: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("organization");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const form = useActionForm(updateOrganization, {
    resetOnSuccess: false,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Organization saved"));
    },
  });

  const error =
    form.error === undefined
      ? null
      : form.error.kind === "conflict"
        ? t("That URL is taken. Pick another one.")
        : errorMessage(form.error);

  return (
    <form {...form.formProps} className="space-y-6">
      <fieldset disabled={!canEdit}>
        <FieldGroup>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-organization-name`}>
              {t("Name")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-organization-name`}
              name="name"
              defaultValue={name}
              required
              minLength={2}
              maxLength={80}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-organization-slug`}>
              {t("URL")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-organization-slug`}
              name="slug"
              defaultValue={slug}
              required
              pattern="[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]*[a-z0-9]"
              maxLength={48}
              aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
            />
            <FieldDescription>
              {t("Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.")}
            </FieldDescription>
            {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
          </Field>
        </FieldGroup>
      </fieldset>
      {canEdit ? (
        <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
          {t("Save")}
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {t("Only owners and admins can change the organization.")}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Chat with history

An AI chat that stores every message, resumes a stored conversation and streams the reply. It calls `useAssistant` from `better-supabase/ai-sdk/react`; the [ai-chat block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/ai-chat) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add ai-chat`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/chat-with-history.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/assistant/components/assistant-chat.tsx"
"use client";

import type { UIMessage } from "ai";

import { useAssistant } from "better-supabase/ai-sdk/react";
import { useDurableAssistant } from "better-supabase/ai-sdk/workflow/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { ChatView } from "./chat-view";

export type ChatMode = "standard" | "durable" | "research";

interface PanelProps {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly messages: UIMessage[];
  readonly streaming: boolean;
}

/**
 * The answer streams from the request; a reload picks it up from the stream
 * store.
 */
function StandardPanel({ id, messages }: PanelProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const chat = useAssistant({
    id,
    messages,
    onFinish: () => {
      router.refresh();
    },
  });

  return <ChatView id={id} chat={chat} />;
}

/**
 * The answer runs as a workflow: it survives a closed tab and waits for
 * approvals.
 */
function DurablePanel({
  id,
  messages,
  streaming,
  agent,
}: PanelProps & { readonly agent: "assistant" | "research" }) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const chat = useDurableAssistant({
    id,
    api: "/api/chat/durable",
    body: { agent },
    messages,
    resume: streaming,
    onFinish: () => {
      router.refresh();
    },
  });

  return <ChatView id={id} chat={chat} />;
}

/**
 * One chat. Standard answers stream from the request; Durable and Research
 * answers run as workflows, which need the AI Gateway key.
 */
export function AssistantChat({
  id,
  messages,
  streaming = false,
  initialMode = "standard",
  durableAvailable,
}: {
  id: string;
  messages: UIMessage[];
  streaming?: boolean;
  initialMode?: ChatMode;
  durableAvailable: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("assistant");

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ChatMode>(
    durableAvailable ? initialMode : "standard",
  );

  const modes: readonly { mode: ChatMode; label: string }[] = [
    { mode: "standard", label: t("Standard") },
    { mode: "durable", label: t("Durable") },
    { mode: "research", label: t("Research") },
  ];

  const panel = { id, messages, streaming };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <fieldset className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <legend className="sr-only">{t("Answer mode")}</legend>
        {modes.map((entry) => (
          <Button
            key={entry.mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={mode === entry.mode ? "default" : "outline"}
            aria-pressed={mode === entry.mode}
            disabled={entry.mode !== "standard" && !durableAvailable}
            onClick={() => {
              setMode(entry.mode);
            }}
          >
            {entry.label}
          </Button>
        ))}
        {durableAvailable ? null : (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {t("Durable answers need AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.")}
          </p>
        )}
      </fieldset>
      {mode === "standard" ? (
        <StandardPanel key="standard" {...panel} />
      ) : (
        <DurablePanel
          key={mode}
          {...panel}
          agent={mode === "research" ? "research" : "assistant"}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Agent activity

The agent runs for the organization with their steps and the approvals that wait for a person. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [agents block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/agents) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add agents`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/agent-run-trace.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/assistant/components/agent-activity.tsx"
import { ActivityIcon, InboxIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

import { getActivity } from "../assistant-queries";
import { ApprovalButtons } from "./approval-buttons";

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the approval inbox, then the latest runs with
 * their steps.
 */
export async function AgentActivity() {
  const [{ runs, approvals }, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getActivity(),
    getExtracted("assistant"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  const when = (iso: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3" aria-labelledby="approvals">
        <h2 id="approvals" className="text-sm font-medium">
          {t("Waiting for approval")}
        </h2>
        {approvals.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <InboxIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("Nothing to approve")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Tool calls that need your approval show up here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border">
            {approvals.map((approval) => (
              <li
                key={approval.approvalId}
                className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-medium">{approval.tool}</span>
                  <Link
                    href={`/assistant/${approval.chatId}`}
                    className="text-muted-foreground underline"
                  >
                    {approval.chatTitle === ""
                      ? t("Untitled chat")
                      : approval.chatTitle}
                  </Link>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                    {when(approval.createdAt)}
                  </span>
                </p>
                <pre className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md bg-muted p-2 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  {approval.input}
                </pre>
                <ApprovalButtons
                  chatId={approval.chatId}
                  approvalId={approval.approvalId}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3" aria-labelledby="runs">
        <h2 id="runs" className="text-sm font-medium">
          {t("Latest runs")}
        </h2>
        {runs.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <ActivityIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No runs yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Every answer the assistant writes is a run.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border">
            {runs.map((run) => (
              <li
                key={run.id}
                className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="outline">{run.status}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="secondary">
                    {run.engine === "workflow" ? t("Durable") : t("Standard")}
                  </Badge>
                  <Link
                    href={`/assistant/${run.chatId}`}
                    className="flex-1 truncate underline"
                  >
                    {run.model ?? t("Default model")}
                  </Link>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                    {when(run.startedAt)}
                  </span>
                </p>
                {run.steps.length > 0 ? (
                  <ol className="flex flex-col gap-1 ps-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {run.steps.map((step) => (
                      <li key={step.key} className="flex gap-2">
                        <span className="w-14 shrink-0">{step.status}</span>
                        <span className="truncate">{step.label}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AgentActivitySkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full rounded-xl" />;
}
```

## Workflow canvas

A node editor for a workflow definition that saves drafts, publishes versions and runs the workflow. It calls `useWorkflowCanvasRun` from `@/hooks/use-workflow-editor`; the [workflow-editor](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/workflow-editor), [workflows](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/workflows) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add workflow-editor workflows`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/workflow-canvas.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button input select
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-workflow-editor
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/workflows/builder/components/workflow-canvas.tsx"
"use client";

import type { Connection } from "@xyflow/react";
import type { WorkflowNodeKind } from "better-supabase/blocks/workflow-editor";

import {
  addEdge,
  Background,
  Controls,
  ReactFlow,
  useEdgesState,
  useNodesState,
} from "@xyflow/react";
import "@xyflow/react/dist/style.css";
import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { PlayIcon, PlusIcon, SaveIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { useWorkflowCanvasRun } from "@/hooks/use-workflow-editor";
import { useWorkflowRuns } from "@/hooks/use-workflows";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { BuilderDetail } from "../builder-queries";
import type { GraphFlowNode, GraphNodeData } from "./graph-node";

import { isFinished, statusVariant } from "../../workflow-labels";
import {
  decideNode,
  publishGraph,
  runDefinition,
  saveDraft,
} from "../builder-actions";
import { CredentialSheet } from "./credential-sheet";
import { fromFlow, nodeTypes, toFlow } from "./graph-node";
import { NodePanel } from "./node-panel";
import { PublishDialog } from "./publish-dialog";
import { TriggerSheet } from "./trigger-sheet";

const shortId = () => crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);

/**
 * The canvas: a palette from the step library, the graph on React Flow, an
 * inspector for the selected node, and the status of a run's nodes on top, live
 * over `workflow-run:<id>`.
 */
export function WorkflowCanvas({ detail }: { detail: BuilderDetail }) {
  const t = useExtracted("workflows");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [initial] = useState(() => toFlow(detail.graph));

  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState<GraphFlowNode>(
    initial.nodes,
  );

  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState(initial.edges);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [runId, setRunId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const { runs } = useWorkflowRuns({
    tenant: detail.tenant,
    schema: "api",
    limit: 50,
  });

  const overlay = useWorkflowCanvasRun(runId, { schema: "api" });

  const definitionRuns = (runs ?? []).filter(
    (run) => run.attributes["bsb.definition"] === detail.definition.id,
  );

  const graph = fromFlow(nodes, edges);
  const draft = { nodes: [...graph.nodes], edges: [...graph.edges] };

  const onError = (error: Parameters<typeof errorMessage>[0]) => {
    toast.error(errorMessage(error));
  };

  const save = useAction(saveDraft, {
    onError,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Draft saved"));
    },
  });

  const publish = useAction(publishGraph, {
    onError,
    onSuccess: (version) => {
      toast.success(
        t("Version {version} published", { version: String(version) }),
      );
    },
  });

  const run = useAction(runDefinition, {
    onError,
    onSuccess: (id) => {
      setRunId(id);
    },
  });

  const decide = useAction(decideNode, { onError });

  const addNode = (kind: WorkflowNodeKind, step?: string, title?: string) => {
    const id = `${step ?? kind}-${shortId()}`.replaceAll(".", "-");
    const lowest = Math.max(0, ...nodes.map((node) => node.position.y));

    const data: GraphNodeData = {
      kind,
      label: title ?? kind,
      config: kind === "sleep" ? { duration: "1m" } : {},
    };

    setNodes((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        id,
        type: "graph",
        position: { x: 0, y: lowest + 120 },
        data: step === undefined ? data : { ...data, step },
      },
    ]);
    setSelected(id);
  };

  const onConnect = (connection: Connection) => {
    setEdges((current) =>
      addEdge(
        connection.sourceHandle
          ? {
              ...connection,
              id: `e-${shortId()}`,
              label: connection.sourceHandle,
            }
          : { ...connection, id: `e-${shortId()}` },
        current,
      ),
    );
  };

  const updateNode = (id: string, data: Partial<GraphNodeData>) => {
    setNodes((current) =>
      current.map((node) =>
        node.id === id ? { ...node, data: { ...node.data, ...data } } : node,
      ),
    );
  };

  const removeNode = (id: string) => {
    setNodes((current) => current.filter((node) => node.id !== id));
    setEdges((current) =>
      current.filter((edge) => edge.source !== id && edge.target !== id),
    );
    setSelected(null);
  };

  const shown =
    runId === null
      ? nodes
      : nodes.map((node) => {
          const status = overlay.nodes[node.id]?.status;

          return status === undefined
            ? node
            : { ...node, data: { ...node.data, status } };
        });

  const selectedNode = nodes.find((node) => node.id === selected);
  const runOpen = overlay.run !== undefined && !isFinished(overlay.run.status);
  const definition = detail.definition.id;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          disabled={save.pending}
          onClick={() => {
            void save.run({ definition, graph: draft });
          }}
        >
          <SaveIcon />
          {t("Save draft")}
        </Button>
        <PublishDialog
          published={detail.published}
          graph={graph}
          pending={publish.pending}
          onPublish={() => {
            void publish.run({ definition, graph: draft });
          }}
        />
        <TriggerSheet definition={definition} triggers={detail.triggers} />
        <CredentialSheet credentials={detail.credentials} />
        <span className="grow" />
        <Input
          value={input}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setInput(event.target.value);
          }}
          placeholder={t("Input text")}
          aria-label={t("Input text")}
          className="w-56"
        />
        <Button
          size="sm"
          disabled={run.pending || detail.published === null}
          onClick={() => {
            void run.run({ definition, text: input });
          }}
        >
          <PlayIcon />
          {t("Run")}
        </Button>
        <Select
          value={runId}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            setRunId(value);
          }}
          items={definitionRuns.map((item) => ({
            value: item.externalId,
            label: format.dateTime(new Date(item.createdAt.epochMilliseconds), {
              timeStyle: "medium",
            }),
          }))}
        >
          <SelectTrigger className="w-44" aria-label={t("Show a run")}>
            <SelectValue placeholder={t("Show a run")} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {definitionRuns.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.id} value={item.externalId}>
                {format.dateTime(new Date(item.createdAt.epochMilliseconds), {
                  timeStyle: "medium",
                })}{" "}
                · {item.status}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        {overlay.run ? (
          <Badge variant={statusVariant(overlay.run.status)}>
            {overlay.run.status}
          </Badge>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-3">
        <nav
          className="w-48 shrink-0 space-y-1 rounded-lg border bg-card p-2"
          aria-label={t("Palette")}
        >
          {detail.steps.map((step) => (
            <Button
              key={step.name}
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="w-full justify-start"
              title={step.description}
              onClick={() => {
                addNode("step", step.name, step.title);
              }}
            >
              <PlusIcon />
              <span className="truncate">{step.title}</span>
            </Button>
          ))}
          {(
            [
              ["sleep", t("Wait")],
              ["approval", t("Approval")],
              ["condition", t("Condition")],
            ] as const
          ).map(([kind, label]) => (
            <Button
              key={kind}
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="w-full justify-start"
              onClick={() => {
                addNode(kind, undefined, label);
              }}
            >
              <PlusIcon />
              {label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <div
          className="h-150 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30"
          data-testid="workflow-canvas"
        >
          <ReactFlow
            nodes={shown}
            edges={edges}
            nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
            onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
            onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
            onConnect={onConnect}
            onNodeClick={(_, node) => {
              setSelected(node.id);
            }}
            onPaneClick={() => {
              setSelected(null);
            }}
            fitView
          >
            <Background />
            <Controls />
          </ReactFlow>
        </div>
        {selectedNode ? (
          <NodePanel
            key={selectedNode.id}
            node={selectedNode}
            steps={detail.steps}
            credentials={detail.credentials}
            canDecide={runOpen}
            onChange={(data) => {
              updateNode(selectedNode.id, data);
            }}
            onRemove={() => {
              removeNode(selectedNode.id);
            }}
            onDecide={(approved) => {
              if (runId === null) {
                return;
              }

              void decide.run({ run: runId, node: selectedNode.id, approved });
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Workflow runs

The latest workflow runs with their status, which update while a run is in progress. It calls `useWorkflowRuns` from `@/hooks/use-workflows`; the [workflows block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/workflows) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add workflows`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/workflow-runs.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge empty skeleton table
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-workflows
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/workflows/components/workflow-runs.tsx"
"use client";

import { WorkflowIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useWorkflowRuns } from "@/hooks/use-workflows";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

import { statusVariant, workflowName } from "../workflow-labels";

/**
 * The organization's runs from the workflows block, loaded again when a run
 * changes status (`workflow-runs:<tenant>`).
 */
export function WorkflowRuns({ tenant }: { tenant: string | null }) {
  const t = useExtracted("workflows");
  const format = useFormatter();

  const { runs, status } = useWorkflowRuns({
    tenant,
    schema: "api",
    limit: 50,
  });

  if (runs === undefined) {
    return <WorkflowRunsSkeleton />;
  }

  if (runs.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <WorkflowIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No runs yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t("Start a sample workflow to see its run here.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl border"
      data-testid="workflow-runs"
      data-status={status}
    >
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>{t("Workflow")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Started")}</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {runs.map((run) => (
            <TableRow key={run.id}>
              <TableCell>
                <Link href={`/workflows/${run.id}`} className="font-medium">
                  {workflowName(run.definition)}
                </Link>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <Badge variant={statusVariant(run.status)}>{run.status}</Badge>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {format.dateTime(new Date(run.createdAt.epochMilliseconds), {
                  dateStyle: "medium",
                  timeStyle: "short",
                })}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function WorkflowRunsSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2" aria-busy="true">
      {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => (
        <Skeleton key={index} className="h-11 w-full" />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Connector credentials

A sheet that stores a connector credential encrypted and revokes it, without reading the secret back. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [connectors](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/connectors), [credentials](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/credentials) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add connectors credentials`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/connector-setup.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button field input sheet
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/workflows/builder/components/credential-sheet.tsx"
"use client";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { KeySquareIcon, Trash2Icon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { CredentialRow } from "../builder-queries";

import { createCredential, revokeCredential } from "../builder-actions";

/**
 * The organization's Slack credentials: the token goes to Vault, the row keeps
 * a reference.
 */
export function CredentialSheet({
  credentials,
}: {
  credentials: readonly CredentialRow[];
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("workflows");
  const id = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const onError = (error: Parameters<typeof errorMessage>[0]) => {
    toast.error(errorMessage(error));
  };

  const create = useAction(createCredential, {
    onError,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Credential saved"));
    },
  });

  const revoke = useAction(revokeCredential, { onError });

  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" />}>
        <KeySquareIcon />
        {t("Credentials")}
      </SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent className="gap-6 p-6">
        <SheetHeader className="p-0">
          <SheetTitle>{t("Credentials")}</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            {t(
              "Slack bot tokens for the Post to Slack step. The token is stored in Vault and never shown again.",
            )}
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {credentials.map((credential) => (
            <li
              key={credential.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
            >
              <span className="truncate">{credential.name}</span>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                aria-label={t("Revoke")}
                disabled={revoke.pending}
                onClick={() => {
                  void revoke.run({ id: credential.id });
                }}
              >
                <Trash2Icon />
              </Button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <form
          className="space-y-3"
          action={(form) => {
            void create.run({
              name: String(form.get("name") ?? ""),
              secret: String(form.get("secret") ?? ""),
            });
          }}
        >
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-name`}>{t("Name")}</FieldLabel>
            <Input id={`${id}-name`} name="name" required maxLength={100} />
          </Field>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-secret`}>{t("Bot token")}</FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${id}-secret`}
              name="secret"
              type="password"
              required
              autoComplete="off"
              placeholder="xoxb-…"
            />
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={create.pending}>
            {t("Add credential")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

## Support session banner

A banner that tells the user a support agent is viewing the app as them, rendered on the server. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [impersonation block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/impersonation) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add impersonation`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/support-session-banner.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/user/components/impersonation-banner.tsx"
import { LifeBuoyIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted } from "next-intl/server";

import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert";

import { getSession } from "../user-queries";

/**
 * Shown during a support session (`bsb.startSupport`): staff see the app as the
 * user, and the audit log records who acted. Render inside `<Suspense>`.
 */
export async function ImpersonationBanner() {
  const [session, t] = await Promise.all([getSession(), getExtracted("user")]);

  if (session.kind !== "user" || !session.impersonator) {
    return null;
  }

  const { id, reason } = session.impersonator;

  return (
    <Alert variant="destructive" data-testid="impersonation">
      <LifeBuoyIcon />
      <AlertTitle>{t("Support session")}</AlertTitle>
      <AlertDescription>
        {reason
          ? t("Signed in by support ({id}): {reason}", { id, reason })
          : t("Signed in by support ({id}).", { id })}
      </AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  );
}
```

## AI task queue

A table of scheduled AI prompts with each task's next run and latest run status, plus pause and resume. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [ai-schedules block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/ai-schedules) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add ai-schedules`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/ai-task-queue.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/ai-tasks/components/ai-task-queue.tsx"
"use client";

import type { AiTaskRunStatus } from "better-supabase/blocks/ai-schedules";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { CalendarClockIcon, PauseIcon, PlayIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useRouter } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { AiTaskRow, AiTasksRead } from "../ai-task-queries";

import { scheduleSampleTask, setAiTaskEnabled } from "../ai-task-actions";

function RunStatusBadge({ status }: { status: AiTaskRunStatus | undefined }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiTasks");

  switch (status) {
    case undefined: {
      return <Badge variant="outline">{t("Not run yet")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "queued": {
      return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Queued")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "running": {
      return <Badge variant="primary-light">{t("Running")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "completed": {
      return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Completed")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "failed": {
      return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Failed")}</Badge>;
    }

    default: {
      const unknown: never = status;

      return unknown;
    }
  }
}

function ScheduleSampleButton({ variant }: { variant: "default" | "outline" }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiTasks");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const schedule = useAction(scheduleSampleTask, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      size="sm"
      variant={variant}
      disabled={schedule.pending}
      onClick={() => {
        void schedule.run({});
      }}
    >
      <CalendarClockIcon />
      {t("Schedule a sample task")}
    </Button>
  );
}

function TaskRows({ tasks }: { tasks: readonly AiTaskRow[] }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiTasks");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const toggle = useAction(setAiTaskEnabled, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const when = (iso: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

  return (
    <Table data-testid="ai-schedules">
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>{t("Task")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
            {t("Schedule")}
          </TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("Next run")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("Last run")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
          </TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {tasks.map((task) => (
          <TableRow key={task.id}>
            <TableCell className="max-w-72">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="truncate font-medium">{task.title}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {task.prompt}
                </span>
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="hidden md:table-cell">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs">{task.cron}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {task.timezone}
                </span>
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">
              {task.enabled ? (
                task.nextRunAt ? (
                  when(task.nextRunAt)
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("On the next tick")}
                  </span>
                )
              ) : (
                <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Paused")}</Badge>
              )}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-0.5">
                <RunStatusBadge status={task.lastRun?.status} />
                {task.lastRun?.error ? (
                  <span className="max-w-48 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {task.lastRun.error}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon-sm"
                disabled={toggle.pendingInputs.some(
                  (input) => input.id === task.id,
                )}
                aria-label={
                  task.enabled
                    ? t("Pause {title}", { title: task.title })
                    : t("Resume {title}", { title: task.title })
                }
                onClick={() => {
                  void toggle.run({ id: task.id, enabled: !task.enabled });
                }}
              >
                {task.enabled ? <PauseIcon /> : <PlayIcon />}
              </Button>
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

/**
 * The caller's scheduled AI tasks, read on the server through `aiTasks.list`,
 * with each task's next occurrence and its latest run. An admin with `ai.admin`
 * sees every task in the organization.
 */
export function AiTaskQueue({ read }: { read: AiTasksRead }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiTasks");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [retrying, startRetry] = useTransition();
  const hasTasks = read.ok && read.tasks.length > 0;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="ai-task-queue">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Scheduled tasks")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Prompts the assistant runs on a cron, with the status of each task's latest run.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        {hasTasks ? (
          <CardAction>
            <ScheduleSampleButton variant="outline" />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {read.ok ? (
          read.tasks.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border" data-testid="ai-tasks-empty">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <CalendarClockIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No tasks scheduled")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t(
                    "Schedule a prompt to run every weekday at 9:00, then watch its runs here.",
                  )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                <ScheduleSampleButton variant="default" />
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <TaskRows tasks={read.tasks} />
          )
        ) : (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertTitle>{t("The tasks didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{errorMessage(read.error)}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={retrying}
                onClick={() => {
                  startRetry(() => {
                    router.refresh();
                  });
                }}
              >
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

const SKELETON_ROWS = ["first", "second", "third"];

export function AiTaskQueueSkeleton() {
  return (
    <Card aria-busy="true">
      <CardHeader>
        <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
        <Skeleton className="h-4 w-72" />
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {SKELETON_ROWS.map((row) => (
          <Skeleton key={row} className="h-11 w-full" />
        ))}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/ai-provider-settings.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert alert-dialog badge button card dialog empty field input select skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/ai-providers/components/ai-provider-settings.tsx"
"use client";

import type { SubmitEvent } from "react";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { CpuIcon, PlusIcon, Trash2Icon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";

  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";

import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

  Table,

  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { useRouter } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { Provider } from "../ai-provider-options";
import type { ProviderKeyRow, ProviderKeysRead } from "../ai-provider-queries";

import { addProviderKey, removeProviderKey } from "../ai-provider-actions";
import { PROVIDERS } from "../ai-provider-options";

const PROVIDER_LABELS = {
  anthropic: "Anthropic",
  openai: "OpenAI",
  google: "Google",
  mistral: "Mistral",
} satisfies Record<Provider, string>;

const labelOf = (provider: string): string => {
  const known = PROVIDERS.find((slug) => slug === provider);

  return known ? PROVIDER_LABELS[known] : provider;
};

function AddProviderKeyDialog({ variant }: { variant: "default" | "outline" }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiProviders");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<Provider>("anthropic");
  const [model, setModel] = useState("");
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState("");

  const add = useAction(addProviderKey, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      setOpen(false);
      toast.success(t("Key saved"));
    },
  });

  const message = add.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(add.error);

  const items = PROVIDERS.map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: PROVIDER_LABELS[value],
  }));

  const submit = (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = model.trim();

    void add.run(
      trimmed ? { provider, apiKey, model: trimmed } : { provider, apiKey },
    );
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        setModel("");
        setApiKey("");
        add.reset();
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant={variant} />}>
        <PlusIcon />
        {t("Add a key")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("Add a provider key")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
```
