```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/ai-providers/components/ai-provider-settings.tsx"
              {t(
                "The key goes to Vault under this organization. Requests then bill the organization's own provider account.",
              )}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-provider`}>
                {t("Provider")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={provider}
                items={items}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  const picked = PROVIDERS.find((known) => known === value);

                  if (picked) {
                    setProvider(picked);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-provider`} className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {items.map((item) => (
                    <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                      {item.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-model`}>{t("Model")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-model`}
                value={model}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setModel(event.target.value);
                }}
                maxLength={120}
                placeholder="claude-sonnet-4.5"
              />
              <FieldDescription>
                {t("Optional. Leave it empty to use the app's default model.")}
              </FieldDescription>
            </Field>
            <Field data-invalid={message ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-api-key`}>
                {t("API key")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-api-key`}
                type="password"
                autoComplete="off"
                value={apiKey}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setApiKey(event.target.value);
                }}
                required
                minLength={8}
                maxLength={500}
              />
              {message ? <FieldError>{message}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={add.pending}>
              {t("Save key")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function RemoveKeyButton({ providerKey }: { providerKey: ProviderKeyRow }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiProviders");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const label = labelOf(providerKey.provider);

  const remove = useAction(removeProviderKey, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger
        render={
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon-sm"
            aria-label={t("Remove the {provider} key", { provider: label })}
          />
        }
      >
        <Trash2Icon />
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>
            {t("Remove the {provider} key?", { provider: label })}
          </AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            {t(
              "Its secret is revoked in Vault, and requests fall back to the app's own key.",
            )}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel disabled={remove.pending}>
            {t("Cancel")}
          </AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={remove.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              void remove.run({ id: providerKey.id });
            }}
          >
            {t("Remove")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

function ProviderRows({ keys }: { keys: readonly ProviderKeyRow[] }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiProviders");
  const format = useFormatter();

  return (
    <Table data-testid="ai-provider-keys">
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>{t("Provider")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("Model")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">{t("Updated")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>
            <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
          </TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {keys.map((key) => (
          <TableRow key={key.id}>
            <TableCell>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="font-medium">{labelOf(key.provider)}</span>
                {key.name === "default" ? null : (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {key.name}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              {key.model ? (
                <span className="font-mono text-xs">{key.model}</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("App default")}
                </span>
              )}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              {key.enabled ? (
                <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Enabled")}</Badge>
              ) : (
                <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Disabled")}</Badge>
              )}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="hidden whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground tabular-nums md:table-cell">
              {format.dateTime(new Date(key.updatedAt), {
                dateStyle: "medium",
              })}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              <RemoveKeyButton providerKey={key} />
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

/**
 * The organization's own model provider keys (bring your own key), read on the
 * server through `aiProviders.keys.list`, with the model each one calls. Saving
 * a key stores it in Vault first; the row only names it.
 */
export function AiProviderSettings({ read }: { read: ProviderKeysRead }) {
  const t = useExtracted("aiProviders");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [retrying, startRetry] = useTransition();
  const hasKeys = read.ok && read.keys.length > 0;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="ai-provider-settings">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("AI providers")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "The organization's own provider keys, used instead of the app's key for the assistant.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        {hasKeys ? (
          <CardAction>
            <AddProviderKeyDialog variant="outline" />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {read.ok ? (
          read.keys.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border" data-testid="ai-providers-empty">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <CpuIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No provider keys yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t(
                    "The assistant uses the app's key until you add one for a provider.",
                  )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                <AddProviderKeyDialog variant="default" />
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <ProviderRows keys={read.keys} />
          )
        ) : (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertTitle>{t("The providers didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{errorMessage(read.error)}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={retrying}
                onClick={() => {
                  startRetry(() => {
                    router.refresh();
                  });
                }}
              >
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

const SKELETON_ROWS = ["first", "second"];

/** Keeps the card's title in the static shell, so the tab commits it at once. */
export function AiProviderSettingsSkeleton() {
  const t = useExtracted("aiProviders");

  return (
    <Card aria-busy="true">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("AI providers")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "The organization's own provider keys, used instead of the app's key for the assistant.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {SKELETON_ROWS.map((row) => (
          <Skeleton key={row} className="h-11 w-full" />
        ))}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Push opt-in

A card that registers this browser for web push and removes it again. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [push block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/push) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add push`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/push-opt-in.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/push/components/push-opt-in.tsx"
"use client";

import { createPush, rpcTransport } from "better-supabase/blocks/push";
import { webPushToken } from "better-supabase/client";
import { BellOffIcon, BellRingIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useSupabase } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

/**
 * The worker in `public/` that shows the pushes; it must be served from the
 * site root.
 */
const WORKER_URL = "/push-sw.js";
const PUSH_GUIDE = "https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/push";

const VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY;

type PushState =
  | { readonly kind: "checking" }
  | { readonly kind: "unsupported" }
  | { readonly kind: "unconfigured" }
  | { readonly kind: "denied" }
  | { readonly kind: "off" }
  | { readonly kind: "on"; readonly token: string }
  | { readonly kind: "error" };

function supportsPush(): boolean {
  return (
    "serviceWorker" in navigator &&
    "PushManager" in window &&
    "Notification" in window
  );
}

/** What the browser already has, without asking the user anything. */
async function currentState(): Promise<PushState> {
  if (!supportsPush()) {
    return { kind: "unsupported" };
  }

  if (!VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY) {
    return { kind: "unconfigured" };
  }

  if (Notification.permission === "denied") {
    return { kind: "denied" };
  }

  const registration =
    await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration(WORKER_URL);

  const subscription = await registration?.pushManager.getSubscription();

  return subscription
    ? { kind: "on", token: JSON.stringify(subscription) }
    : { kind: "off" };
}

/**
 * Asks for web push permission and stores this browser's push subscription as
 * one of the caller's devices in the push module (`register_push_device`), or
 * removes it again. The device row belongs to the signed-in user, so a sender
 * can reach every browser they turned on.
 */
export function PushOptIn() {
  const t = useExtracted("push");
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const [state, setState] = useState<PushState>({ kind: "checking" });
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const devices = createPush({
    transport: rpcTransport(supabase),
    schema: blockConfig.push.api,
  });

  const read = () => {
    currentState().then(setState, () => {
      setState({ kind: "error" });
    });
  };

  const check = () => {
    setState({ kind: "checking" });
    read();
  };

  useEffect(read, []);

  const turnOn = () => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      if (!VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        await navigator.serviceWorker.register(WORKER_URL);

        const token = await webPushToken({
          vapidPublicKey: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY,
        }).token();

        if (token === null) {
          setState(
            Notification.permission === "denied"
              ? { kind: "denied" }
              : { kind: "off" },
          );

          return;
        }

        const saved = await devices.register({
          token,
          platform: "web",
          provider: "webpush",
        });

        setState(saved.ok ? { kind: "on", token } : { kind: "error" });
      } catch {
        setState({ kind: "error" });
      }
    });
  };

  const turnOff = (token: string) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const removed = await devices.unregister(token);

      if (!removed.ok) {
        setState({ kind: "error" });

        return;
      }

      const registration =
        await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration(WORKER_URL);

      await (await registration?.pushManager.getSubscription())?.unsubscribe();
      setState({ kind: "off" });
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card data-testid="push-opt-in" data-recipe="push-opt-in">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Push notifications")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Get a notification on this device when something needs you.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {state.kind === "on" ? (
          <CardAction>
            <Badge variant="success-light">{t("On")}</Badge>
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <PushStateBody
          state={state}
          pending={pending}
          onTurnOn={turnOn}
          onTurnOff={turnOff}
          onRetry={check}
        />
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function PushStateBody({
  state,
  pending,
  onTurnOn,
  onTurnOff,
  onRetry,
}: {
  state: PushState;
  pending: boolean;
  onTurnOn: () => void;
  onTurnOff: (token: string) => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("push");

  switch (state.kind) {
    case "checking": {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3" aria-busy="true">
          <Skeleton className="h-4 flex-1" />
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-24" />
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "unsupported": {
      return (
        <Empty className="border">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <BellOffIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("This browser has no push support")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t(
                "Open the app in a browser that supports web push, or install it to your home screen on iOS.",
              )}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyContent>
            <a
              href={PUSH_GUIDE}
              className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
            >
              {t("Read the push guide")}
            </a>
          </EmptyContent>
        </Empty>
      );
    }

    case "unconfigured": {
      return (
        <Empty className="border">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <BellOffIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("Push isn't set up yet")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t(
                "Set NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY to your VAPID public key to turn on web push.",
              )}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyContent>
            <a
              href={PUSH_GUIDE}
              className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
            >
              {t("Read the push guide")}
            </a>
          </EmptyContent>
        </Empty>
      );
    }

    case "denied": {
      return (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {t(
            "Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload the page.",
          )}
        </p>
      );
    }

    case "off": {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("Your browser asks for permission first.")}
          </p>
          <Button onClick={onTurnOn} disabled={pending}>
            <BellRingIcon />
            {t("Turn on")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "on": {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("This browser gets your push notifications.")}
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              onTurnOff(state.token);
            }}
            disabled={pending}
          >
            {t("Turn off")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "error": {
      return (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <TriangleAlertIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{t("Push couldn't be updated")}</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>
            {t("Check your connection and try again.")}
          </AlertDescription>
          <AlertAction>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRetry}>
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </AlertAction>
        </Alert>
      );
    }

    default: {
      const unknown: never = state;

      return unknown;
    }
  }
}
```

## Metrics dashboard

A card per metric: the 30-day total against the 30 days before, with daily bars. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [metrics block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/metrics) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add metrics`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/metrics-dashboard.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/metrics/components/metrics-dashboard.tsx"
import { toChartData } from "better-supabase/blocks/metrics";
import { tenantOf } from "better-supabase/next";
import { ChartColumnIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";
import { unstable_rethrow } from "next/navigation";
import { Temporal } from "temporal-polyfill";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { getSession } from "@/features/user/user-queries";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { bsb } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { metrics } from "@/metrics";

const DAYS = 30;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

type MetricKey = (typeof metrics)[number]["key"];

interface MetricPanel {
  readonly key: MetricKey;
  readonly kpi: Kpi;
  readonly rows: readonly MetricChartRow[];
}

type Dashboard =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly panels: readonly MetricPanel[] }
  | { readonly kind: "error" };

/**
 * Every metric in `src/metrics.ts` over the last 30 days: the total against the
 * 30 days before, and one point per day. Cached per session; the metrics module
 * checks `metrics.read` on each read. It throws on a failed read, so a failure
 * is never cached and Retry reads again.
 */
async function loadPanels(
  organizationId: string,
): Promise<readonly MetricPanel[]> {
  "use cache: private";
  const { db } = await bsb.cached();
  const until = Temporal.Now.instant();

  const range = {
    from: until.subtract({ milliseconds: DAYS * DAY_MS }),
    until,
  };

  const client = db.metrics;

  return Promise.all(
    metrics.map(async ({ key }) => {
      const [kpi, series] = await Promise.all([
        client
          .kpi(key, range, { organizationId, compare: "previous" })
          .orThrow(),
        client.series(key, range, { organizationId, grain: "day" }).orThrow(),
      ]);

      return { key, kpi, rows: toChartData(series) };
    }),
  );
}

async function loadDashboard(organizationId: string): Promise<Dashboard> {
  try {
    return { kind: "ok", panels: await loadPanels(organizationId) };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: a card per defined metric, with its daily bars. */
export async function MetricsDashboard() {
  const organizationId = tenantOf(await getSession());

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  const [dashboard, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    loadDashboard(organizationId),
    getExtracted("metrics"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (dashboard.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The metrics didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (dashboard.panels.every((panel) => (panel.kpi.value ?? 0) === 0)) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <ChartColumnIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No data in the last 30 days")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t("Add a customer and its metric shows up here.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyContent>
          <Link href="/customers" className={buttonVariants()}>
            {t("Add a customer")}
          </Link>
        </EmptyContent>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const labels: Record<MetricKey, string> = { customers: t("New customers") };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2" data-testid="metrics-dashboard">
      {dashboard.panels.map((panel) => {
        const { change, trend, value, previous } = panel.kpi;
        const max = Math.max(1, ...panel.rows.map((row) => row.value ?? 0));

        return (
          <Card key={panel.key}>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{labels[panel.key]}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                {t("{previous} in the 30 days before", {
                  previous: format.number(previous ?? 0),
                })}
              </CardDescription>
              {change === null || change === undefined ? null : (
                <CardAction>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      trend === "up"
                        ? "success-light"
                        : trend === "down"
                          ? "destructive-light"
                          : "secondary"
                    }
                  >
                    {format.number(change, {
                      style: "percent",
                      signDisplay: "exceptZero",
                    })}
                  </Badge>
                </CardAction>
              )}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <span className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums">
                {format.number(value ?? 0)}
              </span>
              <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-24 items-end gap-0.5">
                {panel.rows.map((row) => (
                  <div
                    key={row.date}
                    title={`${format.dateTime(new Date(row.date), { dateStyle: "medium" })}: ${format.number(row.value ?? 0)}`}
                    className="h-full flex-1 origin-bottom scale-y-(--bar) bg-primary/80"
                    // SAFETY: React's CSSProperties has no custom properties; --bar is a number.
                    style={{ "--bar": (row.value ?? 0) / max } as CSSProperties}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export function MetricsDashboardSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2" aria-busy="true">
      {metrics.map(({ key }) => (
        <Skeleton key={key} className="h-64 rounded-xl" />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Feature flags

Which feature flags are on for the active organization, read-only. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [flags block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/flags) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add flags`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/feature-flag-toggles.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/flags/components/feature-flag-list.tsx"
import { tenantOf } from "better-supabase/next";
import { TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";
import { unstable_rethrow } from "next/navigation";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { bsb } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/** The flags `src/flags.ts` defines. */
const FLAG_KEYS = ["beta-page", "pricing-banner"] as const;

type FlagKey = (typeof FLAG_KEYS)[number];

interface FlagValue {
  readonly key: FlagKey;
  readonly on: boolean;
}

type FlagValues =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly flags: readonly FlagValue[] }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "no-organization" };

/**
 * Each flag as `flag_enabled` answers it for the active organization, with its
 * rules and overrides. Changing a flag is for platform staff (`flags.manage`),
 * so the list only reads. A failed read throws, so it is never cached and Retry
 * reads again.
 */
async function loadFlags(): Promise<readonly FlagValue[] | null> {
  "use cache: private";
  const { session, db } = await bsb.cached();
  const tenant = tenantOf(session);

  if (!tenant) {
    return null;
  }

  return Promise.all(
    FLAG_KEYS.map(async (key) => ({
      key,
      on: (await db.$api("flag_enabled", { key, tenant })) === true,
    })),
  );
}

async function loadFlagValues(): Promise<FlagValues> {
  try {
    const flags = await loadFlags();

    return flags ? { kind: "ok", flags } : { kind: "no-organization" };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: the flags that are on for this organization. */
export async function FeatureFlagList() {
  const [values, t] = await Promise.all([
    loadFlagValues(),
    getExtracted("flags"),
  ]);

  if (values.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const labels: Record<FlagKey, string> = {
    "beta-page": t("The beta page and its menu entry"),
    "pricing-banner": t("The upgrade banner on the pricing page"),
  };

  return (
    <Card data-testid="flags" data-recipe="feature-flag-toggles">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Feature flags")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "What's turned on for this organization. Support changes these for you.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {values.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The flags didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
            {values.flags.map((flag) => (
              <li
                key={flag.key}
                data-testid={`feature-flag-${flag.key}`}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm">{flag.key}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {labels[flag.key]}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {flag.on ? (
                  <Badge variant="success-light">{t("On")}</Badge>
                ) : (
                  <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Off")}</Badge>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function FeatureFlagListSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Rule builder

A condition tree with field, operator and value rows, nested And and Or groups, drag to reorder and a fixed first condition, saved as a versioned rule. It calls `useRuleBuilder` from `@/hooks/use-automations`; the [automations block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/automations) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add automations`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/rule-builder.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert button card empty field input label select skeleton switch
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-automations
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/rules/components/rule-builder.tsx"
"use client";

import type { DragEndEvent } from "@dnd-kit/core";
import type { RuleField } from "better-supabase/blocks/automations";
import type {
  FilterCombinator,
  FilterGroupNode,
  FilterNode,
  FilterQuery,
  FilterRule,
} from "better-supabase/list";
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";

import {
  closestCenter,
  DndContext,
  KeyboardSensor,
  PointerSensor,
  useSensor,
  useSensors,
} from "@dnd-kit/core";
import {
  SortableContext,
  sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
  useSortable,
  verticalListSortingStrategy,
} from "@dnd-kit/sortable";
import { CSS } from "@dnd-kit/utilities";
import { contains, ruleOperators } from "better-supabase/blocks/automations";
import { FILTER_OPERATOR_LABELS } from "better-supabase/list";
import {
  GripVerticalIcon,
  ListFilterIcon,
  LockIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  TriangleAlertIcon,
  XIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { createContext, use, useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import * as v from "valibot";

import type { RuleBuilderState } from "@/hooks/use-automations";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Field, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useStatusLabel } from "@/features/customers/use-status-label";
import { useRuleBuilder } from "@/hooks/use-automations";
import { useRouter } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import {
  initialConditions,
  LOCKED_CONDITION,
  RULE_SUBJECT,
  RULE_TRIGGER,
} from "../rule-fields";
import { rulesChanged } from "../rules-actions";

const LOCKED = [LOCKED_CONDITION];

/** Groups nest at most this deep, below the `RULE_LIMITS` depth of 6. */
const MAX_GROUP_DEPTH = 3;

interface Editor {
  readonly builder: RuleBuilderState;
  readonly fields: ReadonlyMap<string, RuleField>;
  /** The first problem the check found on each node, by node id. */
  readonly issues: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  readonly readOnly: boolean;
}

const EditorContext = createContext<Editor | null>(null);

function useEditor(): Editor {
  const editor = use(EditorContext);

  if (!editor) {
    throw new Error("Render rule editor parts inside <RuleBuilder>");
  }

  return editor;
}

/** The node an issue path such as `["filter", "rules", 1, "value"]` names. */
function nodeAt(
  tree: FilterQuery,
  path: readonly PropertyKey[] | undefined,
): string {
  let node: FilterNode = tree;

  for (let index = 1; index < (path?.length ?? 0); index += 1) {
    const position = path?.[index + 1];

    if (
      path?.[index] !== "rules" ||
      node.type !== "group" ||
      !Number.isInteger(position)
    ) {
      break;
    }

    const child: FilterNode | undefined = node.rules[Number(position)];

    if (child === undefined) {
      break;
    }

    node = child;
    index += 1;
  }

  return node.id;
}

/**
 * The "When" editor of one customer rule: conditions on the catalog fields in
 * nested And/Or groups, reordered by their handles, with the first condition
 * locked. Saves through the browser client as the signed-in user.
 */
export function RuleBuilder({
  organizationId,
  rule,
  canEdit,
  canPublish,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  /** The rule to edit; `null` starts a new one. */
  rule: string | null;
  canEdit: boolean;
  canPublish: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const router = useRouter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const nameId = useId();
  const enabledId = useId();
  const [enabledEdit, setEnabledEdit] = useState<boolean | undefined>();

  const builder = useRuleBuilder({
    organizationId,
    rule,
    subjectType: RULE_SUBJECT,
    trigger: RULE_TRIGGER,
    initial: initialConditions,
    locked: LOCKED,
    schema: blockConfig.automations.api,
  });

  const enabled = enabledEdit ?? builder.rule?.enabled ?? false;

  const fields = useMemo(
    () => new Map((builder.fields ?? []).map((field) => [field.id, field])),
    [builder.fields],
  );

  const issues = useMemo(() => {
    const byNode = new Map<string, string>();

    for (const issue of builder.issues) {
      const id = nodeAt(builder.conditions, issue.path);

      if (!byNode.has(id)) {
        byNode.set(id, issue.message);
      }
    }

    return byNode;
  }, [builder.issues, builder.conditions]);

  const editor = useMemo(
    () => ({ builder, fields, issues, readOnly: !canEdit }),
    [builder, fields, issues, canEdit],
  );

  if (builder.fields === undefined) {
    return builder.error ? (
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The rule didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{errorMessage(builder.error)}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              void builder.refresh();
            }}
          >
            {t("Retry")}
          </Button>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    ) : (
      <RuleBuilderSkeleton />
    );
  }

  const enabledChanged =
    enabledEdit !== undefined && enabledEdit !== builder.rule?.enabled;

  const save = async () => {
    const saved = await builder.save(
      enabledChanged ? { enabled: enabledEdit } : {},
    );

    if (saved === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    setEnabledEdit(undefined);
    await rulesChanged({});

    if (rule === null) {
      router.replace(`/rules/${saved.id}`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <EditorContext value={editor}>
      <Card data-recipe="rule-builder">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("When a lead is saved")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "The rule matches when its conditions hold for the saved customer.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={nameId}>{t("Name")}</FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={nameId}
              value={builder.name}
              maxLength={200}
              disabled={!canEdit}
              placeholder={t("Follow up on large leads")}
              onChange={(event) => {
                builder.setName(event.target.value);
              }}
            />
          </Field>
          {builder.conditions.rules.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyConditions />
          ) : (
            <GroupEditor group={builder.conditions} depth={1} />
          )}
          {builder.error ? (
            <Alert variant="destructive" aria-live="polite">
              <TriangleAlertIcon />
              <AlertTitle>{t("The rule wasn't saved")}</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription>{errorMessage(builder.error)}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          ) : null}
        </CardContent>
        {canEdit ? (
          <CardFooter className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Switch
                id={enabledId}
                checked={enabled}
                disabled={!canPublish || builder.saving}
                onCheckedChange={setEnabledEdit}
              />
              <Label htmlFor={enabledId} className="text-sm font-normal">
                {canPublish
                  ? t("Enabled")
                  : t("Enabled (needs publish rights)")}
              </Label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={(!builder.dirty && !enabledChanged) || builder.saving}
                onClick={() => {
                  builder.reset();
                  setEnabledEdit(undefined);
                }}
              >
                {t("Discard")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                data-testid="save-rule"
                disabled={
                  builder.saving ||
                  builder.name.trim() === "" ||
                  builder.issues.length > 0 ||
                  (!builder.dirty && !enabledChanged)
                }
                onClick={() => {
                  void save();
                }}
              >
                {builder.saving ? t("Saving") : t("Save rule")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardFooter>
        ) : null}
      </Card>
    </EditorContext>
  );
}

function EmptyConditions() {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder, readOnly } = useEditor();

  return (
    <Empty className="border">
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
          <ListFilterIcon />
        </EmptyMedia>
        <EmptyTitle>{t("No conditions")}</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>
          {t("Without conditions the rule matches every saved customer.")}
        </EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
      {readOnly ? null : (
        <EmptyContent>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              builder.addRule(undefined, builder.fields?.[0]?.id);
            }}
          >
            <PlusIcon />
            {t("Add condition")}
          </Button>
        </EmptyContent>
      )}
    </Empty>
  );
}

function GroupEditor({
  group,
  depth,
}: {
  group: FilterGroupNode;
  depth: number;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder, readOnly } = useEditor();
  const locked = new Set(builder.locked);

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor, { activationConstraint: { distance: 4 } }),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
    }),
  );

  const onDragEnd = ({ active, over }: DragEndEvent) => {
    if (!over || active.id === over.id || locked.has(String(over.id))) {
      return;
    }

    const index = group.rules.findIndex((child) => child.id === over.id);

    if (index !== -1) {
      builder.move(String(active.id), group.id, index);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <DndContext
        sensors={sensors}
        collisionDetection={closestCenter}
        onDragEnd={onDragEnd}
      >
        <SortableContext
          items={group.rules.map((child) => child.id)}
          strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
        >
          <ol className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {group.rules.map((child, index) => (
              <SortableNode
                key={child.id}
                node={child}
                disabled={readOnly || locked.has(child.id)}
              >
                <Connective group={group} index={index} />
                {child.type === "rule" ? (
                  <ConditionRow rule={child} />
                ) : (
                  <NestedGroup group={child} depth={depth + 1} />
                )}
              </SortableNode>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </SortableContext>
      </DndContext>
      {readOnly ? null : (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              builder.addRule(group.id, builder.fields?.[0]?.id);
            }}
          >
            <PlusIcon />
            {t("Add condition")}
          </Button>
          {depth < MAX_GROUP_DEPTH ? (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => {
                const added = builder.addGroup(
                  group.id,
                  group.combinator === "and" ? "or" : "and",
                );

                builder.addRule(added, builder.fields?.[0]?.id);
              }}
            >
              <PlusIcon />
              {t("Add group")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SortableNode({
  node,
  disabled,
  children,
}: {
  node: FilterNode;
  disabled: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder } = useEditor();
  const locked = builder.locked.includes(node.id);

  const {
    attributes,
    listeners,
    setNodeRef,
    setActivatorNodeRef,
    transform,
    isDragging,
  } = useSortable({ id: node.id, disabled });

  // SAFETY: React's CSSProperties has no custom properties; it is a CSS transform.
  const style = {
    "--drag-transform": CSS.Transform.toString(transform) ?? "none",
  } as CSSProperties;

  return (
    <li
      ref={setNodeRef}
      style={style}
      data-dragging={isDragging || undefined}
      className="flex [transform:var(--drag-transform)] items-start gap-2 transition-transform duration-200 data-dragging:opacity-60 data-dragging:transition-none motion-reduce:transition-none"
    >
      {locked ? (
        <span
          className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"
          title={t("This condition is fixed")}
        >
          <LockIcon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          <span className="sr-only">{t("This condition is fixed")}</span>
        </span>
      ) : (
        <Button
          ref={setActivatorNodeRef}
          type="button"
          size="icon-sm"
          variant="ghost"
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label={t("Reorder")}
          className="cursor-grab"
          {...attributes}
          {...listeners}
        >
          <GripVerticalIcon />
        </Button>
      )}
      {children}
    </li>
  );
}

/** "Where" before the first child; the group's And or Or before the rest. */
function Connective({
  group,
  index,
}: {
  group: FilterGroupNode;
  index: number;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder, readOnly } = useEditor();

  const label = (combinator: FilterCombinator) =>
    combinator === "and" ? t("And") : t("Or");

  if (index === 0) {
    return (
      <span className="flex h-8 w-20 shrink-0 items-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {t("Where")}
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (index > 1 || readOnly) {
    return (
      <span className="flex h-8 w-20 shrink-0 items-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {label(group.combinator)}
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Select
      value={group.combinator}
      items={[
        { value: "and", label: label("and") },
        { value: "or", label: label("or") },
      ]}
      onValueChange={(value) => {
        if (value === "and" || value === "or") {
          builder.setCombinator(group.id, value);
        }
      }}
    >
      <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-20" aria-label={t("Combine with")}>
        <SelectValue />
      </SelectTrigger>
      <SelectContent>
        <SelectItem value="and">{label("and")}</SelectItem>
        <SelectItem value="or">{label("or")}</SelectItem>
      </SelectContent>
    </Select>
  );
}

function NestedGroup({
  group,
  depth,
}: {
  group: FilterGroupNode;
  depth: number;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder, readOnly } = useEditor();

  const removable =
    !readOnly && !builder.locked.some((id) => contains(group, id));

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-2 border-l-2 pl-3">
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <GroupEditor group={group} depth={depth} />
      </div>
      {removable ? (
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="icon-sm"
          variant="ghost"
          aria-label={t("Remove group")}
          onClick={() => {
            builder.remove(group.id);
          }}
        >
          <XIcon />
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function useFieldLabel(): (field: RuleField) => string {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");

  return (field) => {
    switch (field.id) {
      case "status": {
        return t("Status");
      }

      case "name": {
        return t("Name");
      }

      case "kvk": {
        return t("KvK number");
      }

      case "createdAt": {
        return t("Created");
      }

      default: {
        return field.label;
      }
    }
  };
}

function useOperatorLabel(): (operator: string) => string {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");

  return (operator) => {
    switch (operator) {
      case "is": {
        return t("is");
      }

      case "is_not": {
        return t("is not");
      }

      case "contains": {
        return t("contains");
      }

      case "not_contains": {
        return t("does not contain");
      }

      case "starts_with": {
        return t("starts with");
      }

      case "empty": {
        return t("is empty");
      }

      case "not_empty": {
        return t("is not empty");
      }

      case "is_before": {
        return t("is before");
      }

      case "is_after": {
        return t("is after");
      }

      default: {
        return FILTER_OPERATOR_LABELS[operator] ?? operator;
      }
    }
  };
}

function ConditionRow({ rule }: { rule: FilterRule }) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const { builder, fields, issues, readOnly } = useEditor();
  const fieldLabel = useFieldLabel();
  const operatorLabel = useOperatorLabel();
  const field = fields.get(rule.path.join("."));
  const operators = field ? ruleOperators(field) : [];
  const spec = operators.find((entry) => entry.value === rule.operator);
  const disabled = readOnly || builder.locked.includes(rule.id);
  const issue = issues.get(rule.id);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Select
          value={field?.id ?? null}
          disabled={disabled}
          items={(builder.fields ?? []).map((entry) => ({
            value: entry.id,
            label: fieldLabel(entry),
          }))}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            if (value !== null) {
              builder.setField(rule.id, value);
            }
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-40" aria-label={t("Field")}>
            <SelectValue placeholder={t("Field")} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {(builder.fields ?? []).map((entry) => (
              <SelectItem key={entry.id} value={entry.id}>
                {fieldLabel(entry)}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Select
          value={spec?.value ?? null}
          disabled={disabled || field === undefined}
          items={operators.map((entry) => ({
            value: entry.value,
            label: operatorLabel(entry.value),
          }))}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            if (value !== null) {
              builder.setOperator(rule.id, value);
            }
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-40" aria-label={t("Operator")}>
            <SelectValue placeholder={t("Operator")} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {operators.map((entry) => (
              <SelectItem key={entry.value} value={entry.value}>
                {operatorLabel(entry.value)}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        {field && spec?.arity === "one" ? (
          <ValueControl
            field={field}
            value={valueText(field, rule)}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(text) => {
              builder.setValue(rule.id, valueOf(field, text));
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
        {disabled ? null : (
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={t("Remove condition")}
            onClick={() => {
              builder.remove(rule.id);
            }}
          >
            <XIcon />
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {issue ? <FieldError>{issue}</FieldError> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

const Text = v.fallback(v.string(), "");

const NumberText = v.fallback(
  v.pipe(v.number(), v.finite(), v.transform(String)),
  "",
);

const BooleanText = v.fallback(
  v.pipe(
    v.union([v.boolean(), v.picklist(["true", "false"])]),
    v.transform(String),
  ),
  "",
);

const DayText = v.fallback(
  v.pipe(
    v.object({ date: v.string() }),
    v.transform((value) => value.date),
  ),
  "",
);

/** A condition's value as the text its control shows; `""` when unset. */
function valueText(field: RuleField, rule: FilterRule): string {
  switch (field.type) {
    case "number": {
      return v.parse(NumberText, rule.value);
    }

    case "date": {
      return v.parse(DayText, rule.value);
    }

    case "boolean": {
      return v.parse(BooleanText, rule.value);
    }

    case "text":
    case "select":
    case "multiselect":
    case "relation": {
      return v.parse(Text, rule.value);
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = field.type;

      return String(never);
    }
  }
}

/** The value a control's text stands for; `undefined` clears it. */
function valueOf(field: RuleField, text: string): FilterRule["value"] {
  if (text === "" && field.type !== "text") {
    return undefined;
  }

  switch (field.type) {
    case "number": {
      return Number(text);
    }

    case "date": {
      return { date: text };
    }

    case "text":
    case "boolean":
    case "select":
    case "multiselect":
    case "relation": {
      return text;
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = field.type;

      return String(never);
    }
  }
}

/** One value for the field's type: text, a number, a day or an option. */
function ValueControl({
  field,
  value,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  field: RuleField;
  value: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  onChange: (text: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("rules");
  const statusLabel = useStatusLabel();

  switch (field.type) {
    case "select":
    case "multiselect":
    case "relation":
    case "boolean": {
      const options =
        field.type === "boolean"
          ? [
              { value: "true", label: t("Yes") },
              { value: "false", label: t("No") },
            ]
          : (field.options ?? []).map((option) => ({
              value: option.value,
              label:
                field.id === "status"
                  ? statusLabel(option.value)
                  : option.label,
            }));

      return (
        <Select
          value={value === "" ? null : value}
          disabled={disabled}
          items={options}
          onValueChange={(next) => {
            if (next !== null) {
              onChange(next);
            }
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-40" aria-label={t("Value")}>
            <SelectValue placeholder={t("Value")} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {options.map((option) => (
              <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      );
    }

    case "number":
    case "date":
    case "text": {
      return (
        <Input
          type={field.type}
          className={field.type === "text" ? "w-48" : "w-40"}
          aria-label={t("Value")}
          disabled={disabled}
          value={value}
          onChange={(event) => {
            onChange(event.target.value);
          }}
        />
      );
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = field.type;

      return String(never);
    }
  }
}

export function RuleBuilderSkeleton() {
  return (
    <Card aria-busy="true">
      <CardHeader>
        <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
        <Skeleton className="h-4 w-72" />
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <Skeleton className="h-9 w-full" />
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-8 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Can

Shows an action only to members who hold a permission key; the checks of one render share one round trip. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [permissions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/permissions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add permissions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/can.

Web, with no shadcn components.

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-import-action.tsx"
"use client";

import { Can } from "@/hooks/use-permissions";
import { permissions } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

import { TaskImportDialog } from "./task-import-dialog";

/**
 * The import button, for members with `imports.manage` in the active
 * organization. The `<Can>` checks of one render share one `my_permissions`
 * call; the import action checks the key again on the server.
 */
export function TaskImportAction({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  return (
    <Can permission={permissions.imports.manage}>
      <TaskImportDialog projectId={projectId} />
    </Can>
  );
}
```

## Subject link

A link to any subject type, titled and routed by subject_titles, with plain text for a record the caller can't read. It calls `useSubject` from `@/hooks/use-subjects`; the [subjects block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/subjects) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add subjects`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/subject-link.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-subjects
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/subjects/components/subject-link.tsx"
"use client";

import type { RecordRef } from "better-supabase/blocks/subjects";

import { RotateCwIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useSubject } from "@/hooks/use-subjects";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

/**
 * A link to any subject in `config.records`, titled and routed by
 * `subject_titles`. The links rendered in one pass share one round trip, and a
 * subject the caller can't read shows as plain text.
 */
export function SubjectLink({ subject }: { subject: RecordRef }) {
  const t = useExtracted("subjects");
  const { subject: resolved, error, refresh } = useSubject(subject);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {t("The title didn't load")}
        <Button
          size="icon-xs"
          variant="ghost"
          aria-label={t("Retry")}
          onClick={() => {
            void refresh();
          }}
        >
          <RotateCwIcon />
        </Button>
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (resolved === undefined) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-4 w-32" />;
  }

  if (resolved === null) {
    return (
      <span className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {t("A record you can't open")}
      </span>
    );
  }

  const title = resolved.title ?? t("Untitled");

  return resolved.url === undefined ? (
    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{title}</span>
  ) : (
    <Link
      href={resolved.url}
      className="truncate text-sm font-medium underline-offset-4 transition-colors hover:underline"
    >
      {title}
    </Link>
  );
}
```

## Subject chip

A compact badge with a subject's type and title that links to its page. It calls `useSubject` from `@/hooks/use-subjects`; the [subjects block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/subjects) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add subjects`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/subject-chip.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/use-subjects
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/subjects/components/subject-chip.tsx"
"use client";

import type { RecordRef } from "better-supabase/blocks/subjects";

import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useSubject } from "@/hooks/use-subjects";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

/**
 * A compact badge for a subject: its type and title, linking to its page. Rows
 * that each render a chip share one `subject_titles` call.
 */
export function SubjectChip({ subject }: { subject: RecordRef }) {
  const t = useExtracted("subjects");
  const { subject: resolved, error } = useSubject(subject);

  if (resolved === undefined && !error) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-5 w-24" />;
  }

  const label = resolved?.title ?? t("Unavailable");

  const content = (
    <>
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{subject.type}</span>
      <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
    </>
  );

  return resolved?.url === undefined ? (
    <Badge variant="outline">{content}</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge
      variant="outline"
      className="transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
      render={<Link href={resolved.url} />}
    >
      {content}
    </Badge>
  );
}
```

## Sessions list

The caller's signed-in devices with the last activity and a button to end each session. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [sessions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/sessions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add sessions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/sessions-list.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert-dialog badge button card
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/sessions/components/sessions-list.tsx"
/**
 * The caller's signed-in session with its sign-in method and time, and the
 * sessions on other devices (`list_my_sessions`). Each one can be ended on its
 * own (`end_my_session`), or all of them at once (`signOut({ scope: "others"
 * })`).
 */
export function SessionsList({
  session,
  others,
}: {
  session: CurrentSession;
  others: readonly OtherSession[];
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("sessions");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const router = useRouter();
  const changeSession = useSessionChange(sessionChanged, router);
  const [othersOpen, setOthersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [endingOthers, startEndingOthers] = useTransition();
  const [endingThis, startEndingThis] = useTransition();

  const methodLabel = (method: string | null) => {
    switch (method) {
      case "password": {
        return t("Password");
      }

      case "otp":
      case "magiclink": {
        return t("Email link");
      }

      case "oauth": {
        return t("Social sign-in");
      }

      case "sso/saml": {
        return t("Single sign-on");
      }

      case "totp": {
        return t("Authenticator app");
      }

      case null: {
        return t("Unknown method");
      }

      default: {
        return method;
      }
    }
  };

  const signedIn = session.signedInAt
    ? format.dateTime(new Date(session.signedInAt), {
        dateStyle: "medium",
        timeStyle: "short",
      })
    : null;

  const endOthers = () => {
    startEndingOthers(async () => {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "others" });

      if (error) {
        toast.error(t("Signing out failed. Try again."));

        return;
      }

      setOthersOpen(false);
      toast.success(t("Signed out of your other devices"));
    });
  };

  const endThis = () => {
    startEndingThis(async () => {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "local" });

      if (error) {
        toast.error(t("Signing out failed. Try again."));

        return;
      }

      await changeSession("/login");
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="sessions-list">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Sessions")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "The devices you are signed in on. End a session if you lost the device or signed in somewhere you no longer use.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3">
          <MonitorSmartphoneIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="size-5 text-muted-foreground"
          />
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t("This device")}</span>
              <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active now")}</Badge>
              {session.aal === "aal2" ? (
                <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Two-factor")}</Badge>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {signedIn
                ? t("{method}, signed in {date}", {
                    date: signedIn,
                    method: methodLabel(session.method),
                  })
                : methodLabel(session.method)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            disabled={endingThis}
            onClick={endThis}
          >
            <LogOutIcon />
            {t("Sign out")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {others.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("You are not signed in on any other device.")}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {others.map((other) => (
              <OtherSessionRow key={other.id} session={other} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {others.length > 1 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("Other devices stay signed in until you end their sessions.")}
            </p>
            <AlertDialog
              open={othersOpen}
              onOpenChange={(open) => {
                if (!endingOthers) {
                  setOthersOpen(open);
                }
              }}
            >
              <AlertDialogTrigger
                render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" />}
              >
                {t("Sign out other devices")}
              </AlertDialogTrigger>
              <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogTitle>
                    {t("Sign out of your other devices?")}
                  </AlertDialogTitle>
                  <AlertDialogDescription>
                    {t(
                      "Every session except this one ends. Those devices have to sign in again.",
                    )}
                  </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                  <AlertDialogCancel disabled={endingOthers}>
                    {t("Cancel")}
                  </AlertDialogCancel>
                  <AlertDialogAction
                    type="button"
                    variant="destructive"
                    disabled={endingOthers}
                    onClick={endOthers}
                  >
                    {t("Sign out others")}
                  </AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
              </AlertDialogContent>
            </AlertDialog>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function OtherSessionRow({ session }: { session: OtherSession }) {
  const t = useExtracted("sessions");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const end = useAction(endSession, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Session ended"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const lastActive = format.dateTime(new Date(session.lastActiveAt), {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
  });

  return (
    <li className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3">
      <MonitorIcon
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-5 text-muted-foreground"
      />
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
        <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">
          {session.userAgent ?? t("Unknown device")}
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {session.ip
            ? t("Last active {date} from {ip}", {
                date: lastActive,
                ip: session.ip,
              })
            : t("Last active {date}", { date: lastActive })}
        </span>
      </div>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        disabled={end.pending}
        onClick={() => {
          void end.run({ id: session.id });
        }}
      >
        {t("End session")}
      </Button>
    </li>
  );
}
```

## SSO connection settings

The organization's SAML or OIDC connection with its domains and the role new members get. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [sso block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/sso) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add sso`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/sso-settings.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/sso/components/sso-settings.tsx"
/**
 * The organization's email domains (claimed with a TXT record, then verified)
 * and its SAML connection. A verified domain sets the role new users at it join
 * with and whether they must sign in with SSO.
 */
export async function SsoSettings() {
  if (!can(await getSession(), "sso.manage")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const [t, format, result] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("sso"),
    getFormatter(),
    loadSettings(),
  ]);

  if (result.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="sso-settings">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("SSO settings could not be loaded")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={refreshSso}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (result.data === null) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-recipe="sso-settings">
        {t("Pick an organization to manage its single sign-on.")}
      </p>
    );
  }

  const { domains, connections } = result.data;

  const verifiedDomains = domains
    .filter((domain) => domain.verified)
    .map((domain) => domain.domain);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" data-recipe="sso-settings">
      <Card id="sso-domains">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Domains")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "Claim the email domains your company owns. Publish the TXT record at your DNS host, then verify the domain.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {domains.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty>
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <GlobeIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No domains yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t("Add your company's email domain to start.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                <AddDomainForm />
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y rounded-lg border">
                {domains.map((domain) => (
                  <li key={domain.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                          {domain.domain}
                        </span>
                        {domain.verified ? (
                          <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Verified")}</Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="warning-light">
                            {t("Not verified")}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <DomainActions domain={domain} />
                    </div>
                    {domain.verified ? null : (
                      <dl className="grid gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:grid-cols-[auto_1fr] sm:gap-x-3">
                        <dt>{t("TXT name")}</dt>
                        <dd className="font-mono break-all text-foreground">
                          {domain.recordName}
                        </dd>
                        <dt>{t("TXT value")}</dt>
                        <dd className="font-mono break-all text-foreground">
                          {domain.recordValue}
                        </dd>
                      </dl>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <AddDomainForm />
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("SAML connection")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "Members at your verified domains sign in through your identity provider, such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {connections.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty>
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <KeyRoundIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No SAML connection")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {verifiedDomains.length === 0
                    ? t(
                        "Verify a domain first, then connect your identity provider.",
                      )
                    : t(
                        "Connect your identity provider with its metadata URL.",
                      )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                {verifiedDomains.length === 0 ? (
                  <a
                    href="#sso-domains"
                    className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
                  >
                    {t("Go to domains")}
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <AddSamlForm verifiedDomains={verifiedDomains} />
                )}
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y rounded-lg border">
              {connections.map((connection) => (
                <li
                  key={connection.id}
                  className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-3"
                >
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                        {t("SAML 2.0")}
                      </span>
                      {connection.domains.map((domain) => (
                        <Badge key={domain} variant="outline">
                          {domain}
                        </Badge>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {connection.metadataUrl ?? t("Metadata uploaded as XML")}
                      {" · "}
                      {t("Added {date}", {
                        date: format.dateTime(new Date(connection.createdAt), {
                          dateStyle: "medium",
                        }),
                      })}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <RemoveConnectionButton id={connection.id} />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Access requests inbox

Requests for access to a resource, with approve and deny buttons for the owner. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [access-requests block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/access-requests) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add access-requests`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/access-requests-inbox.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/access-requests/components/access-requests-inbox.tsx"
/**
 * Requests for a temporary role in the active organization. Members ask for
 * one; members with `members.update_role` approve or deny it, and the role goes
 * back to the previous one when the duration runs out.
 */
export async function AccessRequestsInbox() {
  if (!can(await getSession(), "access_requests.create")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const [t, format, result] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("accessRequests"),
    getFormatter(),
    loadInbox(),
  ]);

  if (result.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="access-requests-inbox">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("Access requests could not be loaded")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={refreshAccessRequests}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (result.data === null) {
    return (
      <p
        className="text-sm text-muted-foreground"
        data-recipe="access-requests-inbox"
      >
        {t("Pick an organization to see its access requests.")}
      </p>
    );
  }

  const { requests, role, userId, canDecide } = result.data;
  const canRequest = role !== undefined && role !== "owner";

  const statusLabel = (status: AccessRequestStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "pending": {
        return t("Pending");
      }

      case "granted": {
        return t("Granted");
      }

      case "rejected": {
        return t("Denied");
      }

      case "cancelled": {
        return t("Withdrawn");
      }

      case "expired": {
        return t("Expired");
      }

      case "ended": {
        return t("Ended");
      }

      default: {
        const unknown: never = status;

        return unknown;
      }
    }
  };

  const roleLabel = (value: string) =>
```
