```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/access-requests/components/access-requests-inbox.tsx"
    value === "admin" ? t("Admin") : value === "member" ? t("Member") : value;

  const durationLabel = (value: string | null) => {
    switch (value) {
      case null: {
        return t("Until revoked");
      }

      case "PT1H": {
        return t("1 hour");
      }

      case "P1D": {
        return t("1 day");
      }

      case "P7D": {
        return t("7 days");
      }

      default: {
        return value;
      }
    }
  };

  const date = (value: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(value), {
      dateStyle: "medium",
      timeStyle: "short",
    });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" data-recipe="access-requests-inbox">
      {canRequest ? (
        <Card id="request-access">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Request access")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t(
                "Ask for a higher role for a limited time. An admin or owner approves it.",
              )}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <RequestAccessForm currentRole={role} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Requests")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {canDecide
              ? t("Approve or deny what members asked for.")
              : t("The requests you sent and what happened to them.")}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {requests.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty>
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <InboxIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No access requests")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {canRequest
                    ? t("Requests you and other members send show up here.")
                    : t(
                        "Requests from members show up here for you to decide.",
                      )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                {canRequest ? (
                  <a
                    href="#request-access"
                    className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
                  >
                    {t("Request a role")}
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <Link
                    href="/settings/members"
                    className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
                  >
                    {t("View members")}
                  </Link>
                )}
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Member")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Role")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
                    {t("Duration")}
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">
                    <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
                  </TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {requests.map((request) => (
                  <TableRow key={request.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                        <span className="font-medium">
                          {request.userId === userId
                            ? t("You")
                            : request.requester}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {request.reason ?? date(request.createdAt)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{roleLabel(request.role)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                      {request.status === "granted" && request.expiresAt
                        ? t("Until {date}", { date: date(request.expiresAt) })
                        : durationLabel(request.duration)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[request.status]}>
                        {statusLabel(request.status)}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <AccessRequestActions
                        request={request}
                        mine={request.userId === userId}
                        canDecide={canDecide}
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Grants editor

The grants on a drive item, inherited ones included, with a picker to share it with a member or team at a role. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [drive block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/drive) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add drive`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/grants-editor.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button dialog field select skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/drive/components/grants-editor.tsx"
/**
 * Loads an item's grants; `open` starts a fresh read, so call it with the
 * dialog.
 */
export function useDriveSharing(id: string) {
  const load = useAction(loadDriveSharing);

  return {
    ...load,
    open: () => {
      load.reset();
      void load.run({ id });
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Who can open a drive item: its grants, inherited ones from the folders above
 * included, and a picker to share it with a member or a team.
 */
export function GrantsEditor({
  id,
  name,
  load,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  load: ReturnType<typeof useDriveSharing>;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("drive");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent data-recipe="grants-editor">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t("Share {name}", { name })}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {t("Members and teams you add here can open it.")}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {load.error ? (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm text-destructive"
          >
            {errorMessage(load.error)}
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                void load.run({ id });
              }}
            >
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : load.data === undefined ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-busy="true">
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <SharingPanel
            id={id}
            grants={load.data.grants}
            targets={load.data.targets}
            onChange={() => {
              void load.run({ id });
            }}
          />
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function SharingPanel({
  id,
  grants,
  targets,
  onChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  grants: readonly SharingGrant[];
  targets: readonly SharingTarget[];
  onChange: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("drive");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const roleLabel = useRoleLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const onError = (error: Parameters<typeof errorMessage>[0]) => {
    toast.error(errorMessage(error));
  };

  const share = useAction(shareDriveItem, { onSuccess: onChange, onError });
  const unshare = useAction(unshareDriveItem, { onSuccess: onChange, onError });

  const granted = new Set(grants.map(keyOf));

  const options = targets
    .filter((target) => !granted.has(keyOf(target)))
    .map((target) => ({
      value: keyOf(target),
      label:
        target.type === "team"
          ? t("{name} (team)", { name: target.name })
          : target.name,
    }));

  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<DriveRole>("viewer");

  const target = targets.find(
    (each) => keyOf(each) === (picked ?? options[0]?.value),
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {grants.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {t("Not shared yet. Pick a member or team below.")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {grants.map((grant) => (
            <li
              key={`${keyOf(grant)}:${grant.inherited ? "up" : "here"}`}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
            >
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="truncate text-sm">{grant.name}</span>
                {grant.inherited ? (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("From a folder above")}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="secondary">{roleLabel(grant.role)}</Badge>
                {!grant.inherited && grant.type !== "role" ? (
                  <Button
                    size="icon-sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    disabled={unshare.pending}
                    aria-label={t("Stop sharing with {name}", {
                      name: grant.name,
                    })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (grant.type !== "role") {
                        void unshare.run({
                          id,
                          principal: { type: grant.type, id: grant.id },
                        });
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <XIcon />
                  </Button>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {target === undefined ? null : (
        <form
          className="flex items-end gap-2"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            void share.run({
              id,
              principal: { type: target.type, id: target.id },
              role,
            });
            setPicked(null);
          }}
        >
          <Field className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-target`}>
              {t("Share with")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Select
              value={keyOf(target)}
              items={options}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                const match = options.find((option) => option.value === value);

                if (match) {
                  setPicked(match.value);
                }
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-target`} className="w-full">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {options.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field className="w-36">
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-role`}>{t("Access")}</FieldLabel>
            <Select
              value={role}
              items={DRIVE_ROLES.map((each) => ({
                value: each,
                label: roleLabel(each),
              }))}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                if (isRole(value)) {
                  setRole(value);
                }
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-role`} className="w-full">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {DRIVE_ROLES.map((each) => (
                  <SelectItem key={each} value={each}>
                    {roleLabel(each)}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={share.pending}>
            <UserPlusIcon />
            {t("Share")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Reactions bar

Emoji reactions under a record with counts, which toggle the caller's own reaction. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [reactions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/reactions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add reactions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/reactions-bar.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert button card skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/reactions-bar.tsx"
const EMOJIS = ["👍", "🎉", "❤️", "👀", "🚀"] as const;

/**
 * Quick reactions on the customer. The counts load in the browser and update
 * when anyone in the organization reacts (the `reactions` topic).
 */
export function ReactionsBar({
  customerId,
  canReact,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  canReact: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const subject = { type: "customer", id: customerId };

  const { reactions, error, toggle, refresh } = useReactions({
    subjects: [subject],
  });

  const counts = new Map(
    (reactions?.[subjectKey(subject)] ?? []).map((each) => [each.emoji, each]),
  );

  const total = [...counts.values()].reduce((sum, each) => sum + each.count, 0);

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="reactions-bar">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Reactions")}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The reactions didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  void refresh();
                }}
              >
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        {reactions === undefined ? (
          error ? null : (
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {EMOJIS.map((emoji) => (
                <Skeleton key={emoji} className="h-8 w-12" />
              ))}
            </div>
          )
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <fieldset className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <legend className="sr-only">{t("React to this customer")}</legend>
              {EMOJIS.map((emoji) => {
                const count = counts.get(emoji);

                return (
                  <Button
                    key={emoji}
                    size="sm"
                    variant={count?.reacted ? "secondary" : "outline"}
                    aria-pressed={count?.reacted ?? false}
                    disabled={!canReact || busy !== null}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setBusy(emoji);
                      void toggle(subject, emoji).finally(() => {
                        setBusy(null);
                      });
                    }}
                  >
                    <span aria-hidden>{emoji}</span>
                    <span className="tabular-nums">{count?.count ?? 0}</span>
                  </Button>
                );
              })}
            </fieldset>
            {total === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {canReact
                  ? t("No reactions yet. Pick one to be the first.")
                  : t("No reactions yet.")}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Share link dialog

A dialog that creates an expiring link to a record and revokes it. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [share-links block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/share-links) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add share-links`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/share-link-dialog.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert-dialog badge button card dialog empty field input select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/share-link-dialog.tsx"
type ExpiryDays = 1 | 7 | 30 | 0;

const isExpiry = (value: unknown): value is ExpiryDays =>
  value === 1 || value === 7 || value === 30 || value === 0;

type LinkState = "active" | "expired" | "revoked";

const LINK_VARIANT = {
  active: "success-light",
  expired: "warning-light",
  revoked: "secondary",
} as const satisfies Record<LinkState, string>;

function stateOf(link: ShareLinkRow): LinkState {
  if (link.revokedAt !== null) {
    return "revoked";
  }

  return link.expired ? "expired" : "active";
}

/** View links to the customer: create one, see who can still open them, revoke. */
export function ShareLinkDialog({
  customerId,
  links,
  canCreate,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  links: Loaded<readonly ShareLinkRow[]>;
  canCreate: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="share-link-dialog">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Share links")}</CardTitle>
        {canCreate && links.kind === "ok" && links.data.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <CreateShareLink customerId={customerId} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {links.kind === "error" ? (
          <RecordLoadError title={t("The share links didn't load")} />
        ) : links.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <Link2Icon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No share links")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("A link lets someone outside the team view this customer.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canCreate ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreateShareLink customerId={customerId} />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ShareLinkList
            customerId={customerId}
            links={links.data}
            canRevoke={canCreate}
          />
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function ShareLinkList({
  customerId,
  links,
  canRevoke,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  links: readonly ShareLinkRow[];
  canRevoke: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const format = useFormatter();

  const label: Record<LinkState, string> = {
    active: t("Active"),
    expired: t("Expired"),
    revoked: t("Revoked"),
  };

  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="share-links">
      {links.map((link) => {
        const state = stateOf(link);

        return (
          <li
            key={link.id}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2"
          >
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant={LINK_VARIANT[state]}>{label[state]}</Badge>
                <span className="text-sm">{t("View only")}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {link.expiresAt === null
                  ? t("Never expires")
                  : t("Expires {date}", {
                      date: format.dateTime(link.expiresAt, {
                        dateStyle: "medium",
                        timeStyle: "short",
                      }),
                    })}
              </span>
            </div>
            {canRevoke && state === "active" ? (
              <RevokeShareLink id={link.id} customerId={customerId} />
            ) : null}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function CreateShareLink({ customerId }: { customerId: string }) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expiresInDays, setExpiresInDays] = useState<ExpiryDays>(7);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const create = useAction(createShareLink, {
    onSuccess: ({ token }) => {
      setUrl(`${window.location.origin}/share/${token}`);
    },
  });

  const expiries = [
    { value: 1, label: t("1 day") },
    { value: 7, label: t("7 days") },
    { value: 30, label: t("30 days") },
    { value: 0, label: t("Never") },
  ];

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);

        if (!next) {
          setUrl(null);
          create.reset();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" />}>
        <Link2Icon />
        {t("Create link")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        {url ? (
          <div className="grid gap-6">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{t("Link created")}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                {t(
                  "Copy it now. It is shown once; revoke it here to close it.",
                )}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Input
                value={url}
                readOnly
                aria-label={t("Share link")}
                data-testid="share-link-url"
              />
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="icon"
                aria-label={t("Copy link")}
                onClick={() => {
                  void navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(url)
                    .then(() => toast.success(t("Link copied")));
                }}
              >
                <CopyIcon />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose render={<Button />}>{t("Done")}</DialogClose>
            </DialogFooter>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form
            className="grid gap-6"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              void create.run({ customerId, expiresInDays });
            }}
          >
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{t("Share this customer")}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                {t(
                  "Anyone with the link can view the customer until it expires.",
                )}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <Field data-invalid={create.error ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-expiry`}>
                {t("Expires after")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={expiresInDays}
                items={expiries}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  if (isExpiry(value)) {
                    setExpiresInDays(value);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-expiry`} className="w-40">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {expiries.map((each) => (
                    <SelectItem key={each.value} value={each.value}>
                      {each.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              {create.error ? (
                <FieldError>{errorMessage(create.error)}</FieldError>
              ) : null}
            </Field>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
                {t("Cancel")}
              </DialogClose>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={create.pending}>
                {t("Create link")}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function RevokeShareLink({
  id,
  customerId,
}: {
  id: string;
  customerId: string;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const revoke = useAction(revokeCustomerShareLinks, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Link revoked"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger
        render={
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={revoke.pending} />
        }
      >
        {t("Revoke")}
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("Revoke this link?")}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            {t("Anyone who has it can no longer open the customer.")}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{t("Cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            variant="destructive"
            onClick={() => {
              void revoke.run({ id: customerId, input: { id } });
            }}
          >
            {t("Revoke")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

export function ShareLinkDialogSkeleton() {
```

## Attachments uploader

A drop zone that uploads files to a record and lists them with a download link. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [attachments block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/attachments) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add attachments`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/attachments-uploader.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert-dialog badge button card empty
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/attachments-uploader.tsx"
type FileState = "unfinished" | "scanning" | "ready" | "blocked" | "failed";

function stateOf(file: AttachmentRow): FileState {
  switch (file.status) {
    case "pending": {
      return file.uploaded ? "scanning" : "unfinished";
    }

    case "clean": {
      return "ready";
    }

    case "infected": {
      return "blocked";
    }

    case "failed": {
      return "failed";
    }

    default: {
      const unhandled: never = file.status;

      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}

const VARIANT = {
  unfinished: "warning-light",
  scanning: "info-light",
  ready: "success-light",
  blocked: "destructive-light",
  failed: "destructive-light",
} as const satisfies Record<FileState, string>;

/**
 * Files on the customer, in the private `attachments` bucket. Pick, drop or
 * paste files: the server records each one and signs its upload,
 * `useAttachmentUpload` sends the bytes with progress, and the server confirms
 * it. A file downloads once the scanner marked it clean.
 */
export function AttachmentsUploader({
  customerId,
  files,
  canUpload,
  canRemove,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  files: Loaded<readonly AttachmentRow[]>;
  canUpload: boolean;
  canRemove: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const upload = useCustomerUpload(customerId);

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="attachments-uploader">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Files")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {canUpload
            ? t(
                "Drop or paste files to upload. They download after the virus scan.",
              )
            : t("Files download after the virus scan marks them clean.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {canUpload && files.kind === "ok" && files.data.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <UploadButton busy={upload.busy} onPick={upload.add} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <DropZone enabled={canUpload} onFiles={upload.add}>
          {upload.uploads.length > 0 ? <UploadList upload={upload} /> : null}
          {files.kind === "error" ? (
            <RecordLoadError title={t("The files didn't load")} />
          ) : files.data.length === 0 ? (
            upload.uploads.length > 0 ? null : (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <PaperclipIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No files yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {t(
                      "Attach contracts, quotes or anything else about this customer.",
                    )}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                {canUpload ? (
                  <EmptyContent>
                    <UploadButton busy={upload.busy} onPick={upload.add} />
                  </EmptyContent>
                ) : null}
              </Empty>
            )
          ) : (
            <FileList
              customerId={customerId}
              files={files.data}
              canRemove={canRemove}
            />
          )}
        </DropZone>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/**
 * Uploads to the customer through the server actions, which check
 * `attachments.upload` and read the page again once a file is confirmed.
 */
function useCustomerUpload(customerId: string): AttachmentUploadState {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const start = useAction(startAttachmentUpload);
  const confirm = useAction(confirmAttachment);

  return useAttachmentUpload({
    subject: { type: "customer", id: customerId },
    start: (file) =>
      start.run({
        customerId,
        name: file.name,
        mimeType: file.mimeType,
        size: file.size,
      }),
    confirm: (id) => confirm.run({ id }),
    refresh: false,
    onUploaded: () => {
      toast.success(t("File uploaded"));
    },
  });
}

const asInputs = (files: Iterable<File>): AttachmentFileInput[] =>
  [...files].map((file) => ({ file, name: file.name }));

const EDITABLE = "input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]";

/**
 * Takes files dropped on it and files pasted anywhere on the page outside a
 * text field; a plain wrapper when uploads are off. The Upload button is the
 * keyboard path, so the zone itself takes no focus.
 */
function DropZone({
  enabled,
  onFiles,
  children,
}: {
  enabled: boolean;
  onFiles: (files: readonly AttachmentFileInput[]) => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const zone = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

  const take = useEffectEvent((files: FileList | null | undefined) => {
    const inputs = asInputs(files ?? []);

    if (inputs.length > 0) {
      onFiles(inputs);
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const element = zone.current;

    if (!enabled || !element) {
      return;
    }

    const over = (event: DragEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setDragging(true);
    };

    const leave = () => {
      setDragging(false);
    };

    const drop = (event: DragEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setDragging(false);
      take(event.dataTransfer?.files);
    };

    const paste = (event: ClipboardEvent) => {
      const files = event.clipboardData?.files;

      if (
        !files ||
        files.length === 0 ||
        (event.target instanceof Element && event.target.closest(EDITABLE))
      ) {
        return;
      }

      event.preventDefault();
      take(files);
    };

    element.addEventListener("dragover", over);
    element.addEventListener("dragleave", leave);
    element.addEventListener("drop", drop);
    document.addEventListener("paste", paste);

    return () => {
      element.removeEventListener("dragover", over);
      element.removeEventListener("dragleave", leave);
      element.removeEventListener("drop", drop);
      document.removeEventListener("paste", paste);
    };
  }, [enabled]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={zone}
      data-dragging={(enabled && dragging) || undefined}
      className="-m-2 flex flex-col gap-3 p-2 transition-colors data-dragging:bg-muted"
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function UploadList({ upload }: { upload: AttachmentUploadState }) {
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="uploads">
      {upload.uploads.map((item) => (
        <UploadRow
          key={item.key}
          item={item}
          onRetry={upload.retry}
          onDismiss={upload.dismiss}
        />
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

const UPLOAD_VARIANT = {
  uploading: "info-light",
  confirming: "info-light",
  scanning: "info-light",
  done: "success-light",
  blocked: "destructive-light",
  error: "destructive-light",
} as const satisfies Record<AttachmentUploadItem["status"], string>;

function UploadRow({
  item,
  onRetry,
  onDismiss,
}: {
  item: AttachmentUploadItem;
  onRetry: (key: string) => void;
  onDismiss: (key: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const label: Record<AttachmentUploadItem["status"], string> = {
    uploading: t("Uploading"),
    confirming: t("Saving"),
    scanning: t("Waiting for scan"),
    done: t("Uploaded"),
    blocked: t("Blocked"),
    error: t("Failed"),
  };

  return (
    <li className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
        <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{item.name}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Badge variant={UPLOAD_VARIANT[item.status]}>
            {label[item.status]}
          </Badge>
          {item.status === "uploading" ? (
            <Progress
              className="flex-1"
              value={Math.round(item.progress * 100)}
              aria-label={t("Upload progress for {name}", { name: item.name })}
            />
          ) : item.error === undefined ? null : (
            <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {errorMessage(item.error)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        {item.status === "error" ? (
          <Button
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={t("Retry {name}", { name: item.name })}
            onClick={() => {
              onRetry(item.key);
            }}
          >
            <RotateCwIcon />
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        <Button
          size="icon-sm"
          variant="ghost"
          aria-label={t("Dismiss {name}", { name: item.name })}
          onClick={() => {
            onDismiss(item.key);
          }}
        >
          <XIcon />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

function FileList({
  customerId,
  files,
  canRemove,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  files: readonly AttachmentRow[];
  canRemove: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const label: Record<FileState, string> = {
    unfinished: t("Upload unfinished"),
    scanning: t("Waiting for scan"),
    ready: t("Ready"),
    blocked: t("Blocked"),
    failed: t("Scan failed"),
  };

  const download = useAction(downloadAttachment, {
    onSuccess: ({ signedUrl }) => {
      window.location.assign(signedUrl);
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="attachments">
      {files.map((file) => {
        const state = stateOf(file);

        return (
          <li
            key={file.id}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2"
          >
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{file.name}</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant={VARIANT[state]}>{label[state]}</Badge>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {format.number(file.size / 1024, {
                    style: "unit",
                    unit: "kilobyte",
                    maximumFractionDigits: 1,
                  })}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Button
                size="icon-sm"
                variant="ghost"
                aria-label={t("Download {name}", { name: file.name })}
                disabled={state !== "ready" || download.pending}
                onClick={() => {
                  void download.run({ id: file.id });
                }}
              >
                <DownloadIcon />
              </Button>
              {canRemove ? (
                <RemoveFile
                  id={file.id}
                  customerId={customerId}
                  name={file.name}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function UploadButton({
  busy,
  onPick,
}: {
  busy: boolean;
  onPick: (files: readonly AttachmentFileInput[]) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const pick = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const inputs = asInputs(event.target.files ?? []);
    event.target.value = "";

    if (inputs.length > 0) {
      onPick(inputs);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        multiple
        className="sr-only"
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden
        onChange={pick}
      />
      <Button size="sm" onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>
        <UploadIcon />
        {busy ? t("Upload more") : t("Upload files")}
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}

function RemoveFile({
  id,
  customerId,
  name,
}: {
  id: string;
  customerId: string;
  name: string;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const remove = useAction(removeCustomerAttachments, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("File removed"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger
        render={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={remove.pending} />}
      >
        {t("Remove")}
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("Remove {name}?", { name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            {t("The file is deleted from storage. This can't be undone.")}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{t("Cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            variant="destructive"
            onClick={() => {
              void remove.run({ id: customerId, input: { id } });
            }}
          >
            {t("Remove")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

/** The files card while its rows load. */
export function AttachmentsUploaderSkeleton() {
  return <RecordCardSkeleton rows={2} />;
}
```

## Waitlist signup

An email form that joins the waitlist and shows the position in line. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [waitlist block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/waitlist) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add waitlist`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/waitlist-signup.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card field input
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/waitlist/components/waitlist-signup.tsx"
/**
 * Joins the waitlist with an email address and shows the place in line. Joining
 * again with the same address shows the same place.
 */
export function WaitlistSignup() {
  const t = useExtracted("waitlist");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const form = useActionForm(joinWaitlist);

  const error =
    form.error === undefined
      ? null
      : form.error.kind === "validation"
        ? t("Enter a valid email address.")
        : errorMessage(form.error);

  if (form.data) {
    const { position, status } = form.data;

    return (
      <Card data-recipe="waitlist-signup">
        <CardHeader className="text-center">
          <ListOrderedIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="mx-auto size-8 text-primary"
          />
          <CardTitle>
            {status === "waiting" && position !== null
              ? t("You're number {position} in line", {
                  position: String(position),
                })
              : t("You're on the list")}
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {status === "waiting"
              ? t("We'll email you when your spot opens up.")
              : t("Your spot is open. Create your account to get started.")}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
          <Badge
            variant={status === "waiting" ? "info-light" : "success-light"}
          >
            {status === "waiting" ? t("Waiting") : t("Approved")}
          </Badge>
          {status === "waiting" ? (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                form.reset();
              }}
            >
              {t("Add another address")}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Link href="/signup" className={buttonVariants()}>
              {t("Create your account")}
            </Link>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="waitlist-signup">
      <CardHeader className="text-center">
        <CardTitle>{t("Join the waitlist")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Acme Cloud opens to new teams in batches. Save your spot.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form {...form.formProps}>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-email`}>{t("Email")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-email`}
                name="email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                required
                maxLength={320}
                aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
              />
              {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={form.pending}>
              {t("Join the waitlist")}
            </Button>
            <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("Already have an account?")}{" "}
              <Link
                href="/login"
                className="text-foreground underline underline-offset-4"
              >
                {t("Sign in")}
              </Link>
            </p>
          </FieldGroup>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Contact detail

A person or company with its details, related contacts and the latest activity. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [contacts block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/contacts) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add contacts`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/contact-detail.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/crm/components/contact-detail.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: a company or a person with its details, its
 * people (for a company) and the activity timeline.
 */
export async function ContactDetail({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const [{ id }, session, t] = await Promise.all([
    params,
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("crm"),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "parties.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const loaded = await settle(() => loadContact(id));

  if (loaded.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (loaded.kind === "error") {
    return <CrmLoadError title={t("The contact didn't load")} />;
  }

  const contact = loaded.data;

  if (!contact) {
    notFound();
  }

  const lifecycles = new Map([
    ["lead", t("Lead")],
    ["prospect", t("Prospect")],
    ["customer", t("Customer")],
    ["churned", t("Churned")],
    ["mql", t("Marketing qualified")],
    ["sql", t("Sales qualified")],
    ["opportunity", t("Opportunity")],
  ]);

  const details = [
    { label: t("Email"), value: contact.email },
    { label: t("Phone"), value: contact.phone },
    { label: t("Title"), value: contact.title },
    { label: t("Domain"), value: contact.domain },
    { label: t("Website"), value: contact.website },
  ].filter((detail) => detail.value !== null);

  return (
    <div data-recipe="contact-detail" className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:col-span-2">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{contact.name}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Badge variant="outline">
                {contact.kind === "company" ? t("Company") : t("Person")}
              </Badge>
              <Badge variant="primary-light">
                {lifecycles.get(contact.lifecycle) ?? contact.lifecycle}
              </Badge>
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {details.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("No details yet.")}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {details.map((detail) => (
                  <div key={detail.label} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {detail.label}
                    </dt>
                    <dd className="text-sm">{detail.value}</dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Suspense fallback={<ActivityTimelineSkeleton />}>
          <ActivityTimeline subject={{ type: contact.kind, id: contact.id }} />
        </Suspense>
      </div>
      {contact.kind === "company" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("People")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t("The people you talk to at {name}.", { name: contact.name })}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            {contact.people.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <UserPlusIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No people yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {contact.candidates.length === 0
                      ? t("Add a person first, then link them here.")
                      : t("Link a person below.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                {contact.candidates.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyContent>
                    <CreateContactDialog variant="outline" />
                  </EmptyContent>
                ) : null}
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
                {contact.people.map((person) => (
                  <li
                    key={person.id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0"
                  >
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                      <Link
                        href={`/crm/contacts/${person.id}`}
                        className="truncate text-sm font-medium hover:underline"
                      >
                        {person.name}
                      </Link>
                      <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {[person.role ?? person.title, person.email]
                          .filter((part) => part !== null)
                          .join(" · ")}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {person.primary ? (
                      <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Primary")}</Badge>
                    ) : null}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            {can(session, "parties.write") ? (
              <LinkPersonForm
                companyId={contact.id}
                people={contact.candidates.map((person) => ({
                  value: person.id,
                  label: person.name,
                }))}
              />
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Companies")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t("Link this person from a company's page.")}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Link
              href="/crm/contacts"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium hover:underline"
            >
              <BuildingIcon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              {t("All contacts")}
            </Link>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Deal board

Deals as cards in pipeline stage columns, moved by drag and drop. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [deals](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/deals), [pipelines](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/pipelines) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add deals pipelines`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/deal-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/crm/components/deal-board.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: one column per stage of the default deal
 * pipeline. Dragging a deal saves its new stage through `moveDeal`.
 */
export async function DealBoard() {
  const [session, t] = await Promise.all([getSession(), getExtracted("crm")]);

  if (!can(session, "deals.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const board = await settle(loadDealBoard);

  if (board.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const pipeline = board.kind === "ok" ? board.data.pipeline : null;

  const openStages =
    board.kind === "ok"
      ? board.data.stages
          .filter((stage) => stage.category === "open")
          .map((stage) => ({ value: stage.id, label: stage.name }))
      : [];

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="deal-board">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{pipeline?.name ?? t("Deals")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Drag a deal to another stage to move it.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {pipeline && can(session, "deals.write") ? (
          <CardAction>
            <CreateDealDialog pipelineId={pipeline.id} stages={openStages} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {board.kind === "error" ? (
          <CrmLoadError title={t("The board didn't load")} />
        ) : board.data.pipeline === null ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <KanbanIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No pipeline yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {can(session, "pipelines.manage")
                  ? t(
                      "Start with six stages, from qualified to closed won or lost.",
                    )
                  : t("Ask an admin to create the sales pipeline.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {can(session, "pipelines.manage") ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreatePipelineButton />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <DealKanban
            key={board.data.deals
              .map((deal) => `${deal.id}:${deal.stageId}`)
              .join(",")}
            stages={board.data.stages}
            deals={board.data.deals}
            canMove={can(session, "deals.write")}
          />
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Sequence builder

Each sequence's email, wait and task steps in order, with its enrollment counts, an Add step dialog and an Activate or Pause button. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [sequences block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/sequences) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add sequences`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/sequence-builder.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card dialog empty field input select skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/sequences/components/sequence-builder.tsx"
const statusVariants = {
  draft: "secondary",
  active: "success-light",
  paused: "warning-light",
  archived: "outline",
} as const satisfies Record<SequenceStatus, string>;

const stepIcons = {
  email: MailIcon,
  wait: ClockIcon,
  task: ListChecksIcon,
} as const satisfies Record<SequenceStep["kind"], LucideIcon>;

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's sequences and their steps. */
export async function SequenceBuilder() {
  const [view, session, t] = await Promise.all([
    getSequences(),
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("sequences"),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The sequences didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const manage = can(session, "sequences.manage");

  if (view.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <SendIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No sequences yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {manage
              ? t(
                  "Create a sample sequence, then activate it to enroll contacts.",
                )
              : t(
                  "An admin sets up the sequences your team enrolls contacts in.",
                )}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        {manage ? (
          <EmptyContent>
            <SampleSequenceButton />
          </EmptyContent>
        ) : null}
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const statusLabels: Record<SequenceStatus, string> = {
    draft: t("Draft"),
    active: t("Active"),
    paused: t("Paused"),
    archived: t("Archived"),
  };

  const stepLabel = (step: SequenceStep): string => {
    switch (step.kind) {
      case "email": {
        return step.subject;
      }

      case "wait": {
        return t("Wait {minutes} minutes", { minutes: String(step.minutes) });
      }

      case "task": {
        return step.title;
      }

      default: {
        const unknown: never = step;

        return unknown;
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      {view.data.map((sequence) => (
        <Card key={sequence.id}>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CardTitle>{sequence.name}</CardTitle>
              <Badge variant={statusVariants[sequence.status]}>
                {statusLabels[sequence.status]}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            {manage && sequence.status !== "archived" ? (
              <CardAction className="flex gap-2">
                <AddStepDialog sequenceId={sequence.id} />
                <SequenceStatusButton
                  sequenceId={sequence.id}
                  active={sequence.status === "active"}
                />
              </CardAction>
            ) : null}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {sequence.steps.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("No steps yet.")}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ol className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {sequence.steps.map((step, index) => {
                  const Icon = stepIcons[step.kind];

                  return (
                    <li
                      key={step.id}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"
                    >
                      <span className="w-5 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                        {index + 1}
                      </span>
                      <Icon
                        aria-hidden
                        className="size-4 text-muted-foreground"
                      />
                      <span className="truncate">{stepLabel(step)}</span>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ol>
            )}
          </CardContent>
          <CardFooter className="gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            <span>
              {t("{count} active", { count: String(sequence.counts.active) })}
            </span>
            <span>
              {t("{count} completed", {
                count: String(sequence.counts.completed),
              })}
            </span>
            <span>
              {t("{count} replied", { count: String(sequence.counts.replied) })}
            </span>
          </CardFooter>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

A quote with line items, discounts and totals in minor units, sent for acceptance. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [quotes block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/quotes) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add quotes`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/quote-builder.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash

```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/crm/components/quote-builder.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: a quote's line items and totals. A draft (or a
 * quote with changes requested) is editable; the status decides what comes
 * next: send, record the customer's answer, or revise.
 */
export async function QuoteBuilder({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const [{ id }, session, t, locale] = await Promise.all([
    params,
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("crm"),
    getLocale(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "quotes.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const loaded = await settle(() => loadQuote(id));

  if (loaded.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (loaded.kind === "error") {
    return <CrmLoadError title={t("The quote didn't load")} />;
  }

  const quote = loaded.data;

  if (!quote) {
    notFound();
  }

  const canWrite = can(session, "quotes.write");

  const editable =
    canWrite &&
    (quote.status === "draft" || quote.status === "changes_requested");

  const totals = [
    { label: t("Subtotal"), value: quote.subtotal },
    { label: t("Discount"), value: quote.discountTotal },
    { label: t("Tax"), value: quote.taxTotal },
  ];

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="quote-builder">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{quote.title}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className="tabular-nums">
            {t("{identifier} rev. {revision, number}", {
              identifier: quote.identifier,
              revision: quote.revision,
            })}
          </span>
          <QuoteStatusBadge status={quote.status} />
          {quote.validUntil ? (
            <span>
              {t("Valid until {date}", {
                date: Temporal.PlainDate.from(quote.validUntil).toLocaleString(
                  locale,
                  { dateStyle: "medium" },
                ),
              })}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </CardDescription>
        {canWrite ? (
          <CardAction>
            <QuoteStatusActions
              quoteId={quote.id}
              status={quote.status}
              hasLines={quote.lines.length > 0}
            />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {editable ? (
          <QuoteLinesEditor
            key={quote.lines
              .map((line) => `${line.description}:${line.unitAmount.amount}`)
              .join(",")}
            quoteId={quote.id}
            currency={quote.currency}
            initialLines={quote.lines}
          />
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Description")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Qty")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Unit price")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Discount %")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Tax %")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {quote.lines.length === 0 ? (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell
                    colSpan={5}
                    className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    {t("This quote has no lines.")}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ) : null}
              {quote.lines.map((line) => (
                <TableRow key={line.position}>
                  <TableCell>{line.description}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {line.quantity}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {formatMoney(line.unitAmount, locale)}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {line.discountBps / 100}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {line.taxRateBps / 100}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-end">
        <dl className="grid w-full max-w-xs grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-sm">
          {totals.map((total) => (
            <div key={total.label} className="contents">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{total.label}</dt>
              <dd className="text-right tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(total.value, locale)}
              </dd>
            </div>
          ))}
          <dt className="font-semibold">{t("Total")}</dt>
          <dd className="text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">
            {formatMoney(quote.total, locale)}
          </dd>
        </dl>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/crm/components/targets-progress.tsx"
                    end: Temporal.PlainDate.from(
                      target.periodEnd,
                    ).toLocaleString(locale, { dateStyle: "medium" }),
                  })}

              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
```
