## Work item board

Work items in state columns, ordered by rank and moved through allowed transitions. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [tasks](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/tasks), [state-machine](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/state-machine), [rank](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/rank) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add tasks state-machine rank`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/work-item-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge card @reui/kanban
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/work/components/work-item-board.tsx"
/**
 * Work items in the columns of the workflow's stages, each column labelled with
 * the state its stage stands for. Dragging to another column changes the stage,
 * which the pipelines trigger checks against the allowed transitions; dragging
 * within a column saves the order through the rank block. A refused move puts
 * the card back. The parent keys it by the items' positions, so a server
 * refresh starts it from the saved board.
 */
export function WorkItemBoard({
  stages,
  items,
  canMove,
}: {
  stages: readonly StageColumn[];
  items: readonly WorkItemRow[];
  canMove: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("work");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const stateLabel = useStateLabel();
  const workErrorHint = useWorkErrorHint();
  const [columns, setColumns] = useState(() => columnsOf(stages, items));
  const move = useAction(moveWorkItem);
  const byId = new Map(items.map((item) => [item.id, item]));

  return (
    <div data-recipe="work-item-board">
      <Kanban
        value={columns}
        onValueChange={setColumns}
        getItemValue={(item) => item.id}
        onValueCommit={(value, meta) => {
          if (meta.kind !== "item") {
            return;
          }

          const column = value[meta.overContainer] ?? [];
          const previous = column[meta.overIndex - 1];
          const next = column[meta.overIndex + 1];

          void move
            .run({
              id: String(meta.event.active.id),
              stageId: meta.overContainer,
              stageChanged: meta.activeContainer !== meta.overContainer,
              previousId: previous?.id ?? null,
              nextId: next?.id ?? null,
            })
            .then((result) => {
              if (!result.ok) {
                setColumns(meta.previousValue);
                toast.error(
                  workErrorHint(result.error.hint) ??
                    errorMessage(result.error),
                );

                return;
              }

              if (!result.data.ordered) {
                toast.warning(
                  t("Moved, but its place in the column wasn't saved."),
                );
              }
            });
        }}
      >
        <KanbanBoard className="flex overflow-x-auto">
          {stages.map((stage) => {
            const state = stateOf(stage.category);
            const count = columns[stage.id]?.length ?? 0;

            return (
              <KanbanColumn
                key={stage.id}
                value={stage.id}
                className="w-72 shrink-0 gap-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-3"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">
                      {stage.name}
                    </span>
                    {state === null ? null : (
                      <Badge variant={stateBadgeVariant(state)}>
                        {stateLabel(state)}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      stage.wipLimit !== null && count > stage.wipLimit
                        ? "destructive-light"
                        : "outline"
                    }
                  >
                    {stage.wipLimit === null
                      ? count
                      : t("{count, number} of {limit, number}", {
                          count,
                          limit: stage.wipLimit,
                        })}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <KanbanColumnContent value={stage.id} className="min-h-16">
                  {(columns[stage.id] ?? []).map((item) => (
                    <KanbanItem
                      key={item.id}
                      value={item.id}
                      disabled={!canMove || move.pending}
                    >
                      <KanbanItemHandle cursor={canMove}>
                        <WorkItemCard item={item} />
                      </KanbanItemHandle>
                    </KanbanItem>
                  ))}
                  {count === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("Drop an item here.")}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </KanbanColumnContent>
              </KanbanColumn>
            );
          })}
        </KanbanBoard>
        <KanbanOverlay>
          {({ value, variant }) => {
            const item =
              variant === "item" ? byId.get(String(value)) : undefined;

            return item ? <WorkItemCard item={item} /> : null;
          }}
        </KanbanOverlay>
      </Kanban>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Entity form

A create dialog whose inputs come from `recordForm`: the entity's own fields and the organization's custom fields, validated together by `useRecordForm` before the Server Action runs. It calls `useRecordForm` from `better-supabase/react`; the [tasks](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/tasks), [custom-fields](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/custom-fields) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add tasks custom-fields`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/entity-form.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button checkbox dialog field input select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/work/components/create-work-item-dialog.tsx"
import type { DbError } from "better-supabase";
import type { RecordFormInput } from "better-supabase/records";

import { workItemInputSchema } from "better-supabase/blocks/tasks";
import { useRecordForm } from "better-supabase/react";
import { recordForm } from "better-supabase/records";
import { PlusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import type { FieldRow } from "@/features/custom-fields/custom-fields-types";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Field,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { TeamOption } from "../work-types";

import { usePriorityLabel } from "../use-work-labels";
import { createWorkItem } from "../work-actions";

const NO_TEAM = "";

/** The HTML input type for each form input; the rest are text inputs. */
const INPUT_TYPES: Partial<Record<RecordFormInput, string>> = {
  number: "number",
  integer: "number",
  date: "date",
  datetime: "datetime-local",
  email: "email",
  url: "url",
};

/**
 * A dialog that creates a work item with a title, a team, a priority and the
 * organization's custom fields for work items. `recordForm` turns the entity
 * schema and the field definitions into one list of inputs and validates them
 * together.
 */
export function CreateWorkItemDialog({
  teams,
  defaultTeamId,
  customFields,
}: {
  teams: readonly TeamOption[];
  defaultTeamId: string | null;
  customFields: readonly FieldRow[];
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("work");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const priorityLabel = usePriorityLabel();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [teamId, setTeamId] = useState(defaultTeamId ?? NO_TEAM);

  const definition = useMemo(
    () =>
      recordForm(workItemInputSchema, {
        fields: ["title", "priority"],
        customFields: customFields.map((field) => ({
          key: field.key,
          label: field.label,
          type: field.type,
          required: false,
          sensitive: field.sensitive,
        })),
      }),
    [customFields],
  );

  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<DbError>();

  const form = useRecordForm(definition, {
    initial: { title: "", priority: "0" },
    onSubmit: async ({ input, custom }) => {
      const result = await createWorkItem({
        title: input.title,
        teamId,
        priority: input.priority ?? 0,
        custom: Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(custom).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value)]),
        ),
      });

      if (!result.ok) {
        setFailure(result.error);

        return;
      }

      toast.success(t("Created {identifier}", { identifier: result.data }));
      setOpen(false);
      form.reset();
    },
  });

  const error = failure === undefined ? null : errorMessage(failure);
  const textOf = (key: string) => String(form.values[key] ?? "");

  const teamItems = [
    { value: NO_TEAM, label: t("No team") },
    ...teams.map((team) => ({ value: team.id, label: team.name })),
  ];

  const priorityItems = ["0", "1", "2", "3", "4"].map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: priorityLabel(Number(value)),
  }));

  const custom = definition.fields.filter((field) => field.source === "custom");

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);

        if (!next) {
          form.reset();
          setFailure(undefined);
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" />}>
        <PlusIcon />
        {t("New item")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            void form.submit(event);
          }}
          className="grid gap-6"
        >
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("New work item")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("It starts in the first stage of your workflow.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field
              data-invalid={error || form.errors["title"] ? true : undefined}
            >
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-title`}>{t("Title")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-title`}
                name="title"
                required
                maxLength={200}
                autoComplete="off"
                value={textOf("title")}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  form.set("title", event.target.value);
                }}
              />
              {form.errors["title"] ? (
                <FieldError>{t("Enter a title.")}</FieldError>
              ) : null}
              {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-team`}>{t("Team")}</FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={teamId}
                items={teamItems}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  setTeamId(value ?? NO_TEAM);
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-team`}>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {teamItems.map((item) => (
                    <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                      {item.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-priority`}>
                {t("Priority")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={textOf("priority")}
                items={priorityItems}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  form.set("priority", value ?? "0");
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-priority`}>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {priorityItems.map((item) => (
                    <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                      {item.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            {custom.map((field) =>
              field.input === "bool" ? (
                <Field key={field.key} orientation="horizontal">
                  <Checkbox
                    id={`${fieldId}-${field.key}`}
                    checked={form.values[field.key] === true}
                    onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                      form.set(field.key, checked);
                    }}
                  />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-${field.key}`}>
                    {field.label}
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
              ) : (
                <Field
                  key={field.key}
                  data-invalid={form.errors[field.key] ? true : undefined}
                >
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-${field.key}`}>
                    {field.label}
                  </FieldLabel>
                  <Input
                    id={`${fieldId}-${field.key}`}
                    type={INPUT_TYPES[field.input] ?? "text"}
                    autoComplete="off"
                    value={textOf(field.key)}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      form.set(field.key, event.target.value);
                    }}
                  />
                  {form.errors[field.key] ? (
                    <FieldError>{form.errors[field.key]}</FieldError>
                  ) : null}
                </Field>
              ),
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
              {t("Create item")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

## Work item grid

A data grid of work items with filters, sorting and saved views. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [tasks](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/tasks), [saved-views](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/saved-views) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase add tasks saved-views`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/work-item-grid.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button checkbox dialog field input select table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/work/components/work-item-grid.tsx"
/**
 * Work items as a table. The search, state filter and sort live in the URL and
 * can be saved as named views. State and assignee edit in place, and the
 * checkboxes feed the bulk action bar.
 */
export function WorkItemGrid({
  rows,
  stages,
  members,
  views,
  query,
  canWrite,
  canBulk,
}: {
  rows: readonly WorkItemRow[];
  stages: readonly StageColumn[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  views: readonly SavedViewOption[];
  query: WorkGridQuery;
  canWrite: boolean;
  canBulk: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("work");
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const workErrorHint = useWorkErrorHint();
  const stateLabel = useStateLabel();
  const priorityLabel = usePriorityLabel();
  const sortLabel = useSortLabel();
  const [navigating, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(query.q);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());

  const onEditError = (error: DbError) => {
    toast.error(workErrorHint(error.hint) ?? errorMessage(error));
  };

  const stage = useAction(setWorkItemStage, { onError: onEditError });
  const assign = useAction(setWorkItemAssignee, { onError: onEditError });

  const removeView = useAction(deleteWorkView, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const go = (next: WorkGridQuery) => {
    startTransition(() => {
      router.replace(`${pathname}${workGridSearch(next)}`);
    });
  };

  const visibleIds = new Set(rows.map((row) => row.id));
  const selection = [...selected].filter((id) => visibleIds.has(id));
  const selectedRows = rows.filter((row) => selected.has(row.id));
  const allSelected = rows.length > 0 && selection.length === rows.length;

  const stateItems = [
    { value: ANY, label: t("Any state") },
    ...WORK_ITEM_STATES.map((state) => ({
      value: state,
      label: stateLabel(state),
    })),
  ];

  const sortItems = WORK_ITEM_SORTS.map((sort) => ({
    value: sort,
    label: sortLabel(sort),
  }));

  const stageItems = stages.map((each) => ({
    value: each.id,
    label: each.name,
  }));

  const memberItems = [
    { value: UNASSIGNED, label: t("Unassigned") },
    ...members.map((member) => ({ value: member.userId, label: member.name })),
  ];

  const viewItems = views.map((view) => ({ value: view.id, label: view.name }));

  const activeView = views.find(
    (view) => workGridSearch(view.query) === workGridSearch(query),
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4" data-recipe="work-item-grid">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <form
          className="flex items-center gap-2"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            go({ ...query, q: search.trim() });
          }}
        >
          <Input
            type="search"
            className="w-56"
            value={search}
            placeholder={t("Search titles")}
            aria-label={t("Search titles")}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setSearch(event.target.value);
            }}
          />
          <Button
            type="submit"
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="outline"
            aria-label={t("Search")}
            disabled={navigating}
          >
            <SearchIcon />
          </Button>
        </form>
        <Select
          value={query.state ?? ANY}
          items={stateItems}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const state = WORK_ITEM_STATES.find((each) => each === value);

            go({ ...query, state: state ?? null });
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-36" aria-label={t("State")}>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {stateItems.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Select
          value={query.sort}
          items={sortItems}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const sort = WORK_ITEM_SORTS.find((each) => each === value);

            go({ ...query, sort: sort ?? "newest" });
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-36" aria-label={t("Sort")}>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {sortItems.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
          {views.length === 0 ? null : (
            <Select
              value={activeView?.id ?? null}
              items={viewItems}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                const view = views.find((each) => each.id === value);

                if (view) {
                  setSearch(view.query.q);
                  go(view.query);
                }
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger
                size="sm"
                className="w-44"
                aria-label={t("Saved views")}
              >
                <SelectValue placeholder={t("Saved views")} />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {viewItems.map((item) => (
                  <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                    {item.label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          )}
          {activeView ? (
            <Button
              size="icon-sm"
              variant="ghost"
              aria-label={t("Delete view {name}", { name: activeView.name })}
              disabled={removeView.pending}
              onClick={() => {
                void removeView.run({ id: activeView.id });
              }}
            >
              <Trash2Icon />
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <SaveViewDialog query={query} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {canBulk ? (
        <BulkActionBar
          selected={selectedRows}
          onSettled={(failedIds) => {
            setSelected(new Set(failedIds));
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            {canBulk ? (
              <TableHead className="w-8">
                <Checkbox
                  checked={allSelected}
                  indeterminate={selection.length > 0 && !allSelected}
                  aria-label={t("Select all")}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                    setSelected(
                      checked ? new Set(rows.map((row) => row.id)) : new Set(),
                    );
                  }}
                />
              </TableHead>
            ) : null}
            <TableHead>{t("ID")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("Title")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("State")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("Priority")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("Assignee")}</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {rows.map((row) => {
            const pendingStage = stage.pendingInputs.find(
              (input) => input.id === row.id,
            );

            const pendingAssignee = assign.pendingInputs.find(
              (input) => input.id === row.id,
            );

            const assignee = pendingAssignee
              ? (pendingAssignee.userId ?? UNASSIGNED)
              : (row.assigneeIds[0] ?? UNASSIGNED);

            return (
              <TableRow
                key={row.id}
                data-state={selected.has(row.id) ? "selected" : undefined}
              >
                {canBulk ? (
                  <TableCell>
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={selected.has(row.id)}
                      aria-label={t("Select {identifier}", {
                        identifier: row.identifier,
                      })}
                      onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                        setSelected((current) => {
                          const next = new Set(current);

                          if (checked) {
                            next.add(row.id);
                          } else {
                            next.delete(row.id);
                          }

                          return next;
                        });
                      }}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                ) : null}
                <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  {row.identifier}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">{row.title}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {canWrite && stages.length > 0 ? (
                    <Select
                      value={pendingStage?.stageId ?? row.stageId}
                      items={stageItems}
                      disabled={pendingStage !== undefined}
                      onValueChange={(value) => {
                        if (value !== null && value !== row.stageId) {
                          void stage.run({ id: row.id, stageId: value });
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger
                        size="sm"
                        className="w-40"
                        aria-label={t("State of {identifier}", {
                          identifier: row.identifier,
                        })}
                      >
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {stageItems.map((item) => (
                          <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                            {item.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant={stateBadgeVariant(row.state)}>
                      {stateLabel(row.state)}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {priorityLabel(row.priority)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {canWrite ? (
                    <Select
                      value={assignee}
                      items={memberItems}
                      disabled={pendingAssignee !== undefined}
                      onValueChange={(value) => {
                        void assign.run({
                          id: row.id,
                          userId:
                            value === null || value === UNASSIGNED
                              ? null
                              : value,
                        });
                      }}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger
                        size="sm"
                        className="w-44"
                        aria-label={t("Assignee of {identifier}", {
                          identifier: row.identifier,
                        })}
                      >
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {memberItems.map((item) => (
                          <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                            {item.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {members.find((member) => member.userId === assignee)
                        ?.name ?? t("Unassigned")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Approvals queue

Requests waiting for the caller's decision, with approve and reject buttons. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [approvals block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/approvals) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add approvals`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/approvals-queue.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/approvals/components/approvals-queue.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's pending approval requests,
 * newest first, with Approve and Reject on each. The block checks that the
 * caller is an approver of the current step.
 */
export async function ApprovalsQueue() {
  const [session, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("approvals"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "approvals.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const queue = await getApprovalsQueue();

  if (queue.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canRequest = can(session, "approvals.request");
  const canDecide = can(session, "approvals.manage");
  const customers = queue.kind === "ok" ? queue.data.customers : [];

  const actionLabel = (action: string) =>
    action === "discount" ? t("Discount") : action;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="approvals-queue">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Pending requests")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Each request waits for its approvers, one step at a time.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {canRequest && queue.kind === "ok" && queue.data.requests.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <RequestApprovalDialog customers={customers} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {queue.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The requests didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retryApprovals}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : queue.data.requests.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <ShieldCheckIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("Nothing waiting")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {canRequest
                  ? t(
                      "Ask for an approval before giving a customer a discount.",
                    )
                  : t("New requests show up here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canRequest ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <RequestApprovalDialog customers={customers} />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Request")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Requested by")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Step")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Requested")}</TableHead>
                {canDecide ? (
                  <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Decision")}</TableHead>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {queue.data.requests.map((request) => {
                const label = `${actionLabel(request.action)}: ${
                  request.subjectName ?? request.subjectId
                }`;

                return (
                  <TableRow key={request.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                        <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
                        <SubjectChip
                          subject={{
                            type: request.subjectType,
                            id: request.subjectId,
                          }}
                        />
                        {request.reason ? (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {request.reason}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {request.requestedBy ?? t("Unknown")}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant="warning-light">
                        {t("{step, number} of {steps, number}", {
                          step: request.step + 1,
                          steps: request.steps,
                        })}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(request.createdAt), {
                        dateStyle: "medium",
                        timeStyle: "short",
                      })}
                    </TableCell>
                    {canDecide ? (
                      <TableCell>
                        <ApprovalDecision id={request.id} label={label} />
                      </TableCell>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## SLA badges

A badge on a record with the time left before its SLA is breached. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [sla block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/sla) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add sla`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/sla-badges.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/sla-badges.tsx"
const VARIANT = {
  running: "info-light",
  paused: "secondary",
  met: "success-light",
  breached: "destructive-light",
} as const satisfies Record<SlaClockRow["state"], string>;

/**
 * The customer's SLA clocks as badges. Without clocks, the empty state starts
 * them; with no policy for customers, a caller who manages SLAs gets a default
 * policy first.
 */
export function SlaBadges({
  customerId,
  clocks,
  canCreatePolicy,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  clocks: Loaded<readonly SlaClockRow[]>;
  canCreatePolicy: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const start = useAction(startCustomerSla, {
    onSuccess: (count) => {
      if (count === 0) {
        toast.error(t("No SLA policy covers customers yet."));
      } else {
        toast.success(t("SLA clocks started"));
      }
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const metric = {
    first_response: t("First response"),
    next_response: t("Next response"),
    resolution: t("Resolution"),
  } as const satisfies Record<SlaClockRow["metric"], string>;

  const state = {
    running: t("On track"),
    paused: t("Paused"),
    met: t("Met"),
    breached: t("Breached"),
  } as const satisfies Record<SlaClockRow["state"], string>;

  const timing = (clock: SlaClockRow): string => {
    if (clock.state === "met") {
      return t("Done");
    }

    if (clock.secondsLeft === null || clock.state === "paused") {
      return t("Due {date}", {
        date: format.dateTime(clock.dueAt, {
          dateStyle: "medium",
          timeStyle: "short",
        }),
      });
    }

    const minutes = Math.round(Math.abs(clock.secondsLeft) / 60);

    const span =
      minutes >= 1440
        ? format.number(Math.round(minutes / 1440), {
            style: "unit",
            unit: "day",
            unitDisplay: "long",
          })
        : minutes >= 60
          ? format.number(Math.round(minutes / 60), {
              style: "unit",
              unit: "hour",
              unitDisplay: "long",
            })
          : format.number(minutes, {
              style: "unit",
              unit: "minute",
              unitDisplay: "long",
            });

    return clock.secondsLeft < 0
      ? t("{span} overdue", { span })
      : t("{span} left", { span });
  };

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="sla-badges">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("SLA")}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {clocks.kind === "error" ? (
          <RecordLoadError title={t("The SLA clocks didn't load")} />
        ) : clocks.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <TimerIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No SLA clocks")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {canCreatePolicy
                  ? t(
                      "Start the clocks. Without a policy for customers, a default one is created: first response in 4 hours, resolution in 3 days.",
                    )
                  : t("Start the clocks of the policy that covers customers.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                disabled={start.pending}
                onClick={() => {
                  void start.run({ customerId });
                }}
              >
                <TimerIcon />
                {t("Start SLA clocks")}
              </Button>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2" data-testid="sla-clocks">
            {clocks.data.map((clock) => (
              <li
                key={clock.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                    {metric[clock.metric]}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {timing(clock)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Badge variant={VARIANT[clock.state]}>
                  {state[clock.state]}
                </Badge>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** The SLA card while its clocks load. */
export function SlaBadgesSkeleton() {
  return <RecordCardSkeleton rows={2} />;
}
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/custom-fields/components/custom-fields-editor.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the custom fields of the record type in
 * `?entity=`, in display order. Managers add, relabel, reorder and delete
 * them.
 */
export async function CustomFieldsEditor({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, params] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("custom-fields"),
    searchParams,
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "custom_fields.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const parsed = v.safeParse(FieldEntitySchema, params["entity"]);
  const entity = parsed.success ? parsed.output : "customer";
  const fields = await getFields(entity);

  if (fields.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canManage = can(session, "custom_fields.manage");

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="custom-fields-editor">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Custom fields")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Extra fields on your records, shown in this order.")}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <EntityPicker entity={entity} />
            {canManage && fields.kind === "ok" && fields.data.length > 0 ? (
              <FieldDialog key={entity} entity={entity} />
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {fields.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The fields didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retryCustomFields}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : fields.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <ListPlusIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No custom fields yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {canManage
                  ? t(
                      "Add a field to record what your team tracks on top of the built-in ones.",
                    )
                  : t("An admin can add fields for this record type.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canManage ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <FieldDialog key={entity} entity={entity} />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Label")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Key")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Type")}</TableHead>
                {canManage ? (
                  <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Actions")}</TableHead>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {fields.data.map((field, index) => (
                <TableRow key={field.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-medium">{field.label}</span>
                      {field.sensitive ? (
                        <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Sensitive")}</Badge>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {field.key}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <FieldTypeBadge type={field.type} />
                  </TableCell>
                  {canManage ? (
                    <TableCell>
                      <FieldRowControls
                        entity={entity}
                        field={field}
                        first={index === 0}
                        last={index === fields.data.length - 1}
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                  ) : null}
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Bulk action bar

A bar over a selection of rows that runs an action on all of them and reports failures. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [bulk block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/bulk) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add bulk`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/bulk-action-bar.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert alert-dialog button select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/work/components/bulk-action-bar.tsx"
/**
 * The bar over the grid's selected rows. It changes their state or moves them
 * to the trash through the bulk block, which runs each row on its own; the rows
 * that failed stay selected and are listed with their reason.
 */
export function BulkActionBar({
  selected,
  onSettled,
}: {
  selected: readonly Pick<WorkItemRow, "id" | "identifier">[];
  onSettled: (failedIds: readonly string[]) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("work");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const stateLabel = useStateLabel();
  const [to, setTo] = useState<WorkItemState | null>(null);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [failures, setFailures] = useState<readonly BulkFailure[]>([]);
  const bulk = useAction(runWorkBulkAction);

  const identifiers = new Map(selected.map((row) => [row.id, row.identifier]));

  const run = async (
    input: { action: "state"; to: WorkItemState } | { action: "delete" },
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const ids = selected.map((row) => row.id);
    const result = await bulk.run({ ...input, ids });

    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));

      return;
    }

    const { succeeded, failed } = result.data;

    setFailures(
      failed.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        identifier: identifiers.get(row.id) ?? row.id,
        message: row.message === "" ? t("No reason given.") : row.message,
      })),
    );

    if (failed.length === 0) {
      toast.success(
        t("{count, plural, one {# item updated} other {# items updated}}", {
          count: succeeded,
        }),
      );
    } else {
      toast.warning(
        t("{failed, number} of {total, number} items failed", {
          failed: failed.length,
          total: result.data.total,
        }),
      );
    }

    onSettled(failed.map((row) => row.id));
  };

  const stateItems = WORK_ITEM_STATES.map((state) => ({
    value: state,
    label: stateLabel(state),
  }));

  if (selected.length === 0 && failures.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-recipe="bulk-action-bar">
      {selected.length === 0 ? null : (
        <div
          role="toolbar"
          aria-label={t("Selected items")}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/50 p-2"
        >
          <span className="px-2 text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
            {t("{count, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}}", {
              count: selected.length,
            })}
          </span>
          <Select
            value={to}
            items={stateItems}
            disabled={bulk.pending}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const state = WORK_ITEM_STATES.find((each) => each === value);

              setTo(state ?? null);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger
              size="sm"
              className="w-40"
              aria-label={t("New state")}
            >
              <SelectValue placeholder={t("Set state")} />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {stateItems.map((item) => (
                <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                  {item.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            disabled={to === null || bulk.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              if (to !== null) {
                void run({ action: "state", to });
              }
            }}
          >
            {t("Apply")}
          </Button>
          <AlertDialog
            open={confirming}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
              if (!bulk.pending) {
                setConfirming(next);
              }
            }}
          >
            <AlertDialogTrigger
              render={
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="destructive"
                  disabled={bulk.pending}
                />
              }
            >
              <Trash2Icon />
              {t("Delete")}
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>
                  {t(
                    "{count, plural, one {Delete # item?} other {Delete # items?}}",
                    { count: selected.length },
                  )}
                </AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>
                  {t("They move to the trash, where they can be restored.")}
                </AlertDialogDescription>
              </AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogFooter>
                <AlertDialogCancel disabled={bulk.pending}>
                  {t("Cancel")}
                </AlertDialogCancel>
                <AlertDialogAction
                  type="button"
                  variant="destructive"
                  disabled={bulk.pending}
                  onClick={() => {
                    void run({ action: "delete" }).then(() => {
                      setConfirming(false);
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  {t("Delete")}
                </AlertDialogAction>
              </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
          </AlertDialog>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            disabled={bulk.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              onSettled([]);
            }}
          >
            <XIcon />
            {t("Clear")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {failures.length === 0 ? null : (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <TriangleAlertIcon />
          <AlertTitle>
            {t(
              "{count, plural, one {# item wasn't changed} other {# items weren't changed}}",
              { count: failures.length },
            )}
          </AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              {failures.map((failure) => (
                <li key={failure.id}>
                  <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {failure.identifier}
                  </span>
                  {": "}
                  {failure.message}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </AlertDescription>
          <AlertAction>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                setFailures([]);
              }}
            >
              {t("Dismiss")}
            </Button>
          </AlertAction>
        </Alert>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Undo toast

A toast after a delete with a button that restores the record from the trash. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [trash block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/trash) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add trash`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/undo-toast.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add sonner
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/trash/components/undo-toast.tsx"
"use client";

import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { restoreTrashItem } from "../trash-actions";

export interface TrashedRecord {
  /** The trash item the delete returned. */
  readonly trashItemId: string;
  readonly name: string;
}

/**
 * Returns `show`, which confirms a delete with a toast whose Undo button
 * restores the record's whole trash batch.
 */
export function useUndoToast() {
  const t = useExtracted("trash");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const restore = useAction(restoreTrashItem, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Restored"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return function show({ trashItemId, name }: TrashedRecord) {
    toast(
      <span data-recipe="undo-toast">
        {t("{name} moved to the trash", { name })}
      </span>,
      {
        action: {
          label: t("Undo"),
          onClick: () => {
            void restore.run({ id: trashItemId });
          },
        },
      },
    );
  };
}
```

## Related items panel

The records linked to a record, with a picker to add or remove a link. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [relations block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/relations) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add relations`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/related-items-panel.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty field select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/related-items-panel.tsx"
/** Customers linked to this one (the `relates` kind), and a picker to link more. */
export function RelatedItemsPanel({
  customerId,
  relations,
  canManage,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  relations: Loaded<Relations>;
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="related-items-panel">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Related customers")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Link customers that belong together, such as a parent company.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {relations.kind === "error" ? (
          <RecordLoadError title={t("The related customers didn't load")} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {relations.data.links.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <LinkIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No related customers")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {canManage
                      ? t("Pick a customer below to link it.")
                      : t("Nobody linked a customer yet.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <RelatedList
                customerId={customerId}
                links={relations.data.links}
                canManage={canManage}
              />
            )}
            {canManage ? (
              <LinkForm
                customerId={customerId}
                options={relations.data.options.filter(
                  (option) =>
                    !relations.data.links.some(
                      (link) =>
                        link.subjectType === "customer" &&
                        link.subjectId === option.id,
                    ),
                )}
              />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function RelatedList({
  customerId,
  links,
  canManage,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  links: readonly RelatedCustomer[];
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const unlink = useAction(unlinkCustomerRelations, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Link removed"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="related-customers">
      {links.map((link) => (
        <li
          key={link.id}
          className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2"
        >
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <SubjectLink
              subject={{ type: link.subjectType, id: link.subjectId }}
            />
            {link.kind === "relates" ? null : (
              <Badge variant="outline">{link.kind}</Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          {canManage ? (
            <Button
              size="icon-sm"
              variant="ghost"
              aria-label={t("Remove link")}
              disabled={unlink.pendingInputs.some(
                (input) =>
                  !(input instanceof FormData) &&
                  input.input.target.id === link.subjectId,
              )}
              onClick={() => {
                void unlink.run({
                  id: customerId,
                  input: {
                    kind: link.kind,
                    target: { type: link.subjectType, id: link.subjectId },
                  },
                });
              }}
            >
              <UnlinkIcon />
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function LinkForm({
  customerId,
  options,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  options: readonly { readonly id: string; readonly name: string }[];
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const link = useAction(linkCustomerRelations, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      setTargetId(null);
      toast.success(t("Customer linked"));
    },
  });

  const items = options.map((option) => ({
    value: option.id,
    label: option.name,
  }));

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <form
      className="flex items-end gap-2"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (targetId) {
          void link.run({
            id: customerId,
            input: {
              kind: "relates",
              target: { type: "customer", id: targetId },
            },
          });
        }
      }}
    >
      <Field data-invalid={link.error ? true : undefined}>
        <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-related`}>
          {t("Link a customer")}
        </FieldLabel>
        <Select
          value={targetId}
          items={items}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            setTargetId(value);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-related`} className="w-full">
            <SelectValue placeholder={t("Pick a customer")} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {items.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        {link.error ? (
          <FieldError>{errorMessage(link.error)}</FieldError>
        ) : null}
      </Field>
      <Button
        type="submit"
        variant="outline"
        disabled={!targetId || link.pending}
      >
        {t("Link")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

/** The related customers card while its rows load. */
export function RelatedItemsPanelSkeleton() {
  return <RecordCardSkeleton rows={2} />;
}
```

## Employee directory

A searchable list of employees with an org chart of who reports to whom. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [employees block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/employees) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add employees`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/employee-directory.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/people/components/employee-directory.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the employees as an org chart, each manager above
 * their reports, with a search. Private details open in a sheet for callers
 * with `employees.view_sensitive`.
 */
export async function EmployeeDirectory() {
  const [session, t] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("people"),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "employees.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const directory = await settle(loadDirectory);

  if (directory.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canWrite = can(session, "employees.write");
  const canViewSensitive = can(session, "employees.view_sensitive");

  const managers =
    directory.kind === "ok"
      ? directory.data.map((employee) => ({
          value: employee.id,
          label: employee.name,
        }))
      : [];

  const addEmployee = canWrite ? (
    <AddEmployeeDialog
      managers={managers}
      canViewSensitive={canViewSensitive}
    />
  ) : null;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="employee-directory">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Employees")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Everyone in the organization and who they report to.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {addEmployee && managers.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>{addEmployee}</CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {directory.kind === "error" ? (
          <PeopleLoadError title={t("The directory didn't load")} />
        ) : directory.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <UsersIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No employees yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {canWrite
                  ? t("Add the first employee to start the org chart.")
                  : t("Ask an admin to add employees.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {addEmployee ? <EmptyContent>{addEmployee}</EmptyContent> : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <EmployeeTable
            employees={directory.data}
            canViewSensitive={canViewSensitive}
          />
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Hiring board

Candidates for an opening as cards in interview stage columns. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [hiring block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/hiring) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add hiring`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/hiring-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/people/components/hiring-board.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the candidates of one opening as cards in its
 * stage columns. Dragging a card to Hired or Rejected closes the application;
 * to another open stage, moves it. `?job=` picks the opening.
 */
export async function HiringBoard({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, query] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("people"),
    searchParams,
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "hiring.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const board = await settle(loadHiringBoard);

  if (board.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canManage = can(session, "hiring.manage");
  const canWrite = can(session, "hiring.write");
  const jobs = board.kind === "ok" ? board.data.jobs : [];
  const job = jobs.find((item) => item.id === query["job"]) ?? jobs[0];

  const cards =
    board.kind === "ok" && job
      ? board.data.cards.filter((card) => card.jobId === job.id)
      : [];

  const createOpening = canManage ? <CreateOpeningDialog /> : null;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="hiring-board">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{job?.title ?? t("Hiring")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Drag a candidate to the next stage, or to Hired or Rejected.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {jobs.length > 0 || board.kind === "error" ? (
          <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {job && canWrite && board.kind === "ok" && cards.length > 0 ? (
              <AddCandidateDialog
                jobId={job.id}
                candidates={board.data.candidates}
              />
            ) : null}
            {createOpening}
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {board.kind === "error" ? (
          <PeopleLoadError title={t("The hiring board didn't load")} />
        ) : job === undefined ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <BriefcaseIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No openings yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {canManage
                  ? t("Create an opening, then add candidates to it.")
                  : t("Ask a hiring manager to create an opening.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {createOpening ? (
              <EmptyContent>{createOpening}</EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <>
            {jobs.length > 1 ? (
              <nav
                aria-label={t("Openings")}
                className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"
              >
                {jobs.map((item) => (
                  <Link
                    key={item.id}
                    href={`/people/hiring?job=${item.id}`}
                    aria-current={item.id === job.id ? "page" : undefined}
                    className={buttonVariants({
                      variant: item.id === job.id ? "secondary" : "ghost",
                      size: "sm",
                    })}
                  >
                    {item.title}
                    {item.status === "open" ? null : (
                      <Badge variant="outline">
                        {item.status === "draft" ? t("Draft") : t("Closed")}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </nav>
            ) : null}
            {cards.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <UserPlusIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No candidates yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {t("Candidates start in the first stage of the pipeline.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                {canWrite ? (
                  <EmptyContent>
                    <AddCandidateDialog
                      jobId={job.id}
                      candidates={board.data.candidates}
                    />
                  </EmptyContent>
                ) : null}
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <HiringKanban
                key={cards
                  .map((card) => `${card.id}:${card.stageId}`)
                  .join(",")}
                stages={board.data.stages}
                cards={cards}
                canMove={canWrite}
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Timesheet

A week of time entries per project with a running timer and totals. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [time-tracking block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/time-tracking) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add time-tracking`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/timesheet.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/people/components/timesheet.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the caller's week as one row per project with
 * hours per day and totals, a running timer, and Submit once the week is done.
 * `?week=YYYY-MM-DD` picks the week.
 */
export async function Timesheet({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, format, query] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("people"),
    getFormatter(),
    searchParams,
    connection(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "time_tracking.track")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const monday = mondayOf(query["week"]);
  const week = monday.toString();
  const sheet = await settle(() => loadTimesheet(week));

  if (sheet.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const dayLabel = (date: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(`${date}T12:00:00Z`), {
      weekday: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    });

  const range = format.dateTimeRange(
    new Date(`${week}T12:00:00Z`),
    new Date(`${monday.add({ days: 6 }).toString()}T12:00:00Z`),
    { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" },
  );

  const locked =
    sheet.kind === "ok" &&
    (sheet.data.status === "submitted" || sheet.data.status === "approved");

  const logTime = locked ? null : <LogTimeDialog week={week} />;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="timesheet">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Week of {range}", { range })}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Hours per project and day, in {zone}.", { zone: TIME_ZONE })}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/people/time?week=${monday.subtract({ weeks: 1 }).toString()}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
            aria-label={t("Previous week")}
          >
            <ChevronLeftIcon />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/people/time?week=${monday.add({ weeks: 1 }).toString()}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
            aria-label={t("Next week")}
          >
            <ChevronRightIcon />
          </Link>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {sheet.kind === "error" ? (
          <PeopleLoadError title={t("The timesheet didn't load")} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <StatusBadge
                  status={sheet.data.status}
                  labels={{
                    open: t("Open"),
                    submitted: t("Submitted"),
                    approved: t("Approved"),
                    rejected: t("Rejected"),
                  }}
                />
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  {t("{total} logged, {billable} billable", {
                    total: hours(sheet.data.seconds),
                    billable: hours(sheet.data.billableSeconds),
                  })}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {locked ? null : (
                  <TimerControls
                    running={
                      sheet.data.running
                        ? {
                            project: sheet.data.running.note ?? "",
                            since: format.dateTime(
                              new Date(sheet.data.running.startedAt),
                              { timeStyle: "short" },
                            ),
                          }
                        : null
                    }
                  />
                )}
                {sheet.data.rows.length > 0 ? logTime : null}
                {locked || sheet.data.rows.length === 0 ? null : (
                  <SubmitWeekButton week={week} />
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {sheet.data.rows.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <ClockIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("Nothing logged this week")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {locked
                      ? t("This week is locked.")
                      : t(
                          "Log a block of time or start the timer on a project.",
                        )}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                {logTime ? <EmptyContent>{logTime}</EmptyContent> : null}
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>{t("Project")}</TableHead>
                    {sheet.data.days.map((day) => (
                      <TableHead key={day.date} className="text-right">
                        {dayLabel(day.date)}
                      </TableHead>
                    ))}
                    <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Total")}</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {sheet.data.rows.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                            {row.label === "" ? t("No project") : row.label}
                          </span>
                          {row.billable ? (
                            <Badge variant="outline">{t("Billable")}</Badge>
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      {row.days.map((seconds, index) => (
                        <TableCell
                          // oxlint-disable-next-line react-doctor/no-array-index-as-key -- the columns are a fixed week keyed by date; the index only covers a missing day
                          key={sheet.data.days[index]?.date ?? index}
                          className="text-right tabular-nums"
                        >
                          {seconds === 0 ? "" : hours(seconds)}
                        </TableCell>
                      ))}
                      <TableCell className="text-right font-medium tabular-nums">
                        {hours(row.seconds)}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
                <TableFooter>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell>{t("Total")}</TableCell>
                    {sheet.data.days.map((day) => (
                      <TableCell
                        key={day.date}
                        className="text-right tabular-nums"
                      >
                        {hours(day.seconds)}
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                      {hours(sheet.data.seconds)}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableFooter>
              </Table>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/field/components/dispatch-board.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: a week of technicians by day with their scheduled
 * work orders, and the unscheduled backlog below. `?week=YYYY-MM-DD` picks the
 * week.
 */
export async function DispatchBoard({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, format, query] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("field"),
    getFormatter(),
    searchParams,
    connection(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "dispatch.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const manage = can(session, "dispatch.manage");
  const monday = mondayOf(query["week"]);
  const board = await settle(() => loadDispatchWeek(monday.toString()));

  if (board.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const dayLabel = (date: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(`${date}T12:00:00Z`), {
      weekday: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    });

  const range = format.dateTimeRange(
    new Date(`${monday.toString()}T12:00:00Z`),
    new Date(`${monday.add({ days: 6 }).toString()}T12:00:00Z`),
    { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" },
```
