```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/field/components/dispatch-board.tsx"
  const newWorkOrder = manage ? <NewWorkOrderDialog /> : null;

  return (
    <div data-recipe="dispatch-board" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Week of {range}", { range })}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {board.kind === "ok"
              ? t("Scheduled work per technician, in {zone}.", {
                  zone: board.data.timeZone,
                })
              : t("Scheduled work per technician.")}
          </CardDescription>
          <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Link
              href={`/field/dispatch?week=${monday.subtract({ weeks: 1 }).toString()}`}
              className={buttonVariants({
                variant: "outline",
                size: "icon-sm",
              })}
              aria-label={t("Previous week")}
            >
              <ChevronLeftIcon />
            </Link>
            <Link
              href={`/field/dispatch?week=${monday.add({ weeks: 1 }).toString()}`}
              className={buttonVariants({
                variant: "outline",
                size: "icon-sm",
              })}
              aria-label={t("Next week")}
            >
              <ChevronRightIcon />
            </Link>
          </CardAction>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {board.kind === "error" ? (
            <FieldLoadError title={t("The schedule board didn't load")} />
          ) : board.data.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <CalendarRangeIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("Nothing scheduled this week")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t("Work orders show here once they have a technician.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                <Link
                  href={`/field/dispatch?week=${monday.add({ weeks: 1 }).toString()}`}
                  className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
                >
                  {t("Show next week")}
                </Link>
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Technician")}</TableHead>
                  {board.data.days.map((day) => (
                    <TableHead key={day}>{dayLabel(day)}</TableHead>
                  ))}
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {board.data.rows.map((row) => (
                  <TableRow key={row.technicianId}>
                    <TableCell className="align-top text-sm font-medium">
                      {row.name}
                    </TableCell>
                    {row.days.map(({ date, orders }) => (
                      <TableCell key={date} className="align-top">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                          {orders.map((order) => (
                            <div key={order.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                                {order.title}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                                {order.startsAt
                                  ? format.dateTime(new Date(order.startsAt), {
                                      timeStyle: "short",
                                      timeZone: board.data.timeZone,
                                    })
                                  : null}
                              </span>
                              <WorkOrderStatusBadge status={order.status} />
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Backlog")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t("Work orders without a slot, most urgent first.")}
          </CardDescription>
          {newWorkOrder ? <CardAction>{newWorkOrder}</CardAction> : null}
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {board.kind === "error" ? (
            <FieldLoadError title={t("The backlog didn't load")} />
          ) : board.data.backlog.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <InboxIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("The backlog is empty")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t("Every open work order has a slot.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              {newWorkOrder ? (
                <EmptyContent>{newWorkOrder}</EmptyContent>
              ) : null}
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Job")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Address")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Priority")}</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {board.data.backlog.map((order) => (
                  <TableRow key={order.id}>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm font-medium">
                      {order.title}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {order.address ?? ""}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <WorkOrderPriorityBadge priority={order.priority} />
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Technician day

A technician's stops for the day in route order, each with the button that moves it on. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [dispatch block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/dispatch) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add dispatch`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/technician-day.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/field/components/technician-day.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the caller's stops for a day in route order, each
 * with the button that moves it on. `?day=YYYY-MM-DD` picks the day.
 */
export async function TechnicianDay({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, format, query] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("field"),
    getFormatter(),
    searchParams,
    connection(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "dispatch.work")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const day = dayOf(query["day"]);
  const plan = await settle(() => loadTechnicianDay(day.toString()));

  if (plan.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const title = format.dateTime(new Date(`${day.toString()}T12:00:00Z`), {
    dateStyle: "full",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  });

  const time = (instant: string | null) =>
    instant ? format.dateTime(new Date(instant), { timeStyle: "short" }) : null;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="technician-day">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{title}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {plan.kind === "ok" && plan.data.planned
            ? t("Your stops in the order of the planned route.")
            : t("Your stops by start time.")}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/field/day?day=${day.subtract({ days: 1 }).toString()}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
            aria-label={t("Previous day")}
          >
            <ChevronLeftIcon />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/field/day?day=${day.add({ days: 1 }).toString()}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
            aria-label={t("Next day")}
          >
            <ChevronRightIcon />
          </Link>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {plan.kind === "error" ? (
          <FieldLoadError title={t("Your day didn't load")} />
        ) : plan.data.stops.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <RouteIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No stops on this day")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Work orders scheduled for you show here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Link
                href={`/field/day?day=${day.add({ days: 1 }).toString()}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
              >
                {t("Show the next day")}
              </Link>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ol className="flex flex-col divide-y">
            {plan.data.stops.map(({ position, workOrder }) => {
              const next = nextStep(workOrder.status);
              const from = time(workOrder.startsAt);
              const to = time(workOrder.endsAt);

              return (
                <li
                  key={workOrder.id}
                  className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 py-3"
                >
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="tabular-nums">
                    {position}
                  </Badge>
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      {workOrder.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {[
                        from && to ? t("{from} to {to}", { from, to }) : from,
                        workOrder.address,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(" · ")}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <WorkOrderStatusBadge status={workOrder.status} />
                  {next ? (
                    <AdvanceWorkOrderButton id={workOrder.id} to={next} />
                  ) : null}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Shipment tracking

Shipments with their status and the tracking timeline of the selected one, newest event first. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [shipments block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/shipments) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add shipments`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/shipment-tracking.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card dialog empty field input skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/field/components/shipment-tracking.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the latest shipments with their status, and the
 * tracking timeline of the selected one, newest event first. `?shipment=<id>`
 * picks the shipment.
 */
export async function ShipmentTracking({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, t, format, query] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("field"),
    getFormatter(),
    searchParams,
    connection(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "shipments.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const picked = v.safeParse(ShipmentParam, query["shipment"]);

  const tracking = await settle(() =>
    loadShipmentTracking(picked.success ? picked.output : undefined),
  );

  if (tracking.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const newShipment = can(session, "shipments.manage") ? (
    <NewShipmentDialog />
  ) : null;

  const selected = tracking.kind === "ok" ? tracking.data.selected : null;

  return (
    <div data-recipe="shipment-tracking" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Shipments")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t("The status follows the latest tracking event.")}
          </CardDescription>
          {newShipment ? <CardAction>{newShipment}</CardAction> : null}
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {tracking.kind === "error" ? (
            <FieldLoadError title={t("The shipments didn't load")} />
          ) : tracking.data.shipments.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <PackageIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No shipments yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t("Create a shipment, then buy its label from a carrier.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              {newShipment ? <EmptyContent>{newShipment}</EmptyContent> : null}
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Reference")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Recipient")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Destination")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Tracking number")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {tracking.data.shipments.map((shipment) => (
                  <TableRow
                    key={shipment.id}
                    data-state={
                      shipment.id === selected?.id ? "selected" : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    <TableCell>
                      <Link
                        href={`/field/shipments?shipment=${shipment.id}`}
                        className="text-sm font-medium underline-offset-4 transition-colors hover:underline"
                        aria-current={
                          shipment.id === selected?.id ? "true" : undefined
                        }
                      >
                        {shipment.reference}
                      </Link>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm">
                      {shipment.recipient}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {shipment.destination}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm tabular-nums">
                      {shipment.trackingNumber ?? ""}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <ShipmentStatusBadge status={shipment.status} />
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      {tracking.kind === "ok" && selected ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              {t("Tracking for {reference}", { reference: selected.reference })}
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {selected.carrier
                ? t("Events from {carrier}, newest first.", {
                    carrier: selected.carrier,
                  })
                : t("Events show once the shipment has a label.")}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {tracking.data.timeline.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <TruckIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No tracking events yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {t(
                      "The carrier's webhook adds events as the package moves.",
                    )}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyContent>
                  <Link
                    href={`/field/shipments?shipment=${selected.id}`}
                    className="text-sm font-medium underline-offset-4 transition-colors hover:underline"
                  >
                    {t("Check again")}
                  </Link>
                </EmptyContent>
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <ol className="flex flex-col divide-y">
                {tracking.data.timeline.map((step) => (
                  <li
                    key={step.id}
                    className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 py-3"
                  >
                    <ShipmentStatusBadge status={step.status} />
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
                      <span className="text-sm">
                        {step.description ?? step.location ?? ""}
                      </span>
                      {step.description && step.location ? (
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {step.location}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(step.occurredAt), {
                        dateStyle: "medium",
                        timeStyle: "short",
                      })}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Invoices table

The organization's invoices with their status, amount and a link to the PDF. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [invoices block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/invoices) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add invoices`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/invoices-table.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/billing/components/invoices-table.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's invoices with their status,
 * total and what's still owed. Renders nothing without `invoices.read`, so the
 * billing page still shows the plan.
 */
export async function InvoicesTable() {
  const session = await getSession();

  if (!can(session, "invoices.read")) {
    return null;
  }

  const [list, t, format, locale] = await Promise.all([
    getInvoices(),
    getExtracted("billing"),
    getFormatter(),
    getLocale(),
  ]);

  if (list.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canWrite = can(session, "invoices.write");

  const status = (value: InvoiceStatus, overdue: boolean) => {
    if (overdue) {
      return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Overdue")}</Badge>;
    }

    switch (value) {
      case "draft": {
        return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Draft")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "issued": {
        return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Issued")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "partially_paid": {
        return <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Partly paid")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "paid": {
        return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Paid")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "void": {
        return <Badge variant="outline">{t("Void")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "uncollectible": {
        return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Uncollectible")}</Badge>;
      }

      default: {
        const unknown: never = value;

        return unknown;
      }
    }
  };

  const hasInvoices = list.kind === "ok" && list.invoices.length > 0;

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="invoices-table">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Invoices")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Every invoice for this organization, newest first.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {hasInvoices && canWrite ? (
          <CardAction>
            <CreateDraftInvoiceDialog variant="outline" />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {list.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The invoices didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : list.invoices.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <FileTextIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No invoices yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Invoices show up here once they're created.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canWrite ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreateDraftInvoiceDialog />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Invoice")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Due")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Total")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Owed")}</TableHead>
                {canWrite ? (
                  <TableHead>
                    <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
                  </TableHead>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {list.invoices.map((invoice) => (
                <TableRow key={invoice.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <span className="text-sm">{invoice.title}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {invoice.identifier ?? t("No number yet")}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    {status(invoice.status, invoice.overdue)}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                    {invoice.dueOn
                      ? format.dateTime(new Date(invoice.dueOn), {
                          dateStyle: "medium",
                          timeZone: "UTC",
                        })
                      : t("Not issued")}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {formatMoney(invoice.total, locale)}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {formatMoney(invoice.balance, locale)}
                  </TableCell>
                  {canWrite ? (
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {invoice.status === "draft" ? (
                        <IssueInvoiceButton invoiceId={invoice.id} />
                      ) : null}
                    </TableCell>
                  ) : null}
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Product catalog grid

Products in a grid with prices, variants and a filter by collection. Web, with shadcn components:

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/product-catalog-grid.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's products as cards. */
export async function ProductCatalogGrid() {
  const session = await getSession();

  if (!can(session, "catalog.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const [products, t, locale] = await Promise.all([
    getProducts(),
    getExtracted("shop"),
    getLocale(),
  ]);

  if (products.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canManage = can(session, "catalog.manage");

  const status = (product: Product) => {
    switch (product.status) {
      case "active": {
        return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "draft": {
        return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Draft")}</Badge>;
      }

      case "archived": {
        return <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Archived")}</Badge>;
      }

      default: {
        const unknown: never = product.status;

        return unknown;
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div data-recipe="product-catalog-grid" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {products.kind === "error" ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <TriangleAlertIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{t("The products didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
          <AlertAction>
            <form action={retry}>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </AlertAction>
        </Alert>
      ) : products.data.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty className="border">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <PackageIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("No products yet")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t("Add a product with a price to start taking orders.")}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          {canManage ? (
            <EmptyContent>
              <CreateProductDialog />
            </EmptyContent>
          ) : null}
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("{count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}", {
                count: products.data.length,
              })}
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {can(session, "promotions.manage") ? (
                <CreatePromotionCodeDialog />
              ) : null}
              {canManage ? <CreateProductDialog variant="outline" /> : null}
            </div>
          </div>
          <ul className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            {products.data.map((product) => (
              <li key={product.id}>
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle>{product.title}</CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription className="font-mono">
                      {product.sku}
                    </CardDescription>
                    <CardAction>{status(product)}</CardAction>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums">
                      {product.price
                        ? formatMoney(product.price, locale)
                        : t("No price")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {product.available === null
                        ? t("Not stocked")
                        : t("{count, number} available", {
                            count: product.available,
                          })}
                    </span>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/inventory-table.tsx"
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No stock locations yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Stock is counted per location. Add one to start.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canManage ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreateLocationButton />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : stock.data.levels.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <BoxesIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No products to count")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Products from the catalog show up here with their stock.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Link href="/shop" className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })}>
                {t("Go to the catalog")}
              </Link>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Product")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Location")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("On hand")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Reserved")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Available")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>
                  <span className="sr-only">{t("Status")}</span>
                </TableHead>
                {canManage ? (
                  <TableHead>
                    <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
                  </TableHead>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {stock.data.levels.map((level) => {
                const location = locationName.get(level.locationId) ?? "";

                return (
                  <TableRow key={`${level.variantId}:${level.locationId}`}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                        <span className="text-sm">{level.productTitle}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {level.sku}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{location}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                      {level.onHand}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                      {level.reserved}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                      {level.available}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {level.available <= 0 ? (
                        <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                          {t("Out of stock")}
                        </Badge>
                      ) : level.reorderPoint !== null &&
                        level.available <= level.reorderPoint ? (
                        <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Low")}</Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="success-light">{t("In stock")}</Badge>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    {canManage ? (
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <AdjustStockDialog
                          variantId={level.variantId}
                          locationId={level.locationId}
                          label={`${level.productTitle} (${level.sku}), ${location}`}
                        />
                      </TableCell>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Order detail

An order with its lines, totals, payment state and fulfillment steps. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [orders block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/orders) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add orders`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/order-detail.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/order-detail.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: a placed order, or the caller's draft (an open
 * cart) with the same id, with its lines, totals and next steps.
 */
export async function OrderDetail({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const [{ id }, session] = await Promise.all([params, getSession()]);

  if (!can(session, "orders.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const [detail, t, format, locale] = await Promise.all([
    getOrderDetail(id),
    getExtracted("shop"),
    getFormatter(),
    getLocale(),
  ]);

  if (detail.kind === "not-found") {
    notFound();
  }

  if (detail.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="order-detail">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The order didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const view = detail.data;
  const canManage = can(session, "orders.manage");
  const amount = (value: Money) => formatMoney(value, locale);

  const problemLabel = (problem: string) => {
    switch (problem) {
      case "shipping_required": {
        return t("Pick a shipping rate first.");
      }

      case "shipping_unavailable": {
        return t("No shipping rate covers this address.");
      }

      case "promotion_unavailable": {
        return t("A promotion code no longer applies.");
      }

      default: {
        return problem;
      }
    }
  };

  const totals: readonly (readonly [string, Money])[] = [
    [t("Subtotal"), view.subtotal],
    ...(view.discountTotal.amount > 0n
      ? [[t("Discount"), negateMoney(view.discountTotal)] as const]
      : []),
    ...(view.shippingTotal.amount > 0n
      ? [[t("Shipping"), view.shippingTotal] as const]
      : []),
    ...(view.kind === "order" && view.taxTotal.amount > 0n
      ? [[t("Tax"), view.taxTotal] as const]
      : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div data-recipe="order-detail" className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:col-span-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
              {view.kind === "order"
                ? t("Order {number}", { number: view.number })
                : t("Draft order")}
            </h1>
            <OrderStatusBadge
              status={view.kind === "order" ? view.status : "draft"}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {view.kind === "order"
              ? t("Placed {date}", {
                  date: format.dateTime(new Date(view.placedAt), {
                    dateStyle: "medium",
                    timeStyle: "short",
                  }),
                })
              : t(
                  "Not placed yet. Prices follow the catalog until you place it.",
                )}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Lines")}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {view.lines.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <ShoppingCartIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("This draft is empty")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {t("Add a product from the orders page.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>{t("Product")}</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">
                      {t("Quantity")}
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">
                      {t("Unit price")}
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Total")}</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {view.lines.map((line) => (
                    <TableRow key={line.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                          <span className="text-sm">{line.title}</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {line.sku}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {line.quantity}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {amount(line.unitAmount)}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {amount(line.total)}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
                <TableFooter>
                  {totals.map(([label, value]) => (
                    <TableRow key={label}>
                      <TableCell colSpan={3} className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {label}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {amount(value)}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell colSpan={3} className="font-medium">
                      {t("Total")}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right font-medium tabular-nums">
                      {amount(view.total)}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                  {view.kind === "order" ? (
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell colSpan={3} className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("Paid")}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {amount(view.paidTotal)}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ) : null}
                </TableFooter>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Next step")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {view.kind === "draft"
                ? t(
                    "Placing the order reserves its stock and fixes its prices.",
                  )
                : t("Without a payments provider, record the payment by hand.")}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {view.kind === "draft" && view.problems.length > 0 ? (
              <Alert variant="warning">
                <TriangleAlertIcon />
                <AlertTitle>
                  {t("Check this draft before placing it")}
                </AlertTitle>
                <AlertDescription>
                  {view.problems.map(problemLabel).join(" ")}
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            ) : null}
            {canManage ? (
              view.kind === "draft" ? (
                <PlaceOrderButton
                  cartId={view.id}
                  disabled={view.lines.length === 0}
                />
              ) : (
                <OrderTransitions
                  orderId={view.id}
                  status={view.status}
                  fulfillments={view.fulfillments}
                />
              )
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("Ask an admin to move this order along.")}
              </p>
            )}
            {view.kind === "order" && view.fulfillments.length > 0 ? (
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {view.fulfillments.map((fulfillment, index) => (
                  <li
                    key={fulfillment.id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
                  >
                    <span>{t("Shipment {n, number}", { n: index + 1 })}</span>
                    {fulfillment.status === "delivered" ? (
                      <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Delivered")}</Badge>
                    ) : fulfillment.status === "shipped" ? (
                      <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Shipped")}</Badge>
                    ) : fulfillment.status === "cancelled" ? (
                      <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                        {t("Cancelled")}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Packing")}</Badge>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Promotions")}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {view.kind === "draft" && canManage ? (
              <PromotionCodeField
                cartId={view.id}
                applied={view.promotions.flatMap((promotion) =>
                  promotion.code
                    ? [
                        {
                          code: promotion.code,
                          name: promotion.name,
                          discount: promotion.discount,
                        },
                      ]
                    : [],
                )}
                canCreate={can(session, "promotions.manage")}
              />
            ) : view.promotions.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("No promotion was applied.")}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {view.promotions.map((promotion) => (
                  <li
                    key={promotion.code ?? promotion.name}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {promotion.code ? (
                        <Badge variant="success-light" className="font-mono">
                          {promotion.code}
                        </Badge>
                      ) : null}
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {promotion.name}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="tabular-nums">
                      {amount(negateMoney(promotion.discount))}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Kitchen display

Open tickets per kitchen station, each line moved from queued to served, refreshed over Realtime. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [orders block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/orders) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add orders`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/kitchen-display.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/kitchen-display.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the open tickets at one station, or at every
 * station, oldest first. Each ticket moves its lines to the next state, and the
 * page refreshes when a line changes anywhere in the kitchen.
 */
export async function KitchenDisplay({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [session, params] = await Promise.all([getSession(), searchParams]);

  if (!can(session, "orders.read") && !can(session, "orders.prepare")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const canPrepare =
    can(session, "orders.prepare") || can(session, "orders.manage");

  const [kitchen, t] = await Promise.all([
    getKitchen(
      v.is(StationParam, params["station"]) ? params["station"] : null,
    ),
    getExtracted("shop"),
  ]);

  if (kitchen.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (kitchen.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="kitchen-display">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The kitchen didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const { organizationId, stations, stationId, tickets } = kitchen.data;

  return (
    <div data-recipe="kitchen-display" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <KitchenLive organizationId={organizationId} />
      {stations.length > 1 ? (
        <nav aria-label={t("Stations")} className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <Link
            href="/shop/kitchen"
            aria-current={stationId === null ? "page" : undefined}
            className={buttonVariants({
              size: "sm",
              variant: stationId === null ? "secondary" : "ghost",
            })}
          >
            {t("All stations")}
          </Link>
          {stations.map((each) => (
            <Link
              key={each.id}
              href={`/shop/kitchen?station=${each.id}`}
              aria-current={stationId === each.id ? "page" : undefined}
              className={buttonVariants({
                size: "sm",
                variant: stationId === each.id ? "secondary" : "ghost",
              })}
            >
              {each.name}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
      ) : null}
      {tickets.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty className="border">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <ChefHatIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("No open tickets")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t(
                "Send a paid order to the kitchen and its lines show up here.",
              )}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyContent>
            <Link
              href="/shop/orders"
              className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })}
            >
              {t("Open orders")}
            </Link>
          </EmptyContent>
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {tickets.map((ticket) => (
            <KitchenTicket
              key={ticket.orderId}
              ticket={ticket}
              stationId={stationId}
              canPrepare={canPrepare}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Order state board

Today's kitchen orders in preparation-state columns; dragging an order forward moves all of its lines. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [orders block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/orders) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add orders`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/order-state-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge card @reui/kanban
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/order-state-board.tsx"
/**
 * The orders sent to the kitchen today, in a column for the state of their
 * least advanced line. Dragging a card to a later column moves every line of
 * the order up to that state; a move back or within a column puts the card
 * back. The parent keys it by the cards' states, so a refresh starts it from
 * the saved board.
 */
export function OrderStateBoard({
  cards,
  canPrepare,
}: {
  cards: readonly BoardCardView[];
  canPrepare: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("shop");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const label = usePreparationLabel();
  const [columns, setColumns] = useState(() => columnsOf(cards));
  const bump = useAction(bumpTicket);
  const byId = new Map(cards.map((card) => [card.orderId, card]));

  return (
    <div data-recipe="order-state-board">
      <Kanban
        value={columns}
        onValueChange={setColumns}
        getItemValue={(card) => card.orderId}
        onValueCommit={(_value, meta) => {
          if (meta.kind !== "item") {
            return;
          }

          const from = v.parse(StateSchema, meta.activeContainer);
          const to = v.parse(StateSchema, meta.overContainer);

          if (
            PREPARATION_STATES.indexOf(to) <= PREPARATION_STATES.indexOf(from)
          ) {
            setColumns(meta.previousValue);

            if (from !== to) {
              toast.warning(t("An order only moves forward on this board."));
            }

            return;
          }

          void bump
            .run({
              orderId: String(meta.event.active.id),
              state: to,
              stationId: null,
            })
            .then((result) => {
              if (!result.ok) {
                setColumns(meta.previousValue);
                toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
              }
            });
        }}
      >
        <KanbanBoard className="flex overflow-x-auto">
          {PREPARATION_STATES.map((state) => {
            const column = columns[state] ?? [];
            const count = column.length;

            return (
              <KanbanColumn
                key={state}
                value={state}
                className="w-72 shrink-0 gap-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-3"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <Badge variant={preparationBadgeVariant(state)}>
                    {label(state)}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">{count}</Badge>
                </div>
                <KanbanColumnContent value={state} className="min-h-16">
                  {column.map((card) => (
                    <KanbanItem
                      key={card.orderId}
                      value={card.orderId}
                      disabled={!canPrepare || bump.pending}
                    >
                      <KanbanItemHandle cursor={canPrepare}>
                        <OrderCard card={card} />
                      </KanbanItemHandle>
                    </KanbanItem>
                  ))}
                  {count === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("No orders here.")}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </KanbanColumnContent>
              </KanbanColumn>
            );
          })}
        </KanbanBoard>
        <KanbanOverlay>
          {({ value, variant }) => {
            const card =
              variant === "item" ? byId.get(String(value)) : undefined;

            return card ? <OrderCard card={card} /> : null;
          }}
        </KanbanOverlay>
      </Kanban>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Promotion code field

A field that checks a promotion code and shows the discount it gives. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [promotions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/promotions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add promotions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/promotion-code-field.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button dialog field input
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/shop/components/promotion-code-field.tsx"
export interface AppliedCode {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly discount: Money;
}

/**
 * Applies a promotion code to a draft order's cart. The block checks the code
 * (active, in its window, under its limits) and the cart's totals come back
 * with the discount, which the list below the field shows.
 */
export function PromotionCodeField({
  cartId,
  applied,
  canCreate,
}: {
  cartId: string;
  applied: readonly AppliedCode[];
  canCreate: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("shop");
  const locale = useLocale();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const form = useActionForm(applyPromotionCode, {
    onSuccess: (code) => {
      toast.success(t("{code} applied", { code }));
    },
  });

  const remove = useAction(removePromotionCode, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const error = form.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(form.error);

  return (
    <div data-recipe="promotion-code-field" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <form {...form.formProps}>
        <input type="hidden" name="cartId" value={cartId} />
        <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-code`}>
            {t("Promotion code")}
          </FieldLabel>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-code`}
              name="code"
              required
              maxLength={32}
              autoComplete="off"
              placeholder="WELCOME10"
              className="font-mono uppercase"
            />
            <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={form.pending}>
              {t("Apply")}
            </Button>
          </div>
          {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
        </Field>
      </form>
      {applied.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {applied.map((each) => (
            <li
              key={each.code}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="success-light" className="font-mono">
                  {each.code}
                </Badge>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{each.name}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="tabular-nums">
                  {formatMoney(negateMoney(each.discount), locale)}
                </span>
                <Button
                  size="icon-sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  aria-label={t("Remove {code}", { code: each.code })}
                  disabled={remove.pending}
                  onClick={() => {
                    void remove.run({ cartId, code: each.code });
                  }}
                >
                  <XIcon />
                </Button>
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {t("No code applied.")}
          </p>
          {canCreate ? <CreatePromotionCodeDialog /> : null}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Creates a percentage promotion with one code, to try the field with. */
export function CreatePromotionCodeDialog() {
  const t = useExtracted("shop");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const form = useActionForm(createPromotionCode, {
    onSuccess: (code) => {
      toast.success(t("{code} is ready to use", { code }));
      setOpen(false);
    },
  });

  const error = form.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(form.error);

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        form.reset();
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" />}>
        <TicketPercentIcon />
        {t("New promotion code")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form {...form.formProps} className="grid gap-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("New promotion code")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("A percentage off the whole order, with one code to enter.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-new-code`}>
                {t("Code")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-new-code`}
                name="code"
                required
                maxLength={32}
                autoComplete="off"
                defaultValue="WELCOME10"
                className="font-mono uppercase"
              />
              {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-percent`}>
                {t("Percent off")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-percent`}
                name="percent"
                required
                inputMode="decimal"
                defaultValue="10"
                className="w-24"
              />
              <FieldDescription>
                {t("Above 0 and at most 100, such as 12.5.")}
              </FieldDescription>
            </Field>
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
              {t("Create code")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

## Calendar view

A month and week calendar of events with a dialog to add one. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [calendar block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/calendar) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add calendar`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/calendar-view.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/calendar/components/calendar-view.tsx"
export async function CalendarView({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const session = await getSession();

  if (!can(session, "calendar.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const [t, format, query] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("calendar"),
    getFormatter(),
    searchParams,
    connection(),
  ]);

  const canWrite = can(session, "calendar.write");
  const canManage = can(session, "calendar.manage");
  const first = firstOfMonth(query["month"], "UTC");
  const weeks = weeksOf(first);
  const from = weeks[0]?.[0] ?? first;
  const until = (weeks.at(-1)?.[6] ?? first).add({ days: 1 });

  const month = await settle(() =>
    loadCalendarMonth(from.toString(), until.toString()),
  );

  const monthKey = (date: Temporal.PlainDate) =>
    date.toPlainYearMonth().toString();

  const label = (date: Temporal.PlainDate, options: DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(`${date.toString()}T12:00:00Z`), {
      ...options,
      timeZone: "UTC",
    });

  const byDay = new Map<string, MonthEvent[]>();

  if (month.kind === "ok") {
    for (const event of month.data.events) {
      byDay.set(event.day, [...(byDay.get(event.day) ?? []), event]);
    }
  }

  const today =
    month.kind === "ok"
      ? Temporal.Now.plainDateISO(month.data.tz).toString()
      : null;

  const calendars = month.kind === "ok" ? month.data.calendars : [];

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="calendar-view">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>
          {label(first, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {month.kind === "ok" && calendars.length > 0
            ? t("{count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} in view", {
                count: month.data.events.length,
              })
            : t("Events of your organization by day.")}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/calendar?month=${monthKey(first.subtract({ months: 1 }))}`}
            aria-label={t("Previous month")}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
          >
            <ChevronLeftIcon />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/calendar"
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}
          >
            {t("Today")}
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/calendar?month=${monthKey(first.add({ months: 1 }))}`}
            aria-label={t("Next month")}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
          >
            <ChevronRightIcon />
          </Link>
          {calendars.length > 0 ? <WorkingHoursDialog /> : null}
          {canWrite && calendars.length > 0 ? (
            <CreateEventDialog
              calendars={calendars}
              defaultDate={today ?? first.toString()}
            />
          ) : null}
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {month.kind === "error" ? (
          <CalendarLoadError title={t("The calendar didn't load.")} />
        ) : month.kind === "no-organization" || calendars.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <CalendarIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No calendar yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {month.kind === "no-organization"
                  ? t("Pick an organization to see its calendar.")
                  : t("Create the team calendar, then add events to it.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {month.kind === "ok" && canManage ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreateCalendarButton />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <div className="min-w-[42rem] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
              <div
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="grid grid-cols-7 border-b bg-muted/50"
              >
                {weeks[0]?.map((day) => (
                  <span
                    key={day.toString()}
                    className="px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    {label(day, { weekday: "short" })}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
              <ol
                aria-label={label(first, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}
                className="grid grid-cols-7"
              >
                {weeks.flat().map((day) => {
                  const key = day.toString();
                  const events = byDay.get(key) ?? [];
                  const outside = day.month !== first.month;

                  return (
                    <li
                      key={key}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex min-h-24 flex-col gap-1 border-e border-b p-1.5 [&:nth-child(7n)]:border-e-0",
                        outside && "bg-muted/30",
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className="sr-only">
                        {label(day, { dateStyle: "full" })}
                      </span>
                      <span
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={cn(
                          "text-xs",
                          outside ? "text-muted-foreground" : "font-medium",
                        )}
                      >
                        {key === today ? (
                          <Badge variant="default">{day.day}</Badge>
                        ) : (
                          day.day
                        )}
                      </span>
                      {events.slice(0, SHOWN_PER_DAY).map((event) => (
                        <span
                          key={event.key}
                          title={event.title}
                          className="truncate rounded-sm bg-primary/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-foreground"
                        >
                          {event.time ? (
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                              {event.time}{" "}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                          {event.title}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                      {events.length > SHOWN_PER_DAY ? (
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("{count} more", {
                            count: String(events.length - SHOWN_PER_DAY),
                          })}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ol>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Booking page

A public page that shows open slots and books one without overlaps. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [bookings block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/bookings) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add bookings`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/booking-page.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/bookings/components/booking-page.tsx"
/** The public page of a booking link: open slots for a week, then a form. */
export async function BookingPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ token: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const [{ token }, query, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    params,
    searchParams,
    getExtracted("bookings"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  const parsed = v.safeParse(v.pipe(v.string(), v.isoDate()), query["from"]);
  const from = parsed.success ? parsed.output : undefined;
  const page = await settle(() => loadPublicBooking(token, from));

  if (page.kind === "missing") {
    notFound();
  }

  if (page.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Card data-recipe="booking-page" className="w-full max-w-xl">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Book a time")}</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <BookingsLoadError title={t("The open times didn't load.")} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const { data } = page;

  const next = Temporal.PlainDate.from(data.from).add({ days: 7 }).toString();

  const days = data.days.map((day) => ({
    ...day,
    label: format.dateTime(new Date(`${day.date}T12:00:00Z`), {
      weekday: "long",
      day: "numeric",
      month: "long",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    }),
  }));

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="booking-page" className="w-full max-w-xl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{data.serviceName}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("{minutes} minutes with {host}. Times are in {tz}.", {
            minutes: String(data.minutes),
            host: data.hostName,
            tz: data.tz,
          })}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        {days.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <CalendarXIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No open times this week")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Look at the week after for an open time.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Link
                href={`/book/${token}?from=${next}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
              >
                {t("Next week")}
                <ChevronRightIcon />
              </Link>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <>
            <SlotPicker token={token} days={days} />
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Link
                href={`/book/${token}?from=${next}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
              >
                {t("Next week")}
                <ChevronRightIcon />
              </Link>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
