## Reminders list

The next events with the caller's reminders on each, to add a reminder at an offset before an event or remove one. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [reminders block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/reminders) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add reminders`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/reminders-list.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/calendar/components/reminders-list.tsx"
/**
 * The next events with the caller's reminders on each. A reminder fires its
 * offset before every occurrence of the event, once per occurrence.
 */
export async function RemindersList() {
  const session = await getSession();

  if (!can(session, "reminders.manage")) {
    return null;
  }

  const [t, format, upcoming] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("calendar"),
    getFormatter(),
    settle(loadUpcomingReminders),
    connection(),
  ]);

  if (upcoming.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const calendars = upcoming.kind === "ok" ? upcoming.data.calendars : [];

  const defaultDate = Temporal.Now.plainDateISO(
    calendars[0]?.tz ?? "UTC",
  ).toString();

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="reminders-list">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Upcoming reminders")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Get a notification before the events of the next two weeks.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {upcoming.kind === "error" ? (
          <CalendarLoadError title={t("Your reminders didn't load.")} />
        ) : upcoming.data.events.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <BellIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No events coming up")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Add an event, then set a reminder for it here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {calendars.length > 0 && can(session, "calendar.write") ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <CreateEventDialog
                  calendars={calendars}
                  defaultDate={defaultDate}
                />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {upcoming.data.events.map((event) => (
              <EventReminders
                key={event.id}
                eventId={event.id}
                title={event.title}
                when={format.dateTime(
                  new Date(event.startsAt),
                  event.allDay
                    ? { dateStyle: "medium" }
                    : { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" },
                )}
                reminders={event.reminders}
              />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Drive explorer

Folders and files with upload, rename, move and a breadcrumb trail, each file with its labels and the approval of its current version. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [drive block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/drive) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add drive`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/drive-explorer.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge breadcrumb button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/drive/components/drive-explorer.tsx"
import {
  FileIcon,
  FolderIcon,
  FolderOpenIcon,
  TriangleAlertIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";
import { Fragment } from "react";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

import type { DriveItem } from "../drive-queries";

import { getDriveFolder } from "../drive-queries";
import { DriveItemActions } from "./drive-item-actions";
import { CreateFolderDialog, UploadFileButton } from "./drive-toolbar";

type Approval = NonNullable<DriveItem["approval"]>;

const APPROVAL_BADGE: Record<
  Approval,
  ComponentProps<typeof Badge>["variant"]
> = {
  pending: "warning-light",
  approved: "success-light",
  rejected: "destructive-light",
  cancelled: "secondary",
  expired: "secondary",
};

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: one folder of the drive (the root for `null`). */
export async function DriveExplorer({
  folderId,
}: {
  folderId: Promise<string | null>;
}) {
  const [view, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    folderId.then(getDriveFolder),
    getExtracted("drive"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="drive-explorer">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The drive didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const current = view.crumbs.at(-1);

  const approvalLabels: Record<Approval, string> = {
    pending: t("Awaiting approval"),
    approved: t("Approved"),
    rejected: t("Rejected"),
    cancelled: t("Approval cancelled"),
    expired: t("Approval expired"),
  };

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="drive-explorer">
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Breadcrumb>
          <BreadcrumbList>
            <BreadcrumbItem>
              {current === undefined ? (
                <BreadcrumbPage>{t("My drive")}</BreadcrumbPage>
              ) : (
                <BreadcrumbLink render={<Link href="/drive" />}>
                  {t("My drive")}
                </BreadcrumbLink>
              )}
            </BreadcrumbItem>
            {view.crumbs.map((crumb) => (
              <Fragment key={crumb.id}>
                <BreadcrumbSeparator />
                <BreadcrumbItem>
                  {crumb.id === current?.id ? (
                    <BreadcrumbPage>{crumb.name}</BreadcrumbPage>
                  ) : (
                    <BreadcrumbLink
                      render={<Link href={`/drive/${crumb.id}`} />}
                    >
                      {crumb.name}
                    </BreadcrumbLink>
                  )}
                </BreadcrumbItem>
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </BreadcrumbList>
        </Breadcrumb>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <CreateFolderDialog parentId={view.folderId} />
          <UploadFileButton parentId={view.folderId} />
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {view.items.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <FolderOpenIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("This folder is empty")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Create a folder or upload a file to get started.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <UploadFileButton parentId={view.folderId} />
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Name")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Size")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Added")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-12">
                  <span className="sr-only">{t("Actions")}</span>
                </TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {view.items.map((item) => (
                <TableRow key={item.id}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                      {item.kind === "folder" ? (
                        <Link
                          href={`/drive/${item.id}`}
                          className="flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors hover:text-primary"
                        >
                          <FolderIcon className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          {item.name}
                        </Link>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <FileIcon className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          {item.name}
                          {item.approval === null ? null : (
                            <Badge variant={APPROVAL_BADGE[item.approval]}>
                              {approvalLabels[item.approval]}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.labels.length === 0 ? null : (
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {item.labels.map((label) => (
                            <Badge key={label.id} variant="outline">
                              {label.name}
                            </Badge>
                          ))}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                    {item.kind === "folder"
                      ? t("Folder")
                      : item.size === null
                        ? t("Uploading")
                        : t("{size} KB", {
                            size: format.number(item.size / 1024, {
                              maximumFractionDigits: 1,
                            }),
                          })}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                    {format.dateTime(new Date(item.createdAt), {
                      dateStyle: "medium",
                    })}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <DriveItemActions
                      id={item.id}
                      kind={item.kind}
                      name={item.name}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DriveExplorerSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Version history

The saved versions of a record with a diff and a button to restore one. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [versions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/versions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add versions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/version-history.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert alert-dialog badge button card dialog empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/version-history.tsx"
/**
 * Saved versions of the customer's name and KvK number, newest first. Each one
 * compares with the version before it and restores as a new version.
 */
export function VersionHistory({
  customerId,
  versions,
  canSave,
  canRestore,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  versions: Loaded<readonly VersionRow[]>;
  canSave: boolean;
  canRestore: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="version-history">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Version history")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Snapshots of the name and KvK number.")}
        </CardDescription>
        {canSave && versions.kind === "ok" && versions.data.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <SaveVersionButton customerId={customerId} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {versions.kind === "error" ? (
          <RecordLoadError title={t("The versions didn't load")} />
        ) : versions.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <HistoryIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No versions yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t(
                  "Save a version to keep the customer's details as they are now.",
                )}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canSave ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <SaveVersionButton customerId={customerId} />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <VersionList
            customerId={customerId}
            versions={versions.data}
            canRestore={canRestore}
          />
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function VersionList({
  customerId,
  versions,
  canRestore,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  versions: readonly VersionRow[];
  canRestore: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const format = useFormatter();

  const source = {
    manual: t("Saved"),
    auto: t("Automatic"),
    restore: t("Restored"),
  } as const satisfies Record<VersionRow["source"], string>;

  return (
    <ol className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="versions">
      {versions.map((version, index) => {
        const previous = versions[index + 1];

        return (
          <li
            key={version.id}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2"
          >
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                  {t("Version {number}", { number: String(version.number) })}
                </span>
                <Badge variant="secondary">{source[version.source]}</Badge>
              </div>
              <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {version.label ? `${version.label} · ` : ""}
                {format.dateTime(version.createdAt, {
                  dateStyle: "medium",
                  timeStyle: "short",
                })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {previous ? (
                <CompareDialog
                  fromId={previous.id}
                  toId={version.id}
                  fromNumber={previous.number}
                  toNumber={version.number}
                />
              ) : null}
              {canRestore && index > 0 ? (
                <RestoreButton
                  customerId={customerId}
                  versionId={version.id}
                  number={version.number}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}

function SaveVersionButton({ customerId }: { customerId: string }) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const save = useAction(snapshotCustomerVersions, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Version saved"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <Button
      size="sm"
      variant="outline"
      disabled={save.pending}
      onClick={() => {
        void save.run({ id: customerId, input: {} });
      }}
    >
      <HistoryIcon />
      {t("Save a version")}
    </Button>
  );
}

function CompareDialog({
  fromId,
  toId,
  fromNumber,
  toNumber,
}: {
  fromId: string;
  toId: string;
  fromNumber: number;
  toNumber: number;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const compare = useAction(compareCustomerVersions);

  const load = () => {
    void compare.run({ fromId, toId });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (open) {
          load();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" />}>
        {t("Compare")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>
            {t("Version {from} to {to}", {
              from: String(fromNumber),
              to: String(toNumber),
            })}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {t("What changed between the two versions.")}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {compare.error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The comparison didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={load}>
                {t("Retry")}
              </Button>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : compare.data === undefined || compare.pending ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
          </div>
        ) : compare.data.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("The two versions are the same.")}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="version-diff">
            {compare.data.map((operation) => (
              <li
                key={`${operation.op}:${operation.path}`}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 py-2 text-sm"
              >
                <ChangeBadge operation={operation} />
                <code className="text-xs">{operation.path}</code>
                {"value" in operation ? (
                  <span className="truncate">
                    {JSON.stringify(operation.value)}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogClose render={<Button />}>{t("Done")}</DialogClose>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ChangeBadge({ operation }: { operation: JsonPatchOperation }) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");

  switch (operation.op) {
    case "add": {
      return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Added")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "remove": {
      return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Removed")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "replace": {
      return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Changed")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "move":
    case "copy":
    case "test": {
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{operation.op}</Badge>;
    }

    default: {
      const unhandled: never = operation;

      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}

function RestoreButton({
  customerId,
  versionId,
  number,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  versionId: string;
  number: number;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const restore = useAction(restoreCustomerVersion, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Version restored"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger
        render={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={restore.pending} />}
      >
        {t("Restore")}
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>
            {t("Restore version {number}?", { number: String(number) })}
          </AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            {t(
              "The customer's name and KvK number go back to this version. The current details stay in the history.",
            )}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{t("Cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            onClick={() => {
              void restore.run({ customerId, versionId });
            }}
          >
            {t("Restore")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

/** The version history card while its rows load. */
export function VersionHistorySkeleton() {
  return <RecordCardSkeleton rows={3} />;
}
```

## Trash bin

Deleted records with buttons to restore them or delete them for good. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [trash block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/trash) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add trash`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/trash-bin.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/trash/components/trash-bin.tsx"
import { FolderOpenIcon, Trash2Icon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { can } from "@/features/user/user-permissions";
import { getSession } from "@/features/user/user-queries";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

import { getTrash } from "../trash-queries";
import { TrashItemActions } from "./trash-item-actions";

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: what was deleted, with Restore and Delete
 * forever.
 */
export async function TrashBin() {
  const [view, session, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getTrash(),
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("trash"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const kinds = new Map([
    ["customer", t("Customer")],
    ["drive_node", t("Drive item")],
  ]);

  const canPurge = can(session, "trash.manage");

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="trash-bin">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Deleted items")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Restore an item to put it back where it was, with everything deleted along with it.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {view.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The trash didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : view.items.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <Trash2Icon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("The trash is empty")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Items you delete in the drive or elsewhere show up here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Link href="/drive" className={buttonVariants()}>
                <FolderOpenIcon />
                {t("Open the drive")}
              </Link>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Item")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Type")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Deleted")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Removed for good")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Actions")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {view.items.map((item) => {
                const title = item.title ?? t("Untitled");

                return (
                  <TableRow key={item.id}>
                    <TableCell className="font-medium">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {title}
                        {item.count > 1 ? (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {t("and {count, number} more", {
                              count: item.count - 1,
                            })}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant="secondary">
                        {kinds.get(item.subjectType) ?? item.subjectType}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(item.trashedAt), {
                        dateStyle: "medium",
                        timeStyle: "short",
                      })}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {item.purgeAfter === null
                        ? t("Never")
                        : format.dateTime(new Date(item.purgeAfter), {
                            dateStyle: "medium",
                          })}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <TrashItemActions
                        id={item.id}
                        title={title}
                        canPurge={canPurge}
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function TrashBinSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Form builder

An editor for form fields and a preview, with the responses in a table. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [forms block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/forms) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add forms`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/form-builder.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/forms/components/form-builder.tsx"
import type { FormSubmissionStatus } from "better-supabase/blocks/forms";

import { InboxIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";

import type { AnswerCell } from "../forms-queries";

import { getForm } from "../forms-queries";
import { FormBuilderWorkspace } from "./form-builder-workspace";
import { FormStatusBadge } from "./form-status-badge";

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

const statusVariants = {
  draft: "secondary",
  submitted: "info-light",
  accepted: "success-light",
  rejected: "destructive-light",
} as const satisfies Record<FormSubmissionStatus, string>;

function answerText(
  cell: AnswerCell | undefined,
  yes: string,
  no: string,
): string {
  if (cell === undefined) {
    return "";
  }

  switch (cell.kind) {
    case "text": {
      return cell.text;
    }

    case "bool": {
      return cell.value ? yes : no;
    }

    default: {
      const unhandled: never = cell;

      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: a form's builder, preview and responses. */
export async function FormBuilder({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;

  const [view, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getForm(id),
    getExtracted("forms"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="form-builder">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The form didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const { form, version, fields, submissions } = view.data;

  const statusLabels: Record<FormSubmissionStatus, string> = {
    draft: t("Draft"),
    submitted: t("Submitted"),
    accepted: t("Accepted"),
    rejected: t("Rejected"),
  };

  return (
    <div data-recipe="form-builder" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{form.title}</h2>
        <FormStatusBadge status={form.status} />
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {version === null
            ? t("Not published yet")
            : t("Version {version, number}", { version })}
        </span>
      </div>
      <FormBuilderWorkspace formId={form.id} published={fields} />
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Responses")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t("{count, plural, one {# response} other {# responses}}", {
              count: submissions.length,
            })}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {submissions.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <InboxIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No responses yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t(
                    "Publish the form, then fill in the preview to add the first response.",
                  )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Submitted")}</TableHead>
                  {fields.map((field) => (
                    <TableHead key={field.key}>
                      {field.label ?? field.key}
                    </TableHead>
                  ))}
                  <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {submissions.map((submission) => (
                  <TableRow key={submission.id}>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(submission.createdAt), {
                        dateStyle: "medium",
                        timeStyle: "short",
                      })}
                    </TableCell>
                    {fields.map((field) => (
                      <TableCell key={field.key}>
                        {answerText(
                          submission.answers[field.key],
                          t("Yes"),
                          t("No"),
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant={statusVariants[submission.status]}>
                        {statusLabels[submission.status]}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export function FormBuilderSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-8 w-64" />
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Skeleton className="h-80 rounded-xl" />
        <Skeleton className="h-80 rounded-xl" />
      </div>
      <Skeleton className="h-48 rounded-xl" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Post board

A feedback board's posts ranked by votes, with an upvote toggle, the roadmap status, moderation state and a New post dialog. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [posts block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/posts) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add posts`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/post-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card dialog empty field input skeleton textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/community/components/post-board.tsx"
const statusVariants = {
  open: "outline",
  under_review: "info-light",
  planned: "primary-light",
  in_progress: "warning-light",
  done: "success-light",
  closed: "secondary",
} as const satisfies Record<PostStatus, string>;

const moderationVariants = {
  visible: null,
  pending: "warning-light",
  hidden: "destructive-light",
  removed: "destructive-light",
} as const satisfies Record<PostModeration, string | null>;

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: the board's posts, top voted first. */
export async function PostBoard() {
  const [view, session, t] = await Promise.all([
    getBoard(),
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("community"),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The board didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const board = view.data;

  if (board === null) {
    const manage = can(session, "posts.manage");

    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <MessageSquareTextIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No board yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {manage
              ? t("Open a feedback board where members post and vote on ideas.")
              : t("An admin opens the board your team posts on.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyContent>
          {manage ? (
            <CreateBoardButton />
          ) : (
            <Link href="/" className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}>
              {t("Back to the dashboard")}
            </Link>
          )}
        </EmptyContent>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const write = can(session, "posts.write");

  const statusLabels: Record<PostStatus, string> = {
    open: t("Open"),
    under_review: t("Under review"),
    planned: t("Planned"),
    in_progress: t("In progress"),
    done: t("Done"),
    closed: t("Closed"),
  };

  const moderationLabels: Record<PostModeration, string> = {
    visible: t("Visible"),
    pending: t("Awaiting review"),
    hidden: t("Hidden"),
    removed: t("Removed"),
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-medium">{board.name}</h2>
        {write ? <NewPostDialog boardId={board.id} /> : null}
      </div>
      {board.posts.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty className="border">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <MessageSquareIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("No posts yet")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t("Post the first idea for others to vote on.")}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          {write ? (
            <EmptyContent>
              <NewPostDialog boardId={board.id} />
            </EmptyContent>
          ) : null}
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {board.posts.map((post) => {
            const moderation = moderationVariants[post.moderation];

            return (
              <li key={post.id}>
                <Card size="sm">
                  <CardContent className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <VoteButton
                      postId={post.id}
                      score={post.score}
                      voted={post.vote > 0}
                      disabled={post.moderation !== "visible"}
                    />
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        {post.pinned ? (
                          <PinIcon
                            aria-label={t("Pinned")}
                            className="size-4 text-muted-foreground"
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                          {post.title}
                        </span>
                        <Badge variant={statusVariants[post.status]}>
                          {statusLabels[post.status]}
                        </Badge>
                        {moderation === null ? null : (
                          <Badge variant={moderation}>
                            {moderationLabels[post.moderation]}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {post.body ? (
                        <p className="line-clamp-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {post.body}
                        </p>
                      ) : null}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <MessageSquareIcon aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                          {t("{count} replies", {
                            count: String(post.replyCount),
                          })}
                        </span>
                        {post.locked ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <LockIcon aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                            {t("Locked")}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Course outline

A course's modules and lessons in rank order, with the caller's progress, certificate and an Enroll button. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [courses block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/courses) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add courses`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/course-outline.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty progress skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/courses/components/course-outline.tsx"
import type {
  CourseLessonKind,
  CourseStatus,
} from "better-supabase/blocks/courses";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

import {
  AwardIcon,
  CircleCheckIcon,
  CircleIcon,
  FileTextIcon,
  ListChecksIcon,
  PlayCircleIcon,
  TriangleAlertIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

import { getOutline } from "../courses-queries";
import { EnrollButton } from "./course-controls";

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

const statusVariants = {
  draft: "secondary",
  published: "success-light",
  archived: "outline",
} as const satisfies Record<CourseStatus, string>;

const kindIcons = {
  content: FileTextIcon,
  video: PlayCircleIcon,
  quiz: ListChecksIcon,
} as const satisfies Record<CourseLessonKind, LucideIcon>;

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: a course's modules, lessons and the caller's
 * progress.
 */
export async function CourseOutline({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ courseId: string }>;
}) {
  const { courseId } = await params;

  const [view, t] = await Promise.all([
    getOutline(courseId),
    getExtracted("courses"),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="course-outline">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The course didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const course = view.data;
  const learner = course.learner;

  const statusLabels: Record<CourseStatus, string> = {
    draft: t("Draft"),
    published: t("Published"),
    archived: t("Archived"),
  };

  const kindLabels: Record<CourseLessonKind, string> = {
    content: t("Reading"),
    video: t("Video"),
    quiz: t("Quiz"),
  };

  const next = course.modules
    .flatMap((module) => module.lessons)
    .find((lesson) => !lesson.done);

  return (
    <div data-recipe="course-outline" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{course.title}</h2>
            <Badge variant={statusVariants[course.status]}>
              {statusLabels[course.status]}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          {course.summary ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{course.summary}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        {learner === null ? (
          course.status === "published" ? (
            <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} />
          ) : null
        ) : next === undefined ? null : (
          <Link
            href={`/courses/${course.id}/lessons/${next.id}`}
            className={buttonVariants()}
          >
            <PlayCircleIcon />
            {t("Continue")}
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:col-span-2">
          {course.modules.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <ListChecksIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No lessons yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t("Lessons show up here once a manager adds them.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyContent>
                <Link
                  href="/courses"
                  className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}
                >
                  {t("All courses")}
                </Link>
              </EmptyContent>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            course.modules.map((module) => (
              <Card key={module.id}>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>{module.title}</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>
                    {t("{count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}", {
                      count: module.lessons.length,
                    })}
                  </CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ul className="divide-y">
                    {module.lessons.map((lesson) => {
                      const KindIcon = kindIcons[lesson.kind];

                      return (
                        <li
                          key={lesson.id}
                          className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2"
                        >
                          {lesson.done ? (
                            <CircleCheckIcon
                              className="size-4 text-success"
                              aria-label={t("Done")}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <CircleIcon
                              className="size-4 text-muted-foreground"
                              aria-label={t("Not done")}
                            />
                          )}
                          {learner === null ? (
                            <span className="flex-1 text-sm">
                              {lesson.title}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <Link
                              href={`/courses/${course.id}/lessons/${lesson.id}`}
                              className="flex-1 text-sm transition-colors hover:text-primary"
                            >
                              {lesson.title}
                            </Link>
                          )}
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            <KindIcon className="size-3.5" />
                            {kindLabels[lesson.kind]}
                          </span>
                          {lesson.minutes === null ? null : (
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {t("{minutes, number} min", {
                                minutes: lesson.minutes,
                              })}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {lesson.required ? null : (
                            <Badge variant="outline">{t("Optional")}</Badge>
                          )}
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ul>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Your progress")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {learner === null
                ? t("Enroll to track your progress.")
                : t("{done, number} of {total, number} lessons done", {
                    done: learner.completed,
                    total: learner.total,
                  })}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          {learner === null ? null : (
            <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <Progress
                value={
                  learner.total === 0
                    ? 0
                    : (learner.completed / learner.total) * 100
                }
                aria-label={t("Your progress")}
              />
              {learner.certificateCode === null ? null : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  <AwardIcon className="size-4 text-success" />
                  <span>{t("Certificate")}</span>
                  <code className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {learner.certificateCode}
                  </code>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CourseOutlineSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-8 w-64" />
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl lg:col-span-2" />
        <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
