## CSV import wizard

A stepper that uploads a CSV, maps its columns, validates the rows and imports them. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [imports block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/imports) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add imports`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/csv-import-wizard.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty field select @reui/stepper table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/imports/components/csv-import-wizard.tsx"
"use client";

import type { DbError } from "better-supabase";

import { parseCsv, suggestMapping } from "better-supabase/blocks/imports";
import { useAction } from "better-supabase/react";
import {
  ArrowLeftIcon,
  CheckIcon,
  FileSpreadsheetIcon,
  PlayIcon,
  RotateCcwIcon,
  UploadIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useReducer, useRef } from "react";

import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import {
  Stepper,
  StepperContent,
  StepperIndicator,
  StepperItem,
  StepperNav,
  StepperPanel,
  StepperSeparator,
  StepperTitle,
  StepperTrigger,
} from "@/components/reui/stepper";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { ImportOutcome, ImportPreview } from "../imports-actions";
import type { ColumnMapping, CustomerImportField } from "../imports-fields";

import { previewCustomerImport, runCustomerImport } from "../imports-actions";
import { CUSTOMER_IMPORT_FIELDS } from "../imports-fields";

const SKIP = "skip";
const MAX_BYTES = 500_000;

type Choice = CustomerImportField | typeof SKIP;

type Mapping = Readonly<Record<string, Choice>>;

const CHOICES: readonly Choice[] = [...CUSTOMER_IMPORT_FIELDS, SKIP];

interface CsvFile {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly text: string;
  readonly headers: readonly string[];
  readonly rowCount: number;
}

function isField(value: unknown): value is CustomerImportField | typeof SKIP {
  return (
    value === SKIP || CUSTOMER_IMPORT_FIELDS.some((field) => field === value)
  );
}

/** The mapping without skipped columns, as the server actions take it. */
function mappedOnly(mapping: Mapping): ColumnMapping {
  const result: Record<string, CustomerImportField> = {};

  for (const [header, field] of Object.entries(mapping)) {
    if (field !== SKIP) {
      result[header] = field;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

interface WizardState {
  readonly step: number;
  readonly file: CsvFile | null;
  readonly fileError: string | null;
  readonly mapping: Mapping;
  readonly preview: ImportPreview | null;
  readonly outcome: ImportOutcome | null;
  readonly failure: DbError | null;
}

type WizardEvent =
  | { readonly type: "step"; readonly step: number }
  | { readonly type: "reset" }
  | { readonly type: "file-error"; readonly message: string | null }
  | {
      readonly type: "loaded";
      readonly file: CsvFile;
      readonly mapping: Mapping;
    }
  | { readonly type: "map"; readonly header: string; readonly field: Choice }
  | { readonly type: "running" }
  | { readonly type: "previewed"; readonly preview: ImportPreview }
  | { readonly type: "ran"; readonly outcome: ImportOutcome }
  | { readonly type: "failed"; readonly error: DbError };

const INITIAL: WizardState = {
  step: 1,
  file: null,
  fileError: null,
  mapping: {},
  preview: null,
  outcome: null,
  failure: null,
};

function wizard(state: WizardState, event: WizardEvent): WizardState {
  switch (event.type) {
    case "step": {
      return { ...state, step: event.step };
    }

    case "reset": {
      return INITIAL;
    }

    case "file-error": {
      return { ...state, fileError: event.message };
    }

    case "loaded": {
      return { ...INITIAL, step: 2, file: event.file, mapping: event.mapping };
    }

    case "map": {
      return {
        ...state,
        mapping: { ...state.mapping, [event.header]: event.field },
      };
    }

    case "running": {
      return { ...state, failure: null };
    }

    case "previewed": {
      return { ...state, step: 3, preview: event.preview };
    }

    case "ran": {
      return { ...state, step: 4, outcome: event.outcome };
    }

    case "failed": {
      return { ...state, failure: event.error };
    }

    default: {
      const unhandled: never = event;

      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Imports customers from a CSV file in four steps: upload, map the columns,
 * preview the validated rows, then run the import and show what it created.
 */
export function CsvImportWizard() {
  const t = useExtracted("imports");
  const message = useErrorMessage();
  const inputId = useId();
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(wizard, INITIAL);
  const { step, file, fileError, mapping, preview, outcome, failure } = state;
  const previewAction = useAction(previewCustomerImport);
  const runAction = useAction(runCustomerImport);

  const fieldLabels: Record<Choice, string> = {
    name: t("Name"),
    status: t("Status"),
    kvk: t("KvK number"),
    skip: t("Don't import"),
  };

  const fieldItems = CHOICES.map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: fieldLabels[value],
  }));

  const mapped = Object.values(mapping).filter((field) => field !== SKIP);
  const nameMapped = mapped.includes("name");

  const duplicate = mapped.some(
    (field, index) => mapped.indexOf(field) !== index,
  );

  const reached = outcome ? 4 : preview ? 3 : file ? 2 : 1;

  const reset = () => {
    dispatch({ type: "reset" });
  };

  const choose = async (picked: File | undefined) => {
    dispatch({ type: "file-error", message: null });

    if (picked === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    if (picked.size > MAX_BYTES) {
      dispatch({
        type: "file-error",
        message: t("Pick a file smaller than 500 KB."),
      });

      return;
    }

    const text = await picked.text();
    const [headers = [], ...rows] = parseCsv(text);

    if (headers.length === 0 || rows.length === 0) {
      dispatch({
        type: "file-error",
        message: t("The file needs a header row and at least one row."),
      });

      return;
    }

    const suggested = suggestMapping(headers, CUSTOMER_IMPORT_FIELDS);
    const initial: Record<string, Choice> = {};

    for (const header of headers) {
      const field = suggested[header];

      initial[header] = isField(field) ? field : SKIP;
    }

    dispatch({
      type: "loaded",
      file: { name: picked.name, text, headers, rowCount: rows.length },
      mapping: initial,
    });
  };

  const runPreview = async () => {
    if (file === null) {
      return;
    }

    dispatch({ type: "running" });

    const result = await previewAction.run({
      csv: file.text,
      mapping: mappedOnly(mapping),
    });

    if (result.ok) {
      dispatch({ type: "previewed", preview: result.data });
    } else {
      dispatch({ type: "failed", error: result.error });
    }
  };

  const runImport = async () => {
    if (file === null) {
      return;
    }

    dispatch({ type: "running" });

    const result = await runAction.run({
      csv: file.text,
      mapping: mappedOnly(mapping),
    });

    if (result.ok) {
      dispatch({ type: "ran", outcome: result.data });
    } else {
      dispatch({ type: "failed", error: result.error });
    }
  };

  const failureAlert = failure ? (
    <Alert variant="destructive">
      <AlertTitle>{t("That didn't work")}</AlertTitle>
      <AlertDescription className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
        {message(failure)}
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          disabled={previewAction.pending || runAction.pending}
          onClick={() => {
            void (step === 3 ? runImport() : runPreview());
          }}
        >
          <RotateCcwIcon />
          {t("Retry")}
        </Button>
      </AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  ) : null;

  const steps = [
    { step: 1, title: t("Upload") },
    { step: 2, title: t("Map columns") },
    { step: 3, title: t("Preview") },
    { step: 4, title: t("Results") },
  ];

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="csv-import-wizard">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Import customers")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Upload a CSV file with a name column, and optionally status and KvK number.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Stepper
          value={step}
          onValueChange={(next) => {
            dispatch({ type: "step", step: next });
          }}
          className="flex flex-col gap-6"
        >
          <StepperNav>
            {steps.map((item) => (
              <StepperItem
                key={item.step}
                step={item.step}
                disabled={item.step > reached || outcome !== null}
              >
                <StepperTrigger className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <StepperIndicator>{item.step}</StepperIndicator>
                  <StepperTitle>{item.title}</StepperTitle>
                </StepperTrigger>
                {item.step < steps.length ? <StepperSeparator /> : null}
              </StepperItem>
            ))}
          </StepperNav>
          <StepperPanel>
            <StepperContent value={1}>
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <FileSpreadsheetIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>
                    {file ? file.name : t("Choose a CSV file")}
                  </EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {file
                      ? t("{count, plural, =1 {# row} other {# rows}}", {
                          count: file.rowCount,
                        })
                      : t("The first row names the columns.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyContent>
                  <input
                    ref={fileInput}
                    id={inputId}
                    type="file"
                    accept=".csv,text/csv"
                    className="sr-only"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      void choose(event.target.files?.[0]);
                      event.target.value = "";
                    }}
                  />
                  <Button onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()}>
                    <UploadIcon />
                    {file ? t("Choose another file") : t("Choose file")}
                  </Button>
                  {fileError ? (
                    <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{fileError}</p>
                  ) : null}
                </EmptyContent>
              </Empty>
            </StepperContent>
            <StepperContent value={2} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {file?.headers.map((header) => (
                  <Field key={header}>
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${inputId}-${header}`}>
                      {header}
                    </FieldLabel>
                    <Select
                      value={mapping[header] ?? SKIP}
                      items={fieldItems}
                      onValueChange={(value) => {
                        if (isField(value)) {
                          dispatch({ type: "map", header, field: value });
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger
                        id={`${inputId}-${header}`}
                        className="w-full"
                      >
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {fieldItems.map((item) => (
                          <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                            {item.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                ))}
              </div>
              {nameMapped ? null : (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("Map one column to Name to continue.")}
                </p>
              )}
              {duplicate ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                  {t("Map each customer field to one column only.")}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              {failureAlert}
            </StepperContent>
            <StepperContent value={3} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              {preview ? (
                <>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Badge variant="success-light">
                      {t(
                        "{count, plural, =1 {# valid row} other {# valid rows}}",
                        { count: preview.valid },
                      )}
                    </Badge>
                    {preview.errors.length > 0 ? (
                      <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                        {t(
                          "{count, plural, =1 {# row with errors} other {# rows with errors}}",
                          { count: preview.errors.length },
                        )}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  {preview.errors.length > 0 ? (
                    <Alert variant="destructive">
                      <AlertTitle>
                        {t("Fix these rows and upload the file again")}
                      </AlertTitle>
                      <AlertDescription>
                        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                          {preview.errors.slice(0, 10).map((error) => (
                            <li key={error.row}>
                              {t("Row {row}: {message}", {
                                row: String(error.row),
                                message: error.message,
                              })}
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </AlertDescription>
                    </Alert>
                  ) : null}
                  {preview.rows.length > 0 ? (
                    <Table>
                      <TableHeader>
                        <TableRow>
                          <TableHead>{t("Name")}</TableHead>
                          <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                          <TableHead>{t("KvK number")}</TableHead>
                        </TableRow>
                      </TableHeader>
                      <TableBody>
                        {preview.rows.map((row, index) => (
                          // oxlint-disable-next-line react/no-array-index-key, react-doctor/no-array-index-as-key -- preview rows have no unique column and the list never reorders (1 finding)
                          <TableRow key={`${row.name}-${index}`}>
                            <TableCell className="font-medium">
                              {row.name}
                            </TableCell>
                            <TableCell>
                              {row.status === "active"
                                ? t("Active")
                                : t("Lead")}
                            </TableCell>
                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                              {row.kvk ?? t("None")}
                            </TableCell>
                          </TableRow>
                        ))}
                      </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                  ) : null}
                  {preview.valid > preview.rows.length ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("Showing the first {shown} of {total} rows.", {
                        shown: String(preview.rows.length),
                        total: String(preview.valid),
                      })}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </>
              ) : null}
              {failureAlert}
            </StepperContent>
            <StepperContent value={4}>
              {outcome ? (
                <Alert
                  variant={
                    outcome.status === "completed" ? "success" : "destructive"
                  }
                >
                  <AlertTitle>
                    {outcome.status === "completed"
                      ? t("Import finished")
                      : t("Import failed")}
                  </AlertTitle>
                  <AlertDescription className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
                    {outcome.status === "completed"
                      ? t(
                          "Created {imported, plural, =1 {# customer} other {# customers}}. Skipped {skipped, plural, =1 {# row} other {# rows}} whose name already exists.",
                          {
                            imported: outcome.imported,
                            skipped: outcome.skipped,
                          },
                        )
                      : t(
                          "No customers were created. Fix the rows and try again.",
                        )}
                    <Link
                      href="/customers"
                      className={buttonVariants({
                        variant: "outline",
                        size: "sm",
                      })}
                    >
                      {t("View customers")}
                    </Link>
                  </AlertDescription>
                </Alert>
              ) : null}
            </StepperContent>
          </StepperPanel>
        </Stepper>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-between gap-2">
        {step === 2 || step === 3 ? (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              dispatch({ type: "step", step: step - 1 });
            }}
          >
            <ArrowLeftIcon />
            {t("Back")}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <span />
        )}
        {step === 2 ? (
          <Button
            disabled={!nameMapped || duplicate || previewAction.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              void runPreview();
            }}
          >
            <CheckIcon />
            {previewAction.pending ? t("Checking") : t("Check rows")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {step === 3 ? (
          <Button
            disabled={
              preview === null ||
              preview.valid === 0 ||
              preview.errors.length > 0 ||
              runAction.pending
            }
            onClick={() => {
              void runImport();
            }}
          >
            <PlayIcon />
            {runAction.pending ? t("Importing") : t("Import customers")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {step === 4 ? (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={reset}>
            <RotateCcwIcon />
            {t("Import another file")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Templates gallery

Templates in a grid with a preview and a button to create a record from one. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [templates block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/templates) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add templates`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/templates-gallery.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/templates/components/templates-gallery.tsx"
import { LayoutTemplateIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getExtracted, getFormatter } from "next-intl/server";
import { refresh } from "next/cache";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { can } from "@/features/user/user-permissions";
import { getSession } from "@/features/user/user-queries";

import { getTemplates } from "../templates-queries";
import { CreateTemplateDialog } from "./create-template-dialog";
import { UseTemplateDialog } from "./use-template-dialog";

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/** The New template button, for members who may manage templates. */
export async function TemplateManagerActions() {
  const session = await getSession();

  return can(session, "templates.manage") ? <CreateTemplateDialog /> : null;
}

/** Render inside `<Suspense>`: the customer templates, each with Use template. */
export async function TemplatesGallery() {
  const [view, session, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getTemplates(),
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("templates"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (view.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const canApply =
    can(session, "templates.apply") && can(session, "customers.write");

  if (view.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="templates-gallery">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The templates didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (view.templates.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border" data-recipe="templates-gallery">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <LayoutTemplateIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No templates yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t(
              "A template holds the values a new customer starts with, so the team sets them up the same way.",
            )}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        {can(session, "templates.manage") ? (
          <EmptyContent>
            <CreateTemplateDialog />
          </EmptyContent>
        ) : null}
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      data-recipe="templates-gallery"
    >
      {view.templates.map((template) => (
        <Card key={template.id}>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{template.name}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t("Updated {date}", {
                date: format.dateTime(new Date(template.updatedAt), {
                  dateStyle: "medium",
                }),
              })}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {template.status === null ? null : (
              <Badge variant="info-light">
                {template.status === "active" ? t("Active") : t("Lead")}
              </Badge>
            )}
            {template.publishedVersion === null ? (
              <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Not published")}</Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge variant="outline">
                {t("Version {version}", {
                  version: String(template.publishedVersion),
                })}
              </Badge>
            )}
            {template.scope === "system" ? (
              <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Built in")}</Badge>
            ) : null}
            {template.isDefault ? (
              <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Default")}</Badge>
            ) : null}
          </CardContent>
          <CardFooter>
            <UseTemplateDialog
              templateId={template.id}
              templateName={template.name}
              disabled={!canApply || template.publishedVersion === null}
            />
          </CardFooter>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TemplatesGallerySkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-44 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-44 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-44 rounded-xl" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Document editor

A rich text editor for a document with autosave, collaborators and a suggestion mode that editors accept or reject. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [documents block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/documents) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add documents`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/document-editor.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty field input skeleton tabs textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/documents/components/document-editor.tsx"
"use client";

import type {
  DocumentSuggestion,
  Documents,
} from "better-supabase/blocks/documents";
import type {
  DocumentProviderMode,
  DocumentProviderStatus,
} from "better-supabase/yjs";

import { rpcTransport } from "better-supabase/blocks";
import { createDocuments } from "better-supabase/blocks/documents";
import { createDocumentProvider } from "better-supabase/yjs";
import { MessageSquareDiffIcon, TriangleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as Y from "yjs";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/reui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/reui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useSupabase } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

const DOCUMENT_NAME = "notes";
const LOCAL = Symbol("local edit");

/**
 * Replaces the text with `next` by deleting and inserting only the changed
 * middle, so an edit merges with another editor's edit elsewhere in it.
 */
function replaceText(text: Y.Text, next: string) {
  const current = text.toString();

  if (current === next) {
    return;
  }

  let start = 0;

  while (
    start < current.length &&
    start < next.length &&
    current[start] === next[start]
  ) {
    start += 1;
  }

  let end = 0;

  while (
    end < current.length - start &&
    end < next.length - start &&
    current[current.length - 1 - end] === next[next.length - 1 - end]
  ) {
    end += 1;
  }

  text.doc?.transact(() => {
    text.delete(start, current.length - start - end);
    text.insert(start, next.slice(start, next.length - end));
  }, LOCAL);
}

interface Editing {
  readonly title: Y.Text;
  readonly body: Y.Text;
}

interface DocumentTarget {
  readonly organizationId: string;
  readonly customerId: string;
  readonly customerName: string;
  readonly canWrite: boolean;
  readonly canSuggest: boolean;
}

type SuggestionsState =
  | { readonly kind: "loading" }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly items: readonly DocumentSuggestion[] };

function isMode(value: unknown): value is DocumentProviderMode {
  return value === "edit" || value === "suggest";
}

/**
 * The customer's notes as a Yjs document: a title and a body. Edits are stored
 * as updates through the documents block and reach the other editors over the
 * document's realtime topic.
 */
export function DocumentEditor(target: DocumentTarget) {
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);

  return (
    <DocumentSession
      key={attempt}
      {...target}
      onRetry={() => {
        setAttempt((current) => current + 1);
      }}
    />
  );
}

/** One connection to the document; Retry remounts it with fresh state. */
function DocumentSession({
  organizationId,
  customerId,
  customerName,
  canWrite,
  canSuggest,
  onRetry,
}: DocumentTarget & { readonly onRetry: () => void }) {
  const t = useExtracted("documents");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const editing = useRef<Editing | null>(null);

  const session = useRef<{
    readonly documents: Documents;
    readonly provider: ReturnType<typeof createDocumentProvider>;
  } | null>(null);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<DocumentProviderStatus>("connecting");
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [writable, setWritable] = useState(false);
  const [suggestable, setSuggestable] = useState(false);
  const [documentId, setDocumentId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<DocumentProviderMode>(
    canWrite ? "edit" : "suggest",
  );

  const [hasDraft, setHasDraft] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");

  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<SuggestionsState>({
    kind: "loading",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const doc = new Y.Doc();
    const texts = { title: doc.getText("title"), body: doc.getText("body") };

    const sync = () => {
      setTitle(texts.title.toString());
      setBody(texts.body.toString());
    };

    const documents = createDocuments({
      transport: rpcTransport(supabase),
      schema: blockConfig.documents.api,
    });

    const provider = createDocumentProvider({
      documents,
      client: supabase,
      doc,
      yjs: Y,
      ref: {
        organizationId,
        subjectType: "customer",
        subjectId: customerId,
        name: DOCUMENT_NAME,
      },
      mode: canWrite ? "edit" : "suggest",
      onStatus: setStatus,
    });

    texts.title.observe(sync);
    texts.body.observe(sync);
    editing.current = texts;
    session.current = { documents, provider };

    void provider.connect().then((opened) => {
      if (opened.ok) {
        setWritable(opened.data.canWrite);
        setSuggestable(opened.data.canSuggest);
        setDocumentId(opened.data.id);
        sync();
      } else {
        setFailed(true);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      texts.title.unobserve(sync);
      texts.body.unobserve(sync);
      editing.current = null;
      session.current = null;
      void provider.destroy();
      doc.destroy();
    };
  }, [supabase, organizationId, customerId, canWrite]);

  const loadSuggestions = useCallback(async () => {
    if (documentId === null || session.current === null) {
      return;
    }

    setSuggestions({ kind: "loading" });
    const listed = await session.current.documents.suggestions(documentId);

    setSuggestions(
      listed.ok ? { kind: "ok", items: listed.data } : { kind: "error" },
    );
  }, [documentId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadSuggestions();
  }, [loadSuggestions]);

  const statusLabels: Record<DocumentProviderStatus, string> = {
    connecting: t("Connecting"),
    synced: t("Saved"),
    offline: t("Offline"),
    closed: t("Closed"),
  };

  const editable = canWrite && writable;
  const suggesting = mode === "suggest" && canSuggest && suggestable;
  const readOnly = !(suggesting || (mode === "edit" && editable));

  const changeMode = (next: DocumentProviderMode) => {
    setMode(next);
    session.current?.provider.setMode(next);
  };

  const edit = (text: "title" | "body", value: string) => {
    if (editing.current) {
      replaceText(editing.current[text], value);
    }

    setHasDraft(session.current?.provider.hasDraft ?? false);
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    if (session.current === null) {
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const stored = await session.current.provider.submitSuggestion();
    setSubmitting(false);

    if (stored.ok) {
      setHasDraft(false);
      await loadSuggestions();
    }
  };

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="document-editor">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The document didn't open")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRetry}>
            {t("Retry")}
          </Button>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="document-editor">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <CardTitle>{t("Notes for {name}", { name: customerName })}</CardTitle>
          <Badge variant={statusVariant(status)}>{statusLabels[status]}</Badge>
        </div>
        <CardDescription>
          {readOnly
            ? t("You can read this document. Ask an admin for edit access.")
            : suggesting
              ? t("Your edits become a suggestion that an editor accepts.")
              : t("Changes save as you type and show up for everyone editing.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        {editable && canSuggest ? (
          <Tabs
            value={mode}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              if (isMode(value)) {
                changeMode(value);
              }
            }}
          >
            <TabsList>
              <TabsTrigger value="edit">{t("Editing")}</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="suggest">{t("Suggesting")}</TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
        ) : null}
        {status === "connecting" && title === "" && body === "" ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4" aria-busy="true">
            <Skeleton className="h-9 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-64 w-full" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-title`}>{t("Title")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-title`}
                value={title}
                readOnly={readOnly}
                maxLength={200}
                placeholder={t("Untitled")}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setTitle(event.target.value);
                  edit("title", event.target.value);
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-body`}>{t("Body")}</FieldLabel>
              <Textarea
                id={`${fieldId}-body`}
                value={body}
                readOnly={readOnly}
                rows={16}
                placeholder={t("Write the notes here.")}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setBody(event.target.value);
                  edit("body", event.target.value);
                }}
              />
              <FieldDescription>
                {t(
                  "Plain text. Everyone who can read the customer can read it.",
                )}
              </FieldDescription>
            </Field>
            {suggesting ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={!hasDraft || submitting}
                  onClick={() => {
                    void submit();
                  }}
                >
                  {t("Submit suggestion")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
        <SuggestionList
          state={suggestions}
          canDecide={editable}
          canSuggest={canSuggest && suggestable}
          onRetry={() => {
            void loadSuggestions();
          }}
          onSuggest={() => {
            changeMode("suggest");
          }}
          onDecide={async (suggestion, decision) => {
            if (session.current === null) {
              return;
            }

            const decided =
              decision === "accepted"
                ? await session.current.provider.acceptSuggestion(suggestion.id)
                : await session.current.documents.decideSuggestion(
                    suggestion.id,
                    "rejected",
                  );

            if (decided.ok) {
              await loadSuggestions();
            }
          }}
        />
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

interface SuggestionListProps {
  readonly state: SuggestionsState;
  readonly canDecide: boolean;
  readonly canSuggest: boolean;
  readonly onRetry: () => void;
  readonly onSuggest: () => void;
  readonly onDecide: (
    suggestion: DocumentSuggestion,
    decision: "accepted" | "rejected",
  ) => Promise<void>;
}

/** The open suggestions; editors accept them into the document or reject them. */
function SuggestionList({
  state,
  canDecide,
  canSuggest,
  onRetry,
  onSuggest,
  onDecide,
}: SuggestionListProps) {
  const t = useExtracted("documents");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (state.kind === "loading") {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-busy="true">
        <Skeleton className="h-5 w-32" />
        <Skeleton className="h-14 w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (state.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The suggestions didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRetry}>
            {t("Retry")}
          </Button>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (state.items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <MessageSquareDiffIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No open suggestions")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t("Suggested edits wait here until an editor accepts them.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        {canSuggest ? (
          <EmptyContent>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onSuggest}>
              {t("Suggest a change")}
            </Button>
          </EmptyContent>
        ) : null}
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-medium tracking-tight">{t("Suggestions")}</h3>
      <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
        {state.items.map((suggestion) => (
          <li
            key={suggestion.id}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-3"
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
              <span className="text-sm">
                {suggestion.summary ?? t("Suggested edit")}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {format.relativeTime(
                  new Date(suggestion.createdAt.epochMilliseconds),
                )}
              </span>
            </div>
            {canDecide ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  disabled={busy !== null}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setBusy(suggestion.id);
                    void onDecide(suggestion, "rejected").finally(() => {
                      setBusy(null);
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  {t("Reject")}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={busy !== null}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setBusy(suggestion.id);
                    void onDecide(suggestion, "accepted").finally(() => {
                      setBusy(null);
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  {t("Accept")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function statusVariant(
  status: DocumentProviderStatus,
): "success-light" | "warning-light" | "secondary" | "info-light" {
  switch (status) {
    case "synced": {
      return "success-light";
    }

    case "offline": {
      return "warning-light";
    }

    case "connecting": {
      return "info-light";
    }

    case "closed": {
      return "secondary";
    }

    default: {
      const unhandled: never = status;

      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}

## Webhook endpoints

The organization's webhook endpoints with their recent deliveries and a retry button. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [webhooks-out block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/webhooks-out) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add webhooks-out`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/webhook-endpoints.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/webhooks/components/webhook-endpoints.tsx"
type WebhooksState =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly overview: WebhooksOverview }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "no-organization" };

async function loadWebhooksState(): Promise<WebhooksState> {
  try {
    const overview = await loadWebhooks();

    return overview ? { kind: "ok", overview } : { kind: "no-organization" };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

type Translate = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getExtracted>>;

function DeliveryStatusBadge({
  status,
  t,
}: {
  status: WebhookStatus;
  t: Translate;
}) {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending": {
      return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Pending")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "delivering": {
      return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Delivering")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "succeeded": {
      return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Delivered")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "retrying": {
      return <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Retrying")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "dead": {
      return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Failed")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "canceled": {
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Canceled")}</Badge>;
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = status;

      return never;
    }
  }
}

function EndpointStatusBadge({
  endpoint,
  t,
}: {
  endpoint: WebhookEndpointRow;
  t: Translate;
}) {
  if (!endpoint.enabled) {
    return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Off")}</Badge>;
  }

  return endpoint.failingSince ? (
    <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Failing")}</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active")}</Badge>
  );
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's webhook endpoints and their
 * latest deliveries. Members with `webhooks.manage` add, toggle, test and
 * delete endpoints, and retry finished deliveries.
 */
export async function WebhookEndpoints() {
  const [session, state, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    loadWebhooksState(),
    getExtracted("webhooks"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, "webhooks.read")) {
    forbidden();
  }

  if (state.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const manage = can(session, "webhooks.manage");

  const firstEnabled =
    state.kind === "ok"
      ? state.overview.endpoints.find((endpoint) => endpoint.enabled)
      : undefined;

  const when = (iso: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

  return (
    <div data-recipe="webhook-endpoints" className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card data-testid="webhook-endpoints">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Webhook endpoints")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "URLs that receive this organization's events, signed with a secret only you and the receiver know.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
          {manage && state.kind === "ok" ? (
            <CardAction>
              <CreateWebhookDialog />
            </CardAction>
          ) : null}
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {state.kind === "error" ? (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <TriangleAlertIcon />
              <AlertTitle>{t("The webhooks didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
              <AlertAction>
                <form action={retry}>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                    {t("Retry")}
                  </Button>
                </form>
              </AlertAction>
            </Alert>
          ) : state.overview.endpoints.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <WebhookIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No endpoints yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {manage
                    ? t("Add a URL to start receiving events.")
                    : t("An admin can add a URL to receive events.")}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
              {manage ? (
                <EmptyContent>
                  <CreateWebhookDialog />
                </EmptyContent>
              ) : null}
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Endpoint")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Events")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                  {manage ? (
                    <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Actions")}</TableHead>
                  ) : null}
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {state.overview.endpoints.map((endpoint) => (
                  <TableRow key={endpoint.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                          {endpoint.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="max-w-xs truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {endpoint.url}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {endpoint.eventTypes.map((type) => (
                          <Badge
                            key={type}
                            variant="outline"
                            className="font-mono"
                          >
                            {type}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <EndpointStatusBadge endpoint={endpoint} t={t} />
                    </TableCell>
                    {manage ? (
                      <TableCell>
                        <WebhookEndpointActions
                          id={endpoint.id}
                          name={endpoint.name}
                          enabled={endpoint.enabled}
                        />
                      </TableCell>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      {state.kind === "ok" ? (
        <Card data-testid="webhook-deliveries">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Recent deliveries")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t(
                "The last 20 events sent to your endpoints. Failed deliveries retry with backoff.",
              )}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {state.overview.deliveries.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty className="border">
                <EmptyHeader>
                  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                    <SendIcon />
                  </EmptyMedia>
                  <EmptyTitle>{t("No deliveries yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                  <EmptyDescription>
                    {firstEnabled
                      ? t(
                          "Send a test event to {name} to check that it receives them.",
                          { name: firstEnabled.name },
                        )
                      : t("Deliveries show up here once an endpoint is on.")}
                  </EmptyDescription>
                </EmptyHeader>
                {manage && firstEnabled ? (
                  <EmptyContent>
                    <SendTestEventButton id={firstEnabled.id} />
                  </EmptyContent>
                ) : null}
              </Empty>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>{t("Event")}</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>{t("Attempts")}</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>{t("Response")}</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>{t("Created")}</TableHead>
                    {manage ? (
                      <TableHead className="text-right">
                        {t("Actions")}
                      </TableHead>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {state.overview.deliveries.map((delivery) => (
                    <TableRow key={delivery.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                          <span className="font-mono text-sm">
                            {delivery.eventType}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {delivery.endpointName}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <DeliveryStatusBadge status={delivery.status} t={t} />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="tabular-nums">
                        {delivery.attempt}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <span
                          className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                          title={delivery.lastError ?? undefined}
                        >
                          {delivery.responseStatus ?? "–"}
                        </span>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {when(delivery.createdAt)}
                      </TableCell>
                      {manage ? (
                        <TableCell className="text-right">
                          {delivery.status === "dead" ||
                          delivery.status === "canceled" ||
                          delivery.status === "retrying" ? (
                            <RedeliverButton id={delivery.id} />
                          ) : null}
                        </TableCell>
                      ) : null}
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function WebhookEndpointsSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-48 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" />
    </div>
  );
}

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/service-principals/components/service-principals-table.tsx"
type PrincipalsState =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly principals: readonly ServicePrincipalRow[] }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "no-organization" };

async function loadPrincipalsState(): Promise<PrincipalsState> {
  try {
    const principals = await loadServicePrincipals();

    return principals
      ? { kind: "ok", principals }
      : { kind: "no-organization" };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the machine identities workflows and webhooks run
 * as, with their role. Members with `service_principals.manage` add and disable
 * them. Members without `service_principals.read` see nothing.

export async function ServicePrincipalsTable() {
  const [session, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),

  if (!can(session, "service_principals.read")) {

        {manage && state.kind === "ok" ? (
          <CardAction>
            <CreateServicePrincipalDialog />
          </CardAction>

      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {state.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">

            <AlertAction>

            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">

              <EmptyTitle>{t("No service principals yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {manage
                  ? t("Add one so automations don't run as a person.")
                  : t("An admin can add one for automations.")}

            </EmptyHeader>
            {manage ? (

                <CreateServicePrincipalDialog />

                <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Created")}</TableHead>

                ) : null}

                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm">
                    {roles.get(principal.role) ?? principal.role}

                  <TableCell>
                    {principal.disabledAt ? (
                      <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Disabled")}</Badge>

                      <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active")}</Badge>

                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                      dateStyle: "medium",

                  {manage ? (
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {principal.disabledAt ? null : (

                          name={principal.name}
                        />
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  ) : null}
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/signing-keys/components/signing-keys-rotation.tsx"
type SigningKeysState =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly overview: SigningKeysOverview }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "no-organization" };

async function loadSigningKeysState(): Promise<SigningKeysState> {
  try {
    const overview = await loadSigningKeys();

    return overview ? { kind: "ok", overview } : { kind: "no-organization" };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's active signing key and the
 * retired ones still published, with a rotate button. The keys are service-role
 * only, so this checks `organization.update` before it reads.
 */
export async function SigningKeysRotation() {
  const [session, t] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("signingKeys"),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, SIGNING_KEYS_PERMISSION)) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const state = await loadSigningKeysState();

  if (state.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const rows =
    state.kind === "ok"
      ? [
          ...(state.overview.active
            ? [{ ...state.overview.active, active: true }]
            : []),
          ...state.overview.previous.map((key) => ({ ...key, active: false })),
        ]
      : [];

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="signing-keys-rotation">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Signing keys")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "The keys that sign this organization's tokens. Private keys stay in Vault; receivers check signatures against the published JWKS.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        {rows.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <RotateSigningKeyButton first={false} />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {state.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The signing keys didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <KeyRoundIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No signing key yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("Create one before the organization signs any tokens.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <RotateSigningKeyButton first />
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Key ID")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Algorithm")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {rows.map((key) => (
                <TableRow key={key.kid}>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{key.kid}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-sm">{key.algorithm}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    {key.active ? (
                      <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active")}</Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Previous")}</Badge>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function SigningKeysRotationSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}

Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/data-export-delete.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/privacy/components/privacy-settings.tsx"
/**
 * Data exports for the caller and, with `organization.export`, for the
 * organization, each with its status and a download. Owners schedule the
 * organization's deletion here; account deletion stays on the security page.
 */
export async function PrivacySettings() {
  const [t, format, result] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("privacy"),
    getFormatter(),
    loadSettings(),
  ]);

  if (result.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="data-export-delete">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("Your data settings could not be loaded")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={refreshPrivacy}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const { mine, organization, canDelete, purgeAfter } = result.data;

  const date = (value: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(value), {
      dateStyle: "medium",
      timeStyle: "short",
    });

  const statusLabel = (status: DataExportStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "pending": {
        return t("Queued");
      }

      case "running": {
        return t("Running");
      }

      case "ready": {
        return t("Ready");
      }

      case "failed": {
        return t("Failed");
      }

      default: {
        const unknown: never = status;

        return unknown;
      }
    }
  };

  const exportList = (
    rows: readonly ExportRow[],
    scope: "user" | "organization",
  ) =>
    rows.length === 0 ? (
      <Empty>
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <ArchiveIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No exports yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {scope === "user"
              ? t("Export a copy of everything stored about you.")
              : t("Export a copy of the organization's data.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyContent>
          <RequestExportButton scope={scope} />
        </EmptyContent>
      </Empty>
    ) : (
      <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y rounded-lg border">
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <li
            key={row.id}
            className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-3"
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                  {date(row.requestedAt)}
                </span>
                <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[row.status]}>
                  {statusLabel(row.status)}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {row.status === "failed"
                  ? (row.error ?? t("The export failed. Request a new one."))
                  : row.expiresAt
                    ? t("{count} files, available until {date}", {
                        count: String(row.files),
                        date: date(row.expiresAt),
                      })
                    : t("{count} files", { count: String(row.files) })}
              </span>
            </div>
            {row.status === "ready" ? (
              <DownloadExportButton id={row.id} />
            ) : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" data-recipe="data-export-delete">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Your data")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "Download your profile, notifications and everything else stored about you.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
          {mine.length > 0 ? (
            <CardAction>
              <RequestExportButton scope="user" variant="outline" />
            </CardAction>
          ) : null}
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>{exportList(mine, "user")}</CardContent>
      </Card>
      {organization ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Organization data")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t("Download every record the organization owns.")}
            </CardDescription>
            {organization.length > 0 ? (
              <CardAction>
                <RequestExportButton scope="organization" variant="outline" />
              </CardAction>
            ) : null}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>{exportList(organization, "organization")}</CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
      {canDelete || purgeAfter ? (
        <Card className="ring-destructive/30">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Delete organization")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t(
                "Disables the organization now and purges its data after a 30 day grace period.",
              )}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {purgeAfter ? (
              <Alert variant="destructive">
                <TriangleAlertIcon />
                <AlertTitle>{t("Deletion scheduled")}</AlertTitle>
                <AlertDescription>
                  {t("The organization's data is purged on {date}.", {
                    date: date(purgeAfter),
                  })}
                </AlertDescription>
                <AlertAction>
                  <CancelDeletionButton />
                </AlertAction>
              </Alert>
            ) : (
              <DeleteOrganizationButton />
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {t("To delete your own account, go to")}{" "}
        <Link
          href="/settings/security"
          className="text-foreground underline underline-offset-4"
        >
          {t("Security")}
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
