## Job runs table

The latest background job runs with their status, attempts and error, and a button to retry a failed run. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [queue block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/queue) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add queue`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/job-runs-table.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/jobs/components/job-runs-table.tsx"
type JobRunsState =
  | { readonly kind: "ok"; readonly runs: readonly JobRunRow[] }
  | { readonly kind: "error" }
  | { readonly kind: "no-organization" };

async function loadJobRunsState(): Promise<JobRunsState> {
  try {
    const runs = await loadJobRuns();

    return runs ? { kind: "ok", runs } : { kind: "no-organization" };
  } catch (error) {
    unstable_rethrow(error);

    return { kind: "error" };
  }
}

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

type Translate = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getExtracted>>;

function JobStatusBadge({ status, t }: { status: JobRunStatus; t: Translate }) {
  switch (status) {
    case "queued": {
      return <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Queued")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "scheduled": {
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Scheduled")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "running": {
      return <Badge variant="primary-light">{t("Running")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "retrying": {
      return <Badge variant="warning-light">{t("Retrying")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "succeeded": {
      return <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Succeeded")}</Badge>;
    }

    case "dead": {
      return <Badge variant="destructive-light">{t("Failed")}</Badge>;
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = status;

      return never;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's latest background jobs across
 * every queue, with a retry button on failed runs. Gated by `audit.read`, since
 * it reads with the database owner.
 */
export async function JobRunsTable() {
  const [session, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getSession(),
    getExtracted("jobs"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (!can(session, JOBS_PERMISSION)) {
    forbidden();
  }

  const state = await loadJobRunsState();

  if (state.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const when = (iso: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="job-runs-table">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Job runs")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Background work queued for this organization, newest first. Failed jobs retry with backoff before they stop.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        {state.kind === "ok" && state.runs.length > 0 ? (
          <CardAction>
            <EnqueueTestJobButton variant="outline" />
          </CardAction>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {state.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The job runs didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : state.runs.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <ListChecksIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No job runs yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t(
                  "Jobs are queued when the app hands work to the background, such as a webhook delivery or an import. Queue a test job to see one here.",
                )}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <EnqueueTestJobButton />
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Job")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Status")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Attempts")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Queued")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Finished")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Actions")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {state.runs.map((run) => (
                <TableRow key={`${run.queue}:${String(run.id)}`}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <span className="font-mono text-sm">{run.queue}</span>
                      <span
                        className="max-w-xs truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                        title={run.lastError ?? undefined}
                      >
                        {run.lastError ?? `#${String(run.id)}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <JobStatusBadge status={run.status} t={t} />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{run.attempts}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {when(run.enqueuedAt)}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {run.finishedAt ? when(run.finishedAt) : "–"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    {run.status === "dead" ? (
                      <RetryJobButton queue={run.queue} id={run.id} />
                    ) : null}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function JobRunsTableSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Team picker

A select of the caller's teams in the active organization, to scope a page or assign work. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [teams block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/teams) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add teams`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/team-picker.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button empty field input select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/work/components/team-picker.tsx"
/**
 * Scopes the page to one of the organization's teams through `?team=`. With no
 * teams yet, it offers to create one when the caller holds `teams.manage`.
 */
export function TeamPicker({
  teams,
  teamId,
  canManage,
}: {
  teams: readonly TeamOption[];
  teamId: string | null;
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("work");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [switching, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const form = useActionForm(createTeam, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Team created"));
    },
  });

  if (teams.length === 0) {
    const error = form.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(form.error);

    return (
      <Empty className="border" data-recipe="team-picker">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <UsersIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No teams yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {canManage
              ? t("Create a team to group work and filter the board by it.")
              : t("An admin can create teams to group work.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        {canManage ? (
          <EmptyContent>
            <form {...form.formProps} className="flex w-full items-end gap-2">
              <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-team-name`}>
                  {t("Team name")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input
                  id={`${fieldId}-team-name`}
                  name="name"
                  required
                  maxLength={80}
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
                {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
              </Field>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
                {t("Create team")}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </EmptyContent>
        ) : null}
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const items = [
    { value: ALL_TEAMS, label: t("All teams") },
    ...teams.map((team) => ({ value: team.id, label: team.name })),
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2" data-recipe="team-picker">
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" id={`${fieldId}-label`}>
        {t("Team")}
      </span>
      <Select
        value={teamId ?? ALL_TEAMS}
        items={items}
        disabled={switching}
        onValueChange={(value) => {
          const next = value ?? ALL_TEAMS;

          startTransition(() => {
            router.replace(
              next === ALL_TEAMS
                ? pathname
                : `${pathname}?team=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
            );
          });
        }}
      >
        <SelectTrigger className="w-48" aria-labelledby={`${fieldId}-label`}>
          <SelectValue />
        </SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
              {item.label}
            </SelectItem>
          ))}
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Contract renewals

Active contracts with their value, end date and notice deadline, the nearest deadline first, so a renewal is decided in time. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [contracts block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/contracts) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add contracts`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/contract-renewals.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/compliance/components/contract-renewals.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

const SOON_DAYS = 30;

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: the organization's active contracts, the nearest
 * notice deadline first, so the team decides on a renewal before the
 * counterparty's notice period runs out.
 */
export async function ContractRenewals() {
  const [state, t, format, locale] = await Promise.all([
    getRenewals(),
    getExtracted("compliance"),
    getFormatter(),
    getLocale(),
  ]);

  if (state.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  const day = (date: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(date), { dateStyle: "medium", timeZone: "UTC" });

  const renewal = (row: RenewalRow) => {
    const days = row.noticeInDays;

    if (days === null) {
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{t("No end date")}</Badge>;
    }

    if (days < 0) {
      return (
        <Badge variant="destructive-light">
          {row.autoRenew ? t("Renews, notice passed") : t("Notice passed")}
        </Badge>
      );
    }

    if (days <= SOON_DAYS) {
      return (
        <Badge variant="warning-light">
          {t("Notice in {days, number} days", { days })}
        </Badge>
      );
    }

    return row.autoRenew ? (
      <Badge variant="info-light">{t("Auto-renews")}</Badge>
    ) : (
      <Badge variant="success-light">{t("Active")}</Badge>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="contract-renewals">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Contract renewals")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Active contracts, the nearest notice deadline first. A contract that auto-renews extends itself unless someone gives notice before the deadline.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {state.kind === "error" ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <TriangleAlertIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{t("The contracts didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
            <AlertAction>
              <form action={retry}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </form>
            </AlertAction>
          </Alert>
        ) : state.data.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <FileSignatureIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No active contracts")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t(
                  "A contract becomes active once every signer has signed. Draft one from a customer's record.",
                )}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Link href="/customers" className={buttonVariants()}>
                {t("Open customers")}
              </Link>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("Contract")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("Value")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Ends")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Notice by")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("Renewal")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {state.data.map((row) => (
                <TableRow key={row.id}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{row.title}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                    {row.value
                      ? formatMoney(moneyFromJson(row.value), locale)
                      : "–"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {row.endsOn ? day(row.endsOn) : "–"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {row.noticeDeadline ? day(row.noticeDeadline) : "–"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{renewal(row)}</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function ContractRenewalsSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Control posture

One card per compliance framework with its passing, failing and not started controls, then the overdue evidence tasks. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [compliance block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/compliance) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add compliance`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/control-posture.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty progress skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/compliance/components/control-posture.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: one card per compliance framework with how many
 * of its controls pass, then the evidence tasks that are past their due date.
 */
export async function ControlPosture() {
  const [state, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getPosture(),
    getExtracted("compliance"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  if (state.kind === "no-organization") {
    return null;
  }

  if (state.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="control-posture">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The control posture didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const { frameworks, overdue } = state.data;

  if (frameworks.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border" data-recipe="control-posture">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <ShieldCheckIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("No frameworks yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t(
              "Add a framework such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with the controls block, then link evidence to each control.",
            )}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyContent>
          <a
            className="text-sm underline underline-offset-4"
            href="https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/compliance"
          >
            {t("Read the controls guide")}
          </a>
        </EmptyContent>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const day = (date: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(date), { dateStyle: "medium", timeZone: "UTC" });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" data-recipe="control-posture">
      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        {frameworks.map((framework) => {
          const applicable = framework.total - framework.notApplicable;

          const percent =
            applicable === 0
              ? 100
              : Math.round((framework.passing / applicable) * 100);

          return (
            <Card key={framework.frameworkId}>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>{framework.name}</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  {t(
                    "{passing, number} of {applicable, number} controls passing",
                    { passing: framework.passing, applicable },
                  )}
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                <Progress value={percent} aria-label={t("Controls passing")} />
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="success-light">
                    {t("{count, number} passing", { count: framework.passing })}
                  </Badge>
                  {framework.failing > 0 ? (
                    <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                      {t("{count, number} failing", {
                        count: framework.failing,
                      })}
                    </Badge>
                  ) : null}
                  {framework.notStarted > 0 ? (
                    <Badge variant="secondary">
                      {t("{count, number} not started", {
                        count: framework.notStarted,
                      })}
                    </Badge>
                  ) : null}
                  {framework.overdueTasks > 0 ? (
                    <Badge variant="warning-light">
                      {t("{count, number} overdue tasks", {
                        count: framework.overdueTasks,
                      })}
                    </Badge>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Overdue evidence")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "Recurring tasks whose evidence is past due. Collecting evidence moves the task to its next due date.",
            )}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {overdue.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("Every evidence task is on schedule.")}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>{t("Task")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Control")}</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>{t("Due")}</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {overdue.map((task) => (
                  <TableRow key={task.id}>
                    <TableCell className="font-medium">{task.title}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                      {task.controlCode ?? "–"}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                        {day(task.dueOn)}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ControlPostureSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-36 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-36 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-36 rounded-xl" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Status page

A public status page: the overall status, each public component with its daily uptime, and the public incident updates. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [incidents block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/incidents) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add incidents`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/status-page.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button card empty skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/status/components/status-page.tsx"
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/require-await -- a Server Action must be async, and refresh() returns nothing to await
async function retry() {
  "use server";
  refresh();
}

type BadgeVariant = ComponentProps<typeof Badge>["variant"];

interface StatusLook {
  readonly badge: BadgeVariant;
  /** The background of an uptime cell. */
  readonly cell: string;
}

function statusLook(status: ComponentStatus): StatusLook {
  switch (status) {
    case "operational": {
      return { badge: "success-light", cell: "bg-success" };
    }

    case "maintenance": {
      return { badge: "info-light", cell: "bg-info" };
    }

    case "degraded": {
      return { badge: "warning-light", cell: "bg-warning" };
    }

    case "partial_outage": {
      return { badge: "warning-light", cell: "bg-warning" };
    }

    case "major_outage": {
      return { badge: "destructive-light", cell: "bg-destructive" };
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = status;

      return never;
    }
  }
}

function OverallAlert({
  status,
  title,
}: {
  status: ComponentStatus;
  title: string;
}) {
  switch (status) {
    case "operational": {
      return (
        <Alert variant="success">
          <CircleCheckIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{title}</AlertTitle>
        </Alert>
      );
    }

    case "maintenance": {
      return (
        <Alert variant="info">
          <WrenchIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{title}</AlertTitle>
        </Alert>
      );
    }

    case "degraded":
    case "partial_outage": {
      return (
        <Alert variant="warning">
          <TriangleAlertIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{title}</AlertTitle>
        </Alert>
      );
    }

    case "major_outage": {
      return (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <TriangleAlertIcon />
          <AlertTitle>{title}</AlertTitle>
        </Alert>
      );
    }

    default: {
      const never: never = status;

      return never;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * The public status page published at `slug`: the overall status, each public
 * component with its uptime, then the public incidents with their updates.
 * Anyone can open it; the incidents block returns only fields marked public.
 */
export async function StatusPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const [{ slug }, t, format] = await Promise.all([
    params,
    getExtracted("status"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  const page = await settle(() => loadStatusPage(slug));

  if (page.kind === "missing") {
    notFound();
  }

  if (page.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <Alert variant="destructive" data-recipe="status-page">
        <TriangleAlertIcon />
        <AlertTitle>{t("The status page didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>{t("Try again in a moment.")}</AlertDescription>
        <AlertAction>
          <form action={retry}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" type="submit">
              {t("Retry")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </AlertAction>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  const { data } = page;

  const labels: Record<ComponentStatus, string> = {
    operational: t("Operational"),
    maintenance: t("Maintenance"),
    degraded: t("Degraded performance"),
    partial_outage: t("Partial outage"),
    major_outage: t("Major outage"),
  };

  const overall: Record<ComponentStatus, string> = {
    operational: t("All systems operational"),
    maintenance: t("Scheduled maintenance in progress"),
    degraded: t("Some systems are affected"),
    partial_outage: t("Some systems are affected"),
    major_outage: t("Major outage"),
  };

  const updates: Record<IncidentStatus, string> = {
    investigating: t("Investigating"),
    identified: t("Identified"),
    monitoring: t("Monitoring"),
    resolved: t("Resolved"),
  };

  const day = (date: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(`${date}T12:00:00Z`), {
      dateStyle: "medium",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    });

  const when = (iso: string) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" data-recipe="status-page">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{data.title}</h1>
        {data.description ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{data.description}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <OverallAlert status={data.status} title={overall[data.status]} />
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Components")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t("Uptime over the last {days, number} days.", {
              days: UPTIME_DAYS,
            })}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {data.components.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty className="border">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <ActivityIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>{t("No components yet")}</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  {t(
                    "Components appear here once the team marks them public. Check back later.",
                  )}
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              {data.components.map((component) => {
                const look = statusLook(component.status);

                return (
                  <li key={component.id} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                        {component.name}
                      </span>
                      <Badge variant={look.badge}>
                        {labels[component.status]}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex h-8 gap-px" aria-hidden="true">
                      {component.uptime.map((entry) => (
                        <span
                          key={entry.date}
                          className={`flex-1 rounded-sm ${statusLook(entry.status).cell}`}
                          title={`${day(entry.date)}: ${labels[entry.status]}`}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {t("{percent, number}% uptime", {
                        percent: component.uptimePercent,
                      })}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t("Incidents")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {t(
              "Open incidents and those resolved in the last {days, number} days.",
              { days: UPTIME_DAYS },
            )}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {data.incidents.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("No incidents reported.")}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              {data.incidents.map((incident) => (
                <li key={incident.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      {incident.title}
                    </span>
                    <Badge
                      variant={
                        incident.status === "resolved"
                          ? "success-light"
                          : "warning-light"
                      }
                    >
                      {updates[incident.status]}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  {incident.components.length > 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("Affects {components}", {
                        components: incident.components
                          .map((component) => component.name)
                          .join(", "),
                      })}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                  <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-l pl-4">
                    {incident.updates.map((update) => (
                      <li
                        key={update.createdAt}
                        className="flex flex-col gap-1"
                      >
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {updates[update.status]}
                          {" · "}
                          {when(update.createdAt)}
                        </span>
                        <p className="text-sm">{update.body}</p>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatusPageSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6" aria-busy="true">
      <Skeleton className="h-12 rounded-xl" />
      <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Record grid

An app table as a data grid with search, filters, saved views and bulk actions on the selected rows, including Set field through `appTables.set`. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [saved-views block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/saved-views) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add saved-views`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-grid.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button dialog input select @reui/data-grid @reui/filters
```

A copy of `@reui/data-grid` installed from ReUI 2.8.0 or earlier memoizes its context on `recordCount` but not on the rows, so an edit that keeps the row count (a status change, a renamed task) doesn't repaint the cells. Reinstall it with `npx shadcn add @reui/data-grid --overwrite`, or add `table.options.data` to the dependency list of the `value` memo in `DataGridProvider`.

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-grid.tsx"
const STATUS_FIELD = "status";
const PROJECT_FIELD = "project";
const ONLY_IS = [{ value: "is", label: "is" }];

/** The URL's status and project filters as a ReUI filter query. */
function toFilterQuery(query: TaskQuery): FilterQuery<string> {
  return createFilterQuery([
    ...(query.status === null
      ? []
      : [
          createFilterRule({
            id: STATUS_FIELD,
            path: [STATUS_FIELD],
            operator: "is",
            value: query.status,
          }),
        ]),
    ...(query.projectId === null
      ? []
      : [
          createFilterRule({
            id: PROJECT_FIELD,
            path: [PROJECT_FIELD],
            operator: "is",
            value: query.projectId,
          }),
        ]),
  ]);
}

/** The one value a filter rule holds, or null once it is cleared. */
function valueOf(query: FilterQuery<string>, field: string): string | null {
  const condition = flattenFilterConditions(query).find(
    (each) => each.field === field,
  );

  const value = v.safeParse(v.string(), condition?.values[0]);

  return value.success ? value.output : null;
}

/**
 * The search, the filters and the saved views every task screen shares. They
 * live in the URL, so a saved view is the screen plus its search string.
 */
export function TaskToolbar({
  query,
  projects,
  views,
  canSaveViews,
}: {
  query: TaskQuery;
  projects: readonly ProjectOption[];
  views: readonly TaskViewOption[];
  canSaveViews: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const statusLabel = useStatusLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [navigating, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(query.q);

  const removeView = useAction(deleteTaskView, {
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const go = (next: TaskQuery) => {
    startTransition(() => {
      router.replace(`${pathname}${taskSearch(next)}`);
    });
  };

  const fields: FilterField<string>[] = [
    {
      id: STATUS_FIELD,
      label: t("Status"),
      type: "select",
      operators: ONLY_IS,
      options: TASK_STATUSES.map((status) => ({
        value: status,
        label: statusLabel(status),
      })),
    },
    {
      id: PROJECT_FIELD,
      label: t("Project"),
      type: "select",
      operators: ONLY_IS,
      options: projects.map((project) => ({
        value: project.id,
        label: project.name,
      })),
    },
  ];

  const activeView = views.find(
    (view) => taskSearch(view.query) === taskSearch(query),
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <form
        className="flex items-center gap-2"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          go({ ...query, q: search.trim() });
        }}
      >
        <Input
          type="search"
          className="w-56"
          value={search}
          placeholder={t("Search tasks")}
          aria-label={t("Search tasks")}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setSearch(event.target.value);
          }}
        />
        <Button
          type="submit"
          size="icon-sm"
          variant="outline"
          aria-label={t("Search")}
          disabled={navigating}
        >
          <SearchIcon />
        </Button>
      </form>
      <Filters
        size="sm"
        fields={fields}
        query={toFilterQuery(query)}
        showClear
        onQueryChange={(next) => {
          const status = TASK_STATUSES.find(
            (each) => each === valueOf(next, STATUS_FIELD),
          );

          go({
            ...query,
            status: status ?? null,
            projectId: valueOf(next, PROJECT_FIELD),
          });
        }}
      />
      <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
        {views.length === 0 ? null : (
          <Select
            value={activeView?.id ?? null}
            items={views.map((view) => ({ value: view.id, label: view.name }))}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const view = views.find((each) => each.id === value);

              if (view) {
                setSearch(view.query.q);
                go(view.query);
              }
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger
              size="sm"
              className="w-44"
              aria-label={t("Saved views")}
            >
              <SelectValue placeholder={t("Saved views")} />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {views.map((view) => (
                <SelectItem key={view.id} value={view.id}>
                  {view.name}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        )}
        {activeView ? (
          <Button
            size="icon-sm"
            variant="outline"
            aria-label={t("Delete view {name}", { name: activeView.name })}
            disabled={removeView.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              void removeView.run({ id: activeView.id });
            }}
          >
            <Trash2Icon />
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {canSaveViews ? <SaveTaskViewDialog query={query} /> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SaveTaskViewDialog({ query }: { query: TaskQuery }) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const save = useAction(saveTaskView);
  const error = save.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(save.error);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" />}>
        <BookmarkIcon />
        {t("Save view")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form
          className="grid gap-6"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            void save.run({ name, ...query }).then((result) => {
              if (result.ok) {
                toast.success(t("View saved"));
                setName("");
                setOpen(false);
              }
            });
          }}
        >
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("Save view")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("Keeps the screen, the search and the filters.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-name`}>{t("Name")}</FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-name`}
              value={name}
              required
              maxLength={80}
              autoComplete="off"
              onChange={(event) => {
                setName(event.target.value);
              }}
            />
            {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
          </Field>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={save.pending}>
              {t("Save")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

const UNASSIGNED = "unassigned";

type SetField = "due_on" | "assignee_id";

/**
 * Sets one field on the selected tasks with the bulk block's `appTables.set`.
 * An empty value clears the field.
 */
function SetFieldDialog({
  ids,
  members,
  onDone,
}: {
  ids: readonly string[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [field, setField] = useState<SetField>("due_on");
  const [dueOn, setDueOn] = useState("");
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState(UNASSIGNED);

  const set = useAction(setTaskField, {
    onSuccess: (count) => {
      toast.success(
        t("{count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} changed", { count }),
      );
      setOpen(false);
      onDone();
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const fields = [
    { value: "due_on", label: t("Due date") },
    { value: "assignee_id", label: t("Assignee") },
  ] as const satisfies readonly { value: SetField; label: string }[];

  const people = [
    { value: UNASSIGNED, label: t("Unassigned") },
    ...members.map((member) => ({ value: member.userId, label: member.name })),
  ];

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" />}>
        {t("Set field")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form
          className="grid gap-6"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            void set.run({
              ids: [...ids],
              values:
                field === "due_on"
                  ? { due_on: dueOn === "" ? null : dueOn }
                  : { assignee_id: assignee === UNASSIGNED ? null : assignee },
            });
          }}
        >
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {t(
                "Set a field on {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}",
                { count: ids.length },
              )}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("Leave the value empty to clear the field.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid gap-4">
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-field`}>{t("Field")}</FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={field}
                items={fields}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  const picked = fields.find((each) => each.value === value);

                  if (picked) {
                    setField(picked.value);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-field`} className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {fields.map((each) => (
                    <SelectItem key={each.value} value={each.value}>
                      {each.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            {field === "due_on" ? (
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-due`}>
                  {t("Due date")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input
                  id={`${fieldId}-due`}
                  type="date"
                  value={dueOn}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setDueOn(event.target.value);
                  }}
                />
              </Field>
            ) : (
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-assignee`}>
                  {t("Assignee")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Select
                  value={assignee}
                  items={people}
                  onValueChange={(value) => {
                    const person = people.find((each) => each.value === value);

                    if (person) {
                      setAssignee(person.value);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-assignee`} className="w-full">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {people.map((person) => (
                      <SelectItem key={person.value} value={person.value}>
                        {person.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </Field>
            )}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={set.pending}>
              {t("Apply")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

type GridRow = TaskRow & {
  readonly projectName: string;
  readonly assigneeName: string;
};

type GridCell = CellContext<DataGridFeatures, GridRow>;

const SELECT_COLUMN = {
  id: "select",
  header: () => <DataGridTableRowSelectAll />,
  cell: ({ row }) => <DataGridTableRowSelect row={row} />,
  size: 40,
} satisfies ColumnDef<DataGridFeatures, GridRow>;

function TitleCell({ row }: GridCell) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={`/projects/${row.original.projectId}`}
      className="font-medium hover:underline"
    >
      {row.original.title}
    </Link>
  );
}

function StatusCell({ row }: GridCell) {
  return <TaskStatusBadge status={row.original.status} />;
}

/**
 * Tasks in a ReUI data grid. The checkboxes feed a bulk bar that sets the
 * status of the selected rows, sets another field through the bulk block, or
 * deletes them in one statement.
 */
export function TaskGrid({
  rows,
  projects,
  members,
  canWrite,
}: {
  rows: readonly TaskRow[];
  projects: readonly ProjectOption[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  canWrite: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const statusLabel = useStatusLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<RowSelectionState>({});
  const projectName = new Map(projects.map((each) => [each.id, each.name]));
  const memberName = new Map(members.map((each) => [each.userId, each.name]));

  const bulk = useAction(runTaskBulkAction, {
    onSuccess: ({ count }) => {
      toast.success(
        t("{count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} changed", { count }),
      );
      setSelection({});
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const columns: ColumnDef<DataGridFeatures, GridRow>[] = [
    ...(canWrite ? [SELECT_COLUMN] : []),
    { accessorKey: "title", header: t("Title"), cell: TitleCell, size: 280 },
    { accessorKey: "status", header: t("Status"), cell: StatusCell, size: 120 },
    { accessorKey: "projectName", header: t("Project"), size: 180 },
    { accessorKey: "assigneeName", header: t("Assignee"), size: 160 },
    { accessorKey: "dueOn", header: t("Due"), size: 120 },
  ];

  const data = rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    projectName: projectName.get(row.projectId) ?? "",
    assigneeName:
      row.assigneeId === null
        ? t("Unassigned")
        : (memberName.get(row.assigneeId) ?? ""),
  }));

  const table = useTable({
    features: dataGridFeatures,
    columns,
    data,
    getRowId: (row) => row.id,
    state: { rowSelection: selection },
    enableRowSelection: canWrite,
    onRowSelectionChange: setSelection,
  });

  const ids = rows.filter((row) => selection[row.id]).map((row) => row.id);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-recipe="record-grid">
      {ids.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/50 p-2">
          <span className="text-sm">
            {t("{count, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}}", {
              count: ids.length,
            })}
          </span>
          {TASK_STATUSES.map((status) => (
            <Button
              key={status}
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={bulk.pending}
              onClick={() => {
                void bulk.run({ kind: "status", ids, status });
              }}
            >
              {t("Mark {status}", { status: statusLabel(status) })}
            </Button>
          ))}
          <SetFieldDialog
            ids={ids}
            members={members}
            onDone={() => {
              setSelection({});
            }}
          />
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="destructive"
            className="ml-auto"
            disabled={bulk.pending}
            onClick={() => {
              void bulk.run({ kind: "delete", ids });
            }}
          >
            <Trash2Icon />
            {t("Delete")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <DataGrid table={table} recordCount={rows.length}>
        <DataGridContainer>
          <DataGridScrollArea>
            <DataGridTable />
          </DataGridScrollArea>
        </DataGridContainer>
      </DataGrid>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Record form

A create form whose inputs follow each column: a length limit for text, a select for options, a date input and a searchable picker for references. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [saved-views block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/saved-views) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add saved-views`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-form.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button combobox dialog field input select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-form-dialog.tsx"
interface ReferenceOption {
  readonly value: string;
  readonly label: string;
}

/**
 * A searchable picker for a foreign key, such as `tasks.project_id`. It posts
 * the id in a hidden input, so the form stays a plain server action form.
 */
function ReferenceCombobox({
  id,
  name,
  options,
  defaultValue,
  placeholder,
  empty,
}: {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  options: readonly ReferenceOption[];
  defaultValue: string | null;
  placeholder: string;
  empty: string;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<ReferenceOption | null>(
    () => options.find((option) => option.value === defaultValue) ?? null,
  );

  return (
    <>
      <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value?.value ?? ""} />
      <Combobox
        items={options}
        value={value}
        onValueChange={setValue}
        itemToStringLabel={(option: ReferenceOption) => option.label}
        isItemEqualToValue={(a: ReferenceOption, b: ReferenceOption) =>
          a.value === b.value
        }
      >
        <ComboboxInput id={id} placeholder={placeholder} showClear />
        <ComboboxContent>
          <ComboboxEmpty>{empty}</ComboboxEmpty>
          <ComboboxList>
            {(option: ReferenceOption) => (
              <ComboboxItem key={option.value} value={option}>
                {option.label}
              </ComboboxItem>
            )}
          </ComboboxList>
        </ComboboxContent>
      </Combobox>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The create form for a task. Each column gets the input its type and format
 * call for: text with its `max`, a select for `options`, a date input for
 * `date`, and a combobox for each reference.
 */
export function TaskFormDialog({
  projects,
  members,
  defaultProjectId,
}: {
  projects: readonly ProjectOption[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  defaultProjectId: string | null;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const statusLabel = useStatusLabel();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TaskStatus>("todo");

  const form = useActionForm(createTask, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Task created"));
      setOpen(false);
    },
  });

  const error = form.error === undefined ? null : errorMessage(form.error);

  const statusItems = TASK_STATUSES.map((value) => ({
    value,
    label: statusLabel(value),
  }));

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);

        if (!next) {
          form.reset();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" />}>
        <PlusIcon />
        {t("New task")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <form {...form.formProps} className="grid gap-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("New task")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("It goes to the end of its status column.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-title`}>{t("Title")}</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${fieldId}-title`}
                name="title"
                required
                maxLength={200}
                autoComplete="off"
              />
              {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-project`}>
                {t("Project")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <ReferenceCombobox
                id={`${fieldId}-project`}
                name="projectId"
                options={projects.map((project) => ({
                  value: project.id,
                  label: project.name,
                }))}
                defaultValue={defaultProjectId}
                placeholder={t("Pick a project")}
                empty={t("No projects match.")}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-status`}>
                {t("Status")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <input type="hidden" name="status" value={status} />
              <Select
                value={status}
                items={statusItems}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  setStatus(
                    TASK_STATUSES.find((each) => each === value) ?? "todo",
                  );
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-status`}>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {statusItems.map((item) => (
                    <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                      {item.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-assignee`}>
                {t("Assignee")}
              </FieldLabel>
              <ReferenceCombobox
                id={`${fieldId}-assignee`}
                name="assigneeId"
                options={members.map((member) => ({
                  value: member.userId,
                  label: member.name,
                }))}
                defaultValue={null}
                placeholder={t("Unassigned")}
                empty={t("No members match.")}
              />
            </Field>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-starts`}>
                  {t("Starts on")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input id={`${fieldId}-starts`} name="startsOn" type="date" />
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-due`}>
                  {t("Due on")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input id={`${fieldId}-due`} name="dueOn" type="date" />
              </Field>
            </div>
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
              {t("Cancel")}
            </DialogClose>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
              {t("Create task")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/project-page.tsx"
/**
 * Render inside `<Suspense>`: one project as a record page. Its fields, its
 * tasks through the `project_id` reference, and the comments and tags that
 * reach it because `projects` is a subject.
 */
export async function ProjectPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const [{ id }, session] = await Promise.all([params, getSession()]);
  const organizationId = tenantOf(session);

  if (!organizationId) {
    notFound();
  }

  const [project, tasks, members, history, t, format, locale] =
    await Promise.all([
      settle(() => getProject(id)),
      settle(() => getTasks({ q: "", status: null, projectId: id })),
      settle(() => getMemberOptions(organizationId)),
      settle(() => getProjectHistory(id)),
      getExtracted("projects"),
      getFormatter(),
      getLocale(),
    ]);

  if (project.kind !== "ok" || tasks.kind !== "ok" || members.kind !== "ok") {
    return <ProjectLoadError title={t("The project didn't load")} />;
  }

  const record = project.data;

  if (record === undefined) {
    notFound();
  }

  const nameOf = (userId: string | null) =>
    userId === null
      ? t("Unassigned")
      : (members.data.find((member) => member.userId === userId)?.name ??
        userId);

  const subject = { type: PROJECT_SUBJECT, id: record.id };

  return (
    <div className="grid items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:col-span-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {record.name}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("Created {date}", {
              date: format.dateTime(new Date(record.createdAt), {
                dateStyle: "long",
              }),
            })}
          </p>
        </div>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Tasks")}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {t("{count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}", {
                count: tasks.data.length,
              })}
            </CardDescription>
            <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TaskImportAction projectId={record.id} />
              <TaskFormDialog
                projects={[{ id: record.id, name: record.name }]}
                members={members.data}
                defaultProjectId={record.id}
              />
            </CardAction>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {tasks.data.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("No tasks yet. Add the first one with New task.")}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
                {tasks.data.map((task) => (
                  <li
                    key={task.id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2"
                  >
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                      <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">
                        {task.title}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {nameOf(task.assigneeId)}
                        {task.dueOn
                          ? ` · ${t("due {date}", {
                              date: format.dateTime(
                                new Date(`${task.dueOn}T00:00:00Z`),
                                { dateStyle: "medium", timeZone: "UTC" },
                              ),
                            })}`
                          : null}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <TaskStatusBadge status={task.status} />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card data-recipe="comment-thread">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Comments")}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <CommentThread
              subject={subject}
              authors={Object.fromEntries(
                members.data.map((member) => [member.userId, member.name]),
              )}
              canComment={can(session, "messages.send")}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <Card size="sm">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Details")}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-sm">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{t("Budget")}</dt>
              <dd>
                {formatMoney(
                  money(record.budgetMinor, record.currency),
                  locale,
                )}
              </dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{t("Lead")}</dt>
              <dd>{nameOf(record.leadId)}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{t("Open tasks")}</dt>
              <dd>
                <Badge variant="outline">
                  {tasks.data.filter((task) => task.status !== "done").length}
                </Badge>
              </dd>
            </dl>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        {history.kind === "ok" ? (
          <ProjectHistory
            projectId={record.id}
            versions={history.data}
            canSave={can(session, "versions.create")}
            canRestore={can(session, "versions.restore")}
          />
        ) : (
          <ProjectLoadError title={t("The history didn't load")} />
        )}
        <Card size="sm" data-recipe="tag-input">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t("Tags")}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <TagInput subject={subject} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Link
          href={`/projects?view=board&project=${record.id}`}
          className="text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
        >
          {t("Open this project's board")}
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Record board

An app table as a board with a column per option value, where dragging a card writes the value and its rank. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [rank block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/rank) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add rank`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-board.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge @reui/kanban
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-board.tsx"
type Columns = Record<string, TaskRow[]>;

/** One column per option of the select column; rows arrive in rank order. */
function columnsOf(rows: readonly TaskRow[]): Columns {
  const columns: Columns = Object.fromEntries(
    TASK_STATUSES.map((status) => [status, []]),
  );

  for (const row of rows) {
    columns[row.status]?.push(row);
  }

  return columns;
}

function TaskCard({
  task,
  assignee,
}: {
  task: TaskRow;
  assignee: string | null;
}) {
  return (
    <Card size="sm">
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">{task.title}</span>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
          {task.dueOn === null ? null : (
            <Badge variant="outline">{task.dueOn}</Badge>
          )}
          {assignee === null ? null : (
            <Badge variant="secondary">{assignee}</Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/**
 * Tasks in a column per status. A drop calls `rank.move` with the cards on
 * either side and the column, so the status and the order save together. A
 * refused move puts the card back.
 */
export function TaskBoard({
  rows,
  members,
  canMove,
}: {
  rows: readonly TaskRow[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  canMove: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const statusLabel = useStatusLabel();
  const [columns, setColumns] = useState(() => columnsOf(rows));
  const move = useAction(moveTask);
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  const memberName = new Map(members.map((each) => [each.userId, each.name]));

  const assigneeOf = (task: TaskRow) =>
    task.assigneeId === null ? null : (memberName.get(task.assigneeId) ?? null);

  return (
    <div data-recipe="record-board">
      <Kanban
        value={columns}
        onValueChange={setColumns}
        getItemValue={(item) => item.id}
        onValueCommit={(value, meta) => {
          const status = TASK_STATUSES.find(
            (each) => each === meta.overContainer,
          );

          if (meta.kind !== "item" || status === undefined) {
            return;
          }

          const column = value[status] ?? [];

          void move
            .run({
              id: String(meta.event.active.id),
              status,
              previousId: column[meta.overIndex - 1]?.id ?? null,
              nextId: column[meta.overIndex + 1]?.id ?? null,
            })
            .then((result) => {
              if (!result.ok) {
                setColumns(meta.previousValue);
                toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
              }
            });
        }}
      >
        <KanbanBoard className="flex overflow-x-auto">
          {TASK_STATUSES.map((status) => {
            const tasks = columns[status] ?? [];

            return (
              <KanbanColumn
                key={status}
                value={status}
                className="w-72 shrink-0 gap-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-3"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <Badge variant={statusBadgeVariant(status)}>
                    {statusLabel(status)}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline">{tasks.length}</Badge>
                </div>
                <KanbanColumnContent value={status} className="min-h-16">
                  {tasks.map((task) => (
                    <KanbanItem
                      key={task.id}
                      value={task.id}
                      disabled={!canMove || move.pending}
                    >
                      <KanbanItemHandle cursor={canMove}>
                        <TaskCard task={task} assignee={assigneeOf(task)} />
                      </KanbanItemHandle>
                    </KanbanItem>
                  ))}
                  {tasks.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("Drop a task here.")}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </KanbanColumnContent>
              </KanbanColumn>
            );
          })}
        </KanbanBoard>
        <KanbanOverlay>
          {({ value, variant }) => {
            const task =
              variant === "item" ? byId.get(String(value)) : undefined;

            return task ? (
              <TaskCard task={task} assignee={assigneeOf(task)} />
            ) : null;
          }}
        </KanbanOverlay>
      </Kanban>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Record calendar

Rows on a month grid by a date column, with the month in the URL and a count of rows without a date. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [calendar block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/calendar) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add calendar`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-calendar.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-calendar.tsx"
const SHOWN_PER_DAY = 3;

/**
 * Tasks on a month grid by their due date. The month lives in the URL
 * (`?month=YYYY-MM`), so the arrows are links and the page stays a server
 * component.
 */
export async function TaskCalendar({
  rows,
  first,
  today,
  monthHref,
}: {
  rows: readonly TaskRow[];
  first: Temporal.PlainDate;
  today: Temporal.PlainDate;
  monthHref: (month: string) => string;
}) {
  const [t, format] = await Promise.all([
    getExtracted("projects"),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);

  const weeks = weeksOf(first);
  const byDay = new Map<string, TaskRow[]>();

  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.dueOn !== null) {
      byDay.set(row.dueOn, [...(byDay.get(row.dueOn) ?? []), row]);
    }
  }

  const label = (date: Temporal.PlainDate, options: DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
    format.dateTime(new Date(`${date.toString()}T12:00:00Z`), {
      ...options,
      timeZone: "UTC",
    });

  const unscheduled = rows.filter((row) => row.dueOn === null).length;

  const monthOf = (date: Temporal.PlainDate) =>
    date.toPlainYearMonth().toString();

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="record-calendar">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>
          {label(first, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "{count, plural, =0 {Every task has a due date.} one {# task has no due date.} other {# tasks have no due date.}}",
            { count: unscheduled },
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={monthHref(monthOf(first.subtract({ months: 1 })))}
            aria-label={t("Previous month")}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
          >
            <ChevronLeftIcon />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={monthHref(monthOf(today))}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}
          >
            {t("Today")}
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={monthHref(monthOf(first.add({ months: 1 })))}
            aria-label={t("Next month")}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon-sm" })}
          >
            <ChevronRightIcon />
          </Link>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <div className="min-w-[42rem] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
            <div
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="grid grid-cols-7 border-b bg-muted/50"
            >
              {weeks[0]?.map((day) => (
                <span
                  key={day.toString()}
                  className="px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  {label(day, { weekday: "short" })}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
            <ol
              aria-label={label(first, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}
              className="grid grid-cols-7"
            >
              {weeks.flat().map((day) => {
                const key = day.toString();
                const tasks = byDay.get(key) ?? [];
                const outside = day.month !== first.month;

                return (
                  <li
                    key={key}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex min-h-24 flex-col gap-1 border-e border-b p-1.5 [&:nth-child(7n)]:border-e-0",
                      outside && "bg-muted/30",
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="sr-only">
                      {label(day, { dateStyle: "full" })}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className={cn(
                        "text-xs",
                        outside ? "text-muted-foreground" : "font-medium",
                      )}
                    >
                      {day.equals(today) ? (
                        <Badge variant="default">{day.day}</Badge>
                      ) : (
                        day.day
                      )}
                    </span>
                    {tasks.slice(0, SHOWN_PER_DAY).map((task) => (
                      <Link
                        key={task.id}
                        href={`/projects/${task.projectId}`}
                        title={task.title}
                        className={cn(
                          "truncate rounded-sm bg-primary/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-primary/20",
                          task.status === "done" &&
                            "text-muted-foreground line-through",
                        )}
                      >
                        {task.title}
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                    {tasks.length > SHOWN_PER_DAY ? (
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("{count} more", {
                          count: String(tasks.length - SHOWN_PER_DAY),
                        })}
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
