```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-timeline.tsx"
const UNASSIGNED = "";

/**
 * Tasks as bars from `startsOn` to `dueOn`, one lane per assignee, over a
 * four-week window that lives in the URL (`?from=YYYY-MM-DD`).
 */
export async function TaskTimeline({
  rows,
  members,
  from,
  today,
  windowHref,
}: {
  rows: readonly TaskRow[];
  members: readonly MemberOption[];
  from: Temporal.PlainDate;
  today: Temporal.PlainDate;
  windowHref: (from: string) => string;
}) {
  const t = await getExtracted("projects");
  const lanes = new Map<string, TaskRow[]>();

  for (const row of rows) {
    if (spanOf(row, from) !== null) {
      const lane = row.assigneeId ?? UNASSIGNED;

      lanes.set(lane, [...(lanes.get(lane) ?? []), row]);
    }
  }

  const laneName = (id: string) =>
    id === UNASSIGNED
      ? t("Unassigned")
      : (members.find((member) => member.userId === id)?.name ?? id);

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="record-timeline">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Timeline")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "Tasks with a start or due date in these four weeks, by assignee.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          <WindowNav from={from} today={today} windowHref={windowHref} />
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <div className="min-w-[56rem] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-[10rem_1fr]">
              <span className="border-e border-b bg-muted/50" />
              <WindowDays from={from} today={today} />
              {lanes.size === 0 ? (
                <p className="col-span-2 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("No tasks fall in these weeks.")}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              {[...lanes].map(([lane, tasks]) => (
                <div key={lane} className="contents">
                  <span className="truncate border-e border-b p-2 text-sm font-medium">
                    {laneName(lane)}
                  </span>
                  <ol className="grid grid-cols-28 gap-y-1 border-b py-1.5">
                    {tasks.map((task) => {
                      const span = spanOf(task, from);

                      return span === null ? null : (
                        <li
                          key={task.id}
                          className="[grid-column:var(--span-start)/span_var(--span-length)]"
                          // SAFETY: React's CSSProperties has no custom properties; both are numbers.
                          style={
                            {
                              "--span-start": span.start + 1,
                              "--span-length": span.length,
                            } as CSSProperties
                          }
                        >
                          <Link
                            href={`/projects/${task.projectId}`}
                            title={task.title}
                            className={cn(
                              "block truncate rounded-sm bg-primary/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-primary/20",
                              task.status === "done" &&
                                "text-muted-foreground line-through",
                            )}
                          >
                            {task.title}
                          </Link>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ol>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Record Gantt chart

A row per record grouped by its parent, with a bar for its planned dates and a marker for rows without dates. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [calendar block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/calendar) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add calendar`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-gantt.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-gantt.tsx"
const BAR = {
  todo: "bg-muted-foreground/30",
  doing: "bg-primary/60",
  done: "bg-primary/25",
} as const satisfies Record<TaskStatus, string>;

/**
 * One row per task under its project, with a bar from `startsOn` to `dueOn`.
 * Tasks without dates stay in the list with an empty track, so the plan shows
 * what still needs scheduling.
 */
export async function TaskGantt({
  rows,
  projects,
  from,
  today,
  windowHref,
}: {
  rows: readonly TaskRow[];
  projects: readonly ProjectOption[];
  from: Temporal.PlainDate;
  today: Temporal.PlainDate;
  windowHref: (from: string) => string;
}) {
  const t = await getExtracted("projects");

  const groups = projects
    .map((project) => ({
      project,
      tasks: rows.filter((row) => row.projectId === project.id),
    }))
    .filter((group) => group.tasks.length > 0);

  return (
    <Card data-recipe="record-gantt">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Gantt")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Every task by project, with its planned dates.")}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          <WindowNav from={from} today={today} windowHref={windowHref} />
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <div className="min-w-[60rem] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-[14rem_1fr]">
              <span className="border-e border-b bg-muted/50" />
              <WindowDays from={from} today={today} />
              {groups.map(({ project, tasks }) => (
                <div key={project.id} className="contents">
                  <Link
                    href={`/projects/${project.id}`}
                    className="col-span-2 border-b bg-muted/30 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium hover:underline"
                  >
                    {project.name}
                  </Link>
                  {tasks.map((task) => {
                    const span = spanOf(task, from);

                    return (
                      <div key={task.id} className="contents">
                        <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-e border-b px-2 py-1.5 ps-4">
                          <span className="truncate text-sm">{task.title}</span>
                          {span === null &&
                          task.startsOn === null &&
                          task.dueOn === null ? (
                            <Badge variant="outline">{t("No dates")}</Badge>
                          ) : null}
                        </span>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-28 items-center border-b">
                          {span === null ? null : (
                            <span
                              title={t("{start} to {end}", {
                                start: task.startsOn ?? task.dueOn ?? "",
                                end: task.dueOn ?? task.startsOn ?? "",
                              })}
                              className={`[grid-column:var(--span-start)/span_var(--span-length)] h-4 rounded-sm ${BAR[task.status]}`}
                              // SAFETY: React's CSSProperties has no custom properties; both are numbers.
                              style={
                                {
                                  "--span-start": span.start + 1,
                                  "--span-length": span.length,
                                } as CSSProperties
                              }
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Record history

Every version `subject.versions` kept of a row, with the fields each one changed and a restore per field. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [versions block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/versions) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add versions`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/record-history.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card empty
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/project-history.tsx"
interface FieldChange {
  readonly field: ProjectHistoryField;
  readonly before: string | undefined;
  readonly after: string | undefined;
}

/**
 * The fields a version changed from the one before it; all of them for the
 * first.
 */
function changesOf(
  version: ProjectVersion,
  previous: ProjectVersion | undefined,
): readonly FieldChange[] {
  return PROJECT_HISTORY_FIELDS.flatMap((field) => {
    const after = version.fields[field];
    const before = previous?.fields[field];

    return previous !== undefined && before === after
      ? []
      : [{ field, before, after }];
  });
}

/**
 * The project's history: every version the snapshot trigger kept, with the
 * fields it changed. Restore writes one field of an older version back and
 * leaves the others as they are.
 */
export function ProjectHistory({
  projectId,
  versions,
  canSave,
  canRestore,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  versions: readonly ProjectVersion[];
  canSave: boolean;
  canRestore: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");

  return (
    <Card size="sm" data-recipe="record-history">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("History")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Each change to the name, budget or currency.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {versions.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty className="border">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <HistoryIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>{t("No history yet")}</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                {t("The next change to this project appears here.")}
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
            {canSave ? (
              <EmptyContent>
                <SaveVersionButton projectId={projectId} />
              </EmptyContent>
            ) : null}
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <ol className="flex flex-col divide-y" data-testid="project-history">
            {versions.map((version, index) => (
              <VersionEntry
                key={version.id}
                projectId={projectId}
                version={version}
                changes={changesOf(version, versions[index + 1])}
                canRestore={canRestore && index > 0}
              />
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function VersionEntry({
  projectId,
  version,
  changes,
  canRestore,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  version: ProjectVersion;
  changes: readonly FieldChange[];
  canRestore: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const restore = useAction(restoreProjectFields, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Field restored"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const label = {
    name: t("Name"),
    budget_minor: t("Budget"),
    currency: t("Currency"),
  } as const satisfies Record<ProjectHistoryField, string>;

  const source = {
    manual: t("Saved"),
    auto: t("Edited"),
    restore: t("Restored"),
  } as const satisfies Record<ProjectVersion["source"], string>;

  const shown = (field: ProjectHistoryField, value: string | undefined) => {
    if (value === undefined) {
      return t("Empty");
    }

    return field === "budget_minor"
      ? formatMoney(
          money(BigInt(value), version.fields.currency ?? "EUR"),
          locale,
        )
      : value;
  };

  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-2 py-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
          {t("Version {number}", { number: String(version.number) })}
        </span>
        <Badge variant="secondary">{source[version.source]}</Badge>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {format.dateTime(version.createdAt, {
            dateStyle: "medium",
            timeStyle: "short",
          })}
        </span>
      </div>
      <dl className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        {changes.map((change) => (
          <div key={change.field} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <dt className="w-20 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">
              {label[change.field]}
            </dt>
            <dd className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1">
              {change.before === undefined ? null : (
                <>
                  <span className="truncate text-muted-foreground line-through">
                    {shown(change.field, change.before)}
                  </span>
                  <ArrowRightIcon className="size-3 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                </>
              )}
              <span className="truncate">
                {shown(change.field, change.after)}
              </span>
            </dd>
            {canRestore ? (
              <Button
                size="xs"
                variant="ghost"
                disabled={restore.pending}
                aria-label={t("Restore {field} from version {number}", {
                  field: label[change.field],
                  number: String(version.number),
                })}
                onClick={() => {
                  void restore.run({
                    projectId,
                    versionId: version.id,
                    fields: [change.field],
                  });
                }}
              >
                {t("Restore")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
    </li>
  );
}

function SaveVersionButton({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const save = useAction(snapshotProjectVersions, {
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Version saved"));
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  return (
    <Button
      size="sm"
      variant="outline"
      disabled={save.pending}
      onClick={() => {
        void save.run({ id: projectId, input: {} });
      }}
    >
      <HistoryIcon />
      {t("Save a version")}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## Upsert import

Paste CSV, map its columns, preview the rows it creates and changes, then upsert them on one of the table's unique sets. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [imports block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/imports) must be installed (`npx better-supabase add imports`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/upsert-import.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button dialog field select skeleton textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/projects/components/task-import-dialog.tsx"
const SKIP = "skip";

type Choice = TaskImportField | typeof SKIP;

function isChoice(value: unknown): value is Choice {
  return value === SKIP || TASK_IMPORT_FIELDS.some((field) => field === value);
}

/** The mapped columns, without the skipped ones. */
function mappedOnly(
  mapping: Readonly<Record<string, Choice>>,
): Record<string, TaskImportField> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(mapping).flatMap(([header, choice]) =>
      choice === SKIP ? [] : [[header, choice]],
    ),
  );
}

/**
 * Imports tasks into the project from pasted CSV: map the columns, preview what
 * the file creates and changes, then run it. A task with the same title in the
 * project is updated instead of added twice.
 */
export function TaskImportDialog({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const t = useExtracted("projects");
  const id = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [csv, setCsv] = useState("");
  const [mapping, setMapping] = useState<Record<string, Choice>>({});
  const preview = useAction(previewTaskImport);

  const run = useAction(runTaskImport, {
    onSuccess: ({ status, imported }) => {
      if (status === "completed") {
        toast.success(
          t("{count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} imported", {
            count: imported,
          }),
        );
        setOpen(false);
        setCsv("");
        setMapping({});
        preview.reset();
      } else {
        toast.error(t("The file has rows that need fixing."));
      }
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(errorMessage(error));
    },
  });

  const [headers = []] = csv.trim() === "" ? [] : parseCsv(csv);
  const titleMapped = Object.values(mapping).includes("title");

  const label = {
    title: t("Title"),
    status: t("Status"),
    dueOn: t("Due date"),
  } as const satisfies Record<TaskImportField, string>;

  const choices = [
    { value: SKIP, label: t("Skip") },
    ...TASK_IMPORT_FIELDS.map((field) => ({
      value: field,
      label: label[field],
    })),
  ];

  const changeCsv = (text: string) => {
    setCsv(text);
    preview.reset();

    const [first = []] = text.trim() === "" ? [] : parseCsv(text);
    const suggested = suggestMapping(first, TASK_IMPORT_FIELDS);

    setMapping(
      Object.fromEntries(
        first.map((header) => {
          const field = suggested[header];

          return [header, isChoice(field) ? field : SKIP];
        }),
      ),
    );
  };

  const input = { projectId, csv, mapping: mappedOnly(mapping) };

  const runPreview = () => {
    void preview.run(input);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" />}>
        <UploadIcon />
        {t("Import")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent data-recipe="upsert-import">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t("Import tasks")}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {t(
              "Paste CSV with a title column. A title the project already has updates that task.",
            )}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-csv`}>{t("CSV")}</FieldLabel>
            <Textarea
              id={`${id}-csv`}
              rows={5}
              value={csv}
              placeholder={"title,status,due\nWrite the brief,todo,2026-11-02"}
              onChange={(event) => {
                changeCsv(event.target.value);
              }}
            />
          </Field>
          {headers.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {headers.map((header) => (
                <Field key={header}>
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${header}`}>{header}</FieldLabel>
                  <Select
                    value={mapping[header] ?? SKIP}
                    items={choices}
                    onValueChange={(value) => {
                      if (isChoice(value)) {
                        setMapping((current) => ({
                          ...current,
                          [header]: value,
                        }));
                        preview.reset();
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger
                      id={`${id}-${header}`}
                      size="sm"
                      className="w-full"
                    >
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {choices.map((choice) => (
                        <SelectItem key={choice.value} value={choice.value}>
                          {choice.label}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </Field>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {preview.error ? (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <TriangleAlertIcon />
              <AlertTitle>{t("The preview didn't load")}</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription>{errorMessage(preview.error)}</AlertDescription>
              <AlertAction>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={runPreview}>
                  {t("Retry")}
                </Button>
              </AlertAction>
            </Alert>
          ) : preview.pending ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-8" />
          ) : preview.data ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2" data-testid="import-preview">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="success-light">
                  {t("{count, plural, one {# new} other {# new}}", {
                    count: preview.data.created,
                  })}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="info-light">
                  {t("{count, plural, one {# changed} other {# changed}}", {
                    count: preview.data.changed,
                  })}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="secondary">
                  {t("{count, plural, one {# unchanged} other {# unchanged}}", {
                    count: preview.data.unchanged,
                  })}
                </Badge>
                {preview.data.errors.length > 0 ? (
                  <Badge variant="destructive-light">
                    {t("{count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}", {
                      count: preview.data.errors.length,
                    })}
                  </Badge>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              {preview.data.errors.slice(0, 5).map((error) => (
                <p
                  key={`${error.row}:${error.message}`}
                  className="text-xs text-destructive"
                >
                  {t("Row {row}: {message}", {
                    row: String(error.row),
                    message: error.message,
                  })}
                </p>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
            {t("Cancel")}
          </DialogClose>
          {preview.data && preview.data.errors.length === 0 ? (
            <Button
              disabled={run.pending}
              onClick={() => {
                void run.run(input);
              }}
            >
              {t("Import")}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              disabled={!titleMapped || preview.pending}
              onClick={runPreview}
            >
              {t("Preview")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```
